llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope core LLM post-training research: a measurement/reproducibility audit of difficulty labels in RLVR (GRPO on Qwen2.5-0.5B, MATH), directly engaging RL, reasoning, and LLM evaluation preferences. Methodologically strong: bootstrap CIs, equal-cost budget allocation controls, generation-length confound checks, matched-sample gradient reanalysis with explicit selection-effect caveats, and two prospectively frozen predictions that validated. Novelty is solid but it is a reanalysis rather than a new method or mechanism; the transferable contribution is the sampling-budget procedure, not the specific numbers, which limits generalizability beyond one dataset/model scale. Reproducibility is well supported by a 47-constant configuration audit and planned artifact release, though release is contingent on acceptance and the replication is not byte-for-byte identical (1,024 vs 5,120 token cap).

primary_link.title: Unlearnable, or Unmeasured? On the Reliability of Difficulty Labels in RLVR

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach for improving reasoning during post-training. Recent work suggests that some difficult prompts remain resistant to learning even when they occasionally produce correct solutions. We revisit this unlearnability phenomenon and find that the affected prompts do improve, at roughly one third of the learnable rate, while the difficulty-defined set used to study them is much less reproducible than expected. These di
papers.summary_zh: 本文重新檢視 RLVR 中的「無法學習」（unlearnable）現象。作者指出，被 Chen 等人標為無法學習的提示其實仍會進步，只是速率約為可學習組的三分之一，屬於「慢速學習」而非完全不學；然而用來界定該現象的提示集合本身極不穩定。研究以 Qwen2.5-0.5B 在 MATH 的 1,023 道題目上以 GRPO 訓練五個隨機種子，並以 128 次 rollout 重建難度標籤。結果顯示：同一批候選提示中，原始五種子聚合規則只留下 74 題，改成「五個種子全部無獎勵才剔除」則得 228 題，單一種子則在 145 至 150 題之間；固定檢查點重新取樣即可重現約八成的跨種子差異，顯示多數不一致來自有限次評估而非訓練本身。作者進一步將難度判定形式化為取樣預算問題，以 Kiefer–Wolfowitz 非參數混合分布模型預測不同 rollout 數下的 Jaccard 一致性，並在 N=40 與 N=64 兩個未量測預算上進行前瞻性凍結驗證，量測值皆落於預測區間內。此外，他們指出困難提示的正確 rollout 較少，使梯度估計樣本數不足；將正確 rollout 數配對後，easy 對 unlearnable 的梯度相似度比值由 2.327 倍降至 1.539 倍，殘餘差距仍在。限制在於訓練與主要評估使用 1,024 token 生成上限，與原始 5,120 設定不同，訓練相關數值不宜直接外推；配對分析亦有樣本流失與選擇效應。本文的意義在於提醒：以低預算難度標籤分類個別提示、或據此建立機制性主張，都可能不可靠，應先量化其可重現性。
papers.title: Unlearnable, or Unmeasured? On the Reliability of Difficulty Labels in RLVR
papers.title_zh: 無法學習，還是無法測量？論 RLVR 中難度標籤的可靠性

links.title: COMPASS: Predicting the Relationship of Multiple Patches for Vulnerabilities with LLMs

evidence: Abstract: claims 85.04% average improvement over SOTA on a 300 multi-patch CVE benchmark and public release of https://patch-relation.com
Section II-A: taxonomy derived from 1,050 multi-patch CVE entries plus interviews with 20 developers with 7+ years experience, yielding six relationship types

Section IV-C: benchmark of 300 CVEs (2-7 patches each, 694 patches, 473 relationship instances) across 213 repositories spanning 2009-2024, Cohen's Kappa 87.98% with third-expert disagreement resolution

Section IV-A1/IV-B: four LLMs (DeepSeek-v3, Claude-3.7, Grok-3, Gemini-2.5) evaluated; baselines include fine-tuned CodeReviewer, CodeT5, BERT with soft-prompt variants under 10-fold cross-validation (lr 1e-4, batch 48, focal loss)
Table I (Section V-A): DeepSeek-v3 best F1 on all six types (e.g., Mirror 87.36%, Merge 80.49%) and adopted as default backbone
Section V-C Table III: ablations show Collaboration F1 drops from 63.64% to 32.14% (C_zero-shot) and 36.11% (C_pred-only), supporting both one-shot demonstrations and the multi-phase pipeline
Section VII: threats to validity address annotator subjectivity, LLM data-leakage risk (labels newly created; DS-only underperforms COMPASS), and limited ecosystem coverage
Section I contributions: experimental code, prompts, data, and tool source released in a public repository; authors acknowledge taxonomy is not exhaustive
llm_evaluation.rationale: LLM-centric software engineering paper squarely within preference space: the method's core is structured LLM prompting (chain-of-thought intuition, hierarchy-guided prompts, one-shot demonstrations, validation phase) applied to a new task—predicting relationships among multiple patches for the same CVE. Task-level novelty is high (first work on patch-relationship prediction, six-type taxonomy from 1,050 inspected CVEs and 20 developer interviews), though the pipeline itself is standard prompting methodology rather than a new language-modeling technique. Rigor is solid: 300-CVE benchmark disjoint from taxonomy set, 473 instances with Cohen's Kappa 87.98%, four LLM backbones compared, six fine-tuned pre-trained-model baselines with 10-fold CV, an LLM-only control isolating pipeline gains, and ablations of one-shot prompting and supporting phases; the headline 85.04% average relative F1 improvement is internally consistent with Table II values. Weaknesses: no statistical significance testing, single-LLM DS-only control, taxonomy explicitly non-exhaustive, and scope limited to vulnerability patches without industrial validation. Reproducibility claims are concrete (public repository with prompts/code/data, online website patch-relation.com), though link liveness is unverifiable from the text.

primary_link.title: COMPASS: Predicting the Relationship of Multiple Patches for Vulnerabilities with LLMs

papers.summary: Modern software heavily relies on code reuse, so upstream vulnerability fixes do not automatically propagate to downstream codebases. Downstream maintainers must manually adopt patches to eliminate known risks. In practice, a single vulnerability often corresponds to multiple patches, which greatly complicates downstream patch adoption because different patch relationships imply different adoption strategies. To address this challenge, we first manually inspect large-scale multi-patch vulnerabil
papers.summary_zh: 開源軟體大量依賴程式碼重用，上游的漏洞修補不會自動傳遞到下游專案，下游維護者必須手動採納修補程式。然而單一漏洞常對應多個修補程式，也就是「多對一」修補模式，不同修補關係意味著截然不同的採納策略，若理解錯誤可能導致延遲、不一致，甚至不安全的修補。既有做法幾乎全靠人工分析，耗時費力且難以規模化。為此，作者先人工檢視約一千筆真實世界的多重修補漏洞案例並訪談二十位資深開發者，歸納出六種典型關係：Merge、Mirror、Better Solution、Fixing-of-Fixing、Collaboration 與 Separation。據此提出 COMPASS，一套以大型語言模型（LLM）為核心的自動化方法，採四階段流程：先擷取修補群並預先掃描訊息中的顯性關係線索，再進行個別修補程式分析，接著以階層引導式提示推論關係實例，最後驗證結果的完整性與一致性，並輸出關係圖。作者建構 300 筆含 2 至 7 個修補程式的 CVE 基準集，與建立分類法所用的一千餘筆資料完全不相交，標註者間 Cohen's Kappa 達 87.98%。實驗顯示 COMPASS 在六類關係上皆優於學習式基準（CodeReviewer、CodeT5、BERT 及其 soft-prompt 變體）與純 LLM 基準，平均 F1 相對提升 85.04%；消融實驗指出 one-shot 示範與第二、四階段皆有正面貢獻，其中 Collaboration 對示範最為敏感。作者亦釋出線上查詢網站與工具。限制在於分類法與標註仍含主觀判斷，基準規模與產業驗證尚有不足，且部分關係類型的 F1 仍偏低。
papers.title: COMPASS: Predicting the Relationship of Multiple Patches for Vulnerabilities with LLMs
papers.title_zh: COMPASS：以大型語言模型預測漏洞多重修補程式之間的關係

links.title: From Spectra to Joint Schedules in LLM Pre-training: 3+3(+2) Scaling-Law Regimes

evidence: Abstract: 'Controlled nanoGPT experiments show that (1) learning-rate and batch-size schedules with matched B/eta paths are nearly equivalent in intrinsic time, (2) a forcing-memory surrogate accurately predicts loss across schedules'; code at github.com/yichenblue/spectra-to-schedules-in-pretraining
Theorem 3.1 (Sec. 3): 'nu_W^F((0,x]) prop x^{q_F} iff F_{W,>0}(t) prop T^{-q_F}' — cumulative weighted spectral mass, not coordinatewise power laws, determines component power laws

Theorem 5.1 (Sec. 5): q_N(vartheta) piecewise formula and preserve/change/destroy classification comparing noise exponent to clean exponent q_0, with a 'memory ceiling' beyond which late-stage noise reduction cannot improve decay
Sec. 5.4 / Fig. 6: independently fitted q_K = 1.017 (OpenWebText), 0.952 (FineWeb), 0.995 (peS2o V2), each fitted only on 8-1-1 and transferred to WSD 'without refitting'

Appendix F.1: 30M nanoGPT, plain SGD, B=8, eleven ratio paths vartheta in {0,...,2} stopped at matched intrinsic time; authors state 'This experiment tests these predictions only qualitatively. It uses one seed... and does not independently estimate q_K'

Appendix F.2: 300M nanoGPT, 6.5B OpenWebText tokens (5.2B prefix + 1.3B tail); plain-SGD trajectories 'nearly coincide' under B/eta in intrinsic time, Muon under B/eta^2 (empirically calibrated, 'not identified with the plain-SGD ratio')
Remark A.5 and Assumption A1: 'the simultaneous width–time uniformity used above is assumed' and empirical-to-DE transfer is assumed — key bridging conditions not proved
Appendix F.3 (unrestricted fit): all seven parameters free gives q_K=0.989, q_F=0.291; authors caution this 'does not independently identify an asymptotic memory exponent'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory-first paper on LLM pre-training scaling laws and joint learning-rate/batch-size schedules, squarely matching the LLM (2.5) and Scaling & Efficiency (1.3) preferences plus Training & Optimization. It proves componentwise spectral iff-criteria for power-law forcing/memory (Theorems 3.1/A.4), a sharp preserve-change-destroy schedule classification (Theorem 5.1, Appendix D), and phase-wise compute-optimal rates (Corollary 5.2, Table 1), then bridges to LLMs via a 7-parameter forcing-memory surrogate tested on nanoGPT across OpenWebText/FineWeb/peS2o with q_K=1.017/0.952/0.995 (Sec. 5.4, Appendix F.3). Novelty is solid but partly derivative of Paquette et al. (2024) 4+3 regimes and Li et al. (2025) FSL; the extension adds label noise, joint schedules, and a new 3+3(+2) propagation taxonomy. Rigor is high: extensive proved theorems with explicit stability/spectral-window assumptions, though key uniformity assumptions (Remark A.5, Assumption A1, C.19) are assumed rather than proved. LLM evidence is meaningful but limited: plain-SGD nanoGPT at 30M-300M, one seed in the ratio-path test (Appendix F.1 admits it is qualitative), and proxy-to-LLM validity is empirical, not proved. Code is released and protocols are detailed, aiding reproducibility. Generalizability beyond power-law spectra, SGD, and small-scale models is qualified by the authors themselves (Muon uses different coordinates, Appendix F.2).

primary_link.title: From Spectra to Joint Schedules in LLM Pre-training: 3+3(+2) Scaling-Law Regimes

papers.summary: Power-law learning curves are often treated as fixed properties of a model and its data, although learning-rate and batch-size schedules can change the observed loss. We study this dependence in noisy online SGD with linear random features. Conditional on the representation, an exact Volterra equation separates two response components: a forcing term that propagates unresolved target error and a memory kernel that propagates stochastic-error injections. We prove that either component follows a p
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個常被忽略的問題：冪次學習曲線究竟有多少是模型與資料的固定屬性，又有多少取決於學習率與批次大小的排程。作者以帶標籤雜訊的線上 SGD 訓練線性隨機特徵模型作為代理模型，推導出精確的 Volterra 遞迴式，將預測風險拆成兩個成分：傳遞未解目標誤差的強制項（forcing），以及傳遞隨機誤差注入的記憶核（memory kernel）。理論證明這兩個成分各自遵循冪次律，若且唯若其累積加權低頻譜質量具備對應的尺度行為，個別特徵值或目標係數不需逐點服從冪次律。在聯合排程下，內在時間控制最佳化進度，而批次大小與學習率之比控制雜訊注入，兩者交互決定排程是保留、改變或摧毀乾淨的冪次律，並給出雜訊縮減的記憶上限。實作上以 124M 與 300M 的 nanoGPT 進行控制實驗，發現配對的 B/η 路徑在內在時間下幾乎重合、強制—記憶代理模型能準確預測未見排程，且在 OpenWebText、FineWeb 與 peS2o 上擬合出的記憶指數皆接近 1，落在 LM/IM 邊界。限制在於代理模型刻意簡化、實驗僅用單一隨機種子與總驗證交叉熵、未獨立估計漸近記憶指數，且 Muon 僅為外部效度檢查。
papers.title: From Spectra to Joint Schedules in LLM Pre-training: 3+3(+2) Scaling-Law Regimes
papers.title_zh: 從頻譜到聯合排程：LLM 預訓練中的 3+3(+2) 縮放律機制

links.title: MemLife: Curating and Reasoning over Long-Term Egocentric Video Memories

evidence: Abstract: 'Without training or query-time video access, MemLife improves over the strongest training-free baseline by 4.6-12.0% across four long-horizon benchmarks' and MemOpt adds 2.7-5.0%.
Section 3.2: reader action space A = {Rewrite, SearchMemory, FetchMemory, FetchVideo, Answer} defining the agentic tool-calling reader.
Section 3.3 Eqs. (6)-(12): FIRM reward decomposing information loss into memory-writing and recall terms, token-level faithfulness reward, and GRPO-based group-relative optimization.
Section 4.2 Table 1: MemLife 56.50 accuracy vs EgoRAG 49.28 on SuperMemory-VQA; MemLife+MemOpt 60.35; MemLife-V+MemOpt 61.96 on SuperMemory-LVQA.
Section 4.4 Table 3: MemOpt gains transfer across Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B writer/reader pairings.
Appendix C Table 10: controlled comparison with VST, TaskMem, M3-Agent reproduced on the same Qwen3.5-9B backbone and training split; MemLife+MemOpt best on both benchmarks.
Appendix D Table 11: five-run stochastic decoding stability; 'accuracy improvements of MemLife over EgoRAG are significant on all four benchmarks (p<0.05)'.
Appendix E Table 12: MemLife lowest storage (0.68 MB/h) and fastest reading (13.1 s/question on SuperMemory-VQA).
Appendix A: SuperMemory-VQA splits (S1-S6 train, 3,425/723/623 questions), 82 questions excluded for unavailable videos; EgoLife-EQA is 100 questions with 92.1% annotator agreement.
Appendix B Table 9 and Appendix L: full training hyperparameters and exact writer/reader/evaluator prompt templates; no explicit code-release statement found.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper, not pure CV: an LLM-based (Qwen3.5-9B/27B) agentic memory system for long egocentric video with tool-calling reader (Section 3.2 action space), and GRPO-style RL applied only to the memory writer with a decomposed FIRM reward (Section 3.3, Appendix K information-loss derivation). Strong preference fit across Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RAG/memory, and RLHF-alignment themes. Rigor is high: four benchmarks, trained and training-free baselines, matched-backbone controlled comparison (Appendix C Table 10), component and supervision ablations (Section 4.5 Tables 4-6), stability with significance testing (Appendix D, p<0.05), efficiency analysis (Appendix E). Novelty is moderate: memory systems and writer-training baselines exist; the distinctive parts are writer-only RL with token-level faithfulness and retrievability replay, plus the mutual-information decomposition. Evidence is quantitatively rich but self-judged rewards use the same frozen 9B model, and EgoLife-EQA has only 100 questions (Appendix A). Generalizability is well tested across backbones, memory systems, and out-of-domain data (Section 4.4). Reproducibility is aided by full hyperparameters (Table 9) and prompts (Appendix L), but no code-release claim and reliance on partially unavailable data/checkpoints.

primary_link.title: MemLife: Curating and Reasoning over Long-Term Egocentric Video Memories

papers.summary: Long-term egocentric video enables personalized AI assistants to reason about daily life. However, as video histories grow to hundreds of hours spanning months or years, reprocessing raw clips for every query becomes computationally prohibitive. Memory systems offer a scalable alternative by compacting videos into text representations, but often fail on practical benchmarks: either the memory does not preserve key evidence, or the retriever fails to locate relevant entries due to retrieval compe
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文關注長期第一人稱（egocentric）影片的問答問題：當影片累積到數百小時、橫跨數月甚至數年之後，若每次提問都重新處理原始片段，運算成本將高得難以負擔。作者指出既有記憶系統的兩種典型失效模式：寫入記憶時漏掉關鍵證據，或是在檢索空間不斷膨脹下，檢索器無法在競爭中定位到相關條目。為此，團隊提出 MemLife，一套多模態記憶系統，將影片壓縮為以時間與實體為錨點、並以第一人稱敘述的文字情節（episode），再交由時間索引的代理式閱讀器（agentic reader）進行檢索與推理；在不需訓練、也不需在提問時存取原始影片的設定下，於四個長時距基準上比最強的免訓練基線提升 4.6% 至 12.0%。進一步地，作者提出 MemOpt，一套強化學習框架，僅最佳化記憶寫入器，透過名為 FIRM 的獎勵機制同時要求忠實（faithful）、具資訊量（informative）與可檢索（retrievable），並採用權杖層級的群組相對最佳化。MemOpt 在跨影片與問題分布上穩定帶來 2.7% 至 5.0% 的增益，且可遷移到不同寫入器與閱讀器骨幹、其他記憶系統（如 EgoRAG）以及域外的影片與題型。整體而言，搭配 MemOpt 的 MemLife 超越最強先前基線 4.0% 至 17.0%，同時把記憶體積縮減最多約 31 倍，突顯「學習該記住什麼」是長期影片問答中有效且可泛化的方向；其限制在於訓練僅涵蓋寫入器，閱讀器的強化學習在分布偏移下仍不穩定。
papers.title: MemLife: Curating and Reasoning over Long-Term Egocentric Video Memories
papers.title_zh: MemLife：長期第一人稱影片記憶的整理與推理

links.title: TRACE: Trajectory Selection for Parallel Scaling of Search Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'On Qwen2.5-14B Base/SFT WebQA pools, TRACE achieves 45.2/49.2% EM, compared with 43.9/48.0% for the strongest Qwen3-32B generative aggregators' and '78.6% average accuracy, exceeding majority voting by 3.1 percentage points'
Section 4.3, Table 3 (Mechanism ablations): removing cross-rollout communication lowers WebQA 45.2→43.9 and long-horizon 78.6→72.7, the largest drop among main ablations; w/o GNN gives 43.7/75.5
Section 4.4, Table 4: post-rollout cost 0.271 H20 GPU-hours for TRACE vs 3.28/32.96/69.93 for SolAgg/SummAgg/AggAgent (12×/122×/258×), with Appendix H giving a stage-level timing breakdown
Appendix C, Table C.1: checkpoint trained at K=16 transfers to other budgets, EM rising 35.2% (K=2) → 45.2% (K=16) → 46.3% (K=32) on WebQA Base pools

Appendix E, Table E.1 and surrounding text: gains over majority voting hold across all six Qwen2.5-7B/14B Base/SFT/RL policies but shrink to 0.7/0.3 points on RL rollouts with 0.87/0.83 mean retrieved-chunk overlap
Appendix A.1: 'Long-horizon accuracy uses the saved Qwen3-32B judgments' — both supervision and evaluation for BrowseComp-Plus/FRAMES/GAIA rely on an LLM judge rather than gold labels

Reproducibility Statement: 'All code, including the implementation, training configurations, and evaluation scripts, is available at https://github.com/Jaasssoooonnnnn/TRACE'; Section 4.1 and Appendix A.4 specify optimizer, learning rate, epochs, batch sizes, losses, and frozen Qwen3-Embedding-8B embeddings
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology: test-time parallel scaling of search agents with a learned, transferable trajectory selector, directly matching high-weight preferences (agents, reasoning/verification, scaling & efficiency, inference serving). Novelty is solid but incremental: it reframes post-rollout consolidation as relational selection (graph message passing over shared evidence across rollouts) rather than voting or generative aggregation, differing from independent verifiers and AggAgent-style LLM aggregation. Rigor is strong: six WebQA rollout policies, three LLM aggregator baselines, comprehensive mechanism and connection-scheme ablations (Table 3, Appendix B), budget sweeps with a fixed checkpoint (Appendix C), and a careful efficiency profile (Table 4, Appendix H). Caveats: long-horizon training and evaluation correctness labels come from saved Qwen3-32B LLM judgments, training pools are filtered to mixed correctness questions, FRAMES uses a 500-question subset and GAIA a 103-question text-only split, and no significance tests or variance estimates are reported. Gains are consistent but modest on RL rollouts, which the authors honestly analyze via chunk-overlap. Reproducibility is good: full code release, explicit losses, hyperparameters, graph construction, and timing protocols. Generalizability is demonstrated across policies, backbones, and budgets within search QA, but only two search settings and no non-search agent domains are tested.

primary_link.title: TRACE: Trajectory Selection for Parallel Scaling of Search Agents

papers.summary: Parallel search may generate a correct answer that final-answer voting fails to select. We formulate this consolidation stage as trajectory selection and introduce TRACE (Trajectory Ranking with Aggregated Cross-Rollout Evidence), a lightweight learned selector that ranks completed trajectories using the search evidence behind their answers. TRACE preserves individual query and evidence occurrences, connects rollouts through shared content or document identity, and propagates information across
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理的是搜尋代理在平行擴展下的「整併」問題：同一道問題取樣 K 條完整搜尋軌跡後，正確答案往往已存在於候選池中，卻在最終答案投票時被漏掉。作者將此階段重新定義為「軌跡選擇」，提出 TRACE（Trajectory Ranking with Aggregated Cross-Rollout Evidence），一個輕量的學習式選擇器。TRACE 建立「保留出現次數」的查詢—證據圖：在單一軌跡內保留每次搜尋與每筆證據的檢索脈絡，跨軌跡則透過共享的文本區塊身分（WebQA）或文件身分（長程瀏覽）建立連結，再以關係特定的 GraphSAGE 傳遞訊息。候選答案僅讀取自身軌跡更新後的狀態，透過 answer-conditioned QFormer 產生選擇分數，直接回傳既有答案，不需額外搜尋或自迴歸生成。訓練只用答案層級的正確性監督，文字嵌入模型與生成軌跡的搜尋策略皆凍結，因此每個搜尋設定只需訓練一個選擇器，即可跨 rollout 策略與代理骨幹遷移。在 K=16 時，於六種 WebQA 策略上皆優於投票；Qwen2.5-14B Base/SFT 池達到 45.2/49.2% EM，勝過最強的 Qwen3-32B 生成式聚合器（43.9/48.0%）。長程 FRAMES、GAIA、BrowseComp-Plus 平均準確率 78.6%，高出多數投票 3.1 個百分點；Base WebQA 上僅用 8 條軌跡即逼近 64 條投票的水準。效率方面，後處理僅需 0.271 H20 GPU 小時，較 SolAgg、SummAgg、AggAgent 快上約 12、122、258 倍。消融顯示跨軌跡共享證據（尤其長程任務）與圖傳遞、答案條件式讀出皆為關鍵。限制在於：方法依賴候選池中已存在正確答案，且於高重複性的 RL 軌跡池上增益明顯縮小；文件身分對應與圖解析品質也會影響效果。整體而言，此工作指出後處理整併可與軌跡生成解耦，並以輕量判別式選擇取代重量級生成式聚合。
papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory Selection for Parallel Scaling of Search Agents
papers.title_zh: TRACE：以軌跡選擇實現搜尋代理的平行擴展

links.title: SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching

evidence: Abstract: 'On ALFWorld and Search-QA, our method achieves the best overall performance among the compared vector-based skill approaches' - claim is scoped to compared vector-based approaches, not all methods.
Appendix B: 'Success is 115/140 (82.14%) on seen tasks and 113/134 (84.33%) on unseen tasks, totaling 228/274 (83.21%)' with average steps 16.59/15.79.
Section 4.2, Table 2: Search-QA micro-averaged EM 39.36 for Ours vs 35.62 for LatentSkill; Table 13 (Appendix C.2) reports 39.94 macro average for Qwen3-8B.
Section 5.1, Table 4: ablations 'w/o codec training 10.00 / 16.42' and 'w/o flow 25.00 / 23.13' seen/unseen vs Ours 82.14/84.33; Table 5 decoder-only SFT Qwen3-8B 41.24 overall vs 83.21.

Section 6.1, Table 8: under 25% injected irrelevant skills, generation beats embedding retrieval by +35.71/+47.01 pp on ALFWorld seen/unseen; generator trains on the contaminated bank while retrieval selects from it at test time.
Section 4.3: 'Figure 3 reports gains of 21.53-43.43 percentage points across GPT, Llama, and Mistral actors'; Table 3 shows consistent gains across Qwen3 4B/8B/32B.
Appendix C.1, Table 12: WebShop Ours 20.00 SR / 55.35 score vs Reflexion 28.80 / 58.10 - one of eight baselines exceeds the method; text admits 'exceeding seven of the eight'.

Appendix F.4, Table 18: training loss falls 32.50% (5.670 to 3.827) from 10k to 30k updates while holdout Chamfer rises 3.14%, justifying the 10k checkpoint; text notes a single run 'does not establish significant overfitting'.
Appendix D: 'All 46 failed episodes exhausted the 50-step budget, and all 46 associated skills decoded successfully'; failure analysis attributes errors to execution, not skill format.

Appendix E: 'the heating case was selected for display after inspecting them' and 'other fixed cases include plateaus and regressions' - acknowledged selection bias in qualitative flow-trajectory diagnostics.

Abstract: 'Our code and training skill libraries are available at https://github.com/lulushang999/SkillFM'; Appendix B gives learning rates, LoRA ranks, batch sizes, checkpoint selection; Appendix H gives full prompt templates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-agent research (high-weight Agents, LLM, and Reasoning matches): learns task-conditioned textual skills via a latent codec plus improved MeanFlow one-step generation, replacing test-time skill retrieval for frozen executors. The generative-skill synthesis angle is a genuinely new combination in the agent skill literature, distinct from retrieval (ExpeL-style) and adapter internalization (LatentSkill, SHINE). Rigor is solid: component ablations (w/o codec 10.00 vs 82.14 seen; w/o flow 25.00), a decoder-only SFT control (41.24 vs 83.21 overall), hyperparameter sweeps, bank-size/quality study, failure analysis, and unusually honest caveats (selected diagnostic trajectory, no causal claims from JVP curves, WebShop loses to Reflexion 20.00 vs 28.80). Weaknesses: headline baselines are imported from other papers under partly different protocols (SkillOS three-run means, WebShop baselines on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), no multi-seed variance, and the 25%-noise comparison structurally favors a generator trained on the contaminated bank over test-time retrieval from it, without a clean-bank retrieval control. Evidence is quantitatively detailed (115/140 and 113/134 counts, per-task breakdowns) but comparability across borrowed baselines limits strength. Good breadth: three domains, cross-family transfer (21.53-43.43 pp over GPT/Llama/Mistral actors), cross-scale 4B-32B. Reproducibility is strong with a public code/skill-library URL and full training recipes plus prompt templates in Appendices B and H.

primary_link.title: SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching

papers.summary: Textual skills provide reusable guidance for large language model agents, but existing approaches often rely on manually curated skill banks or reinforcement learning with indirect and delayed feedback. We introduce SkillFM (Skill Flow Matching), a generative framework that synthesizes task-conditioned textual skills directly without test-time skill retrieval. Our framework combines a codec for encoding and reconstructing textual skills in a continuous latent space with a conditional flow model
papers.summary_zh: 現有 LLM 代理的技能重用多依賴人工整理的技能庫，或以強化學習搭配間接且延遲的回饋，導致技能更新難以評估、技能庫膨脹後檢索易混淆。本文提出 SkillFM（Skill Flow Matching），改以生成方式取代測試時檢索：先訓練一個技能編碼解碼器（codec），把文字技能壓縮成單位球面上的連續潛在向量並可重建為可讀指引；接著凍結 codec，以改良式 MeanFlow 學習一個任務條件式速度場，將技能庫的程序知識內化到生成器中。推論時只需單次流網路評估（NFE=1），從高斯雜訊取樣潛在碼並正規化，再由凍結的解碼器產生文字技能，交給凍結的執行代理使用，全程不做技能庫查找。實驗涵蓋 ALFWorld、Search-QA 與 WebShop：在 ALFWorld 達到 seen 82.14%、unseen 84.33%（整體 83.21%），於 Search-QA 取得 39.36% micro EM，優於 LatentSkill 等向量化技能方法；文字介面也让同一生成器可跨 GPT、Llama、Mistral 等不同凍結執行者轉移，並隨執行者規模增大而穩定提升。在技能庫注入 25% 無關技能時，生成式指引仍勝過嵌入檢索。消融顯示移除 codec 訓練或流推論均大幅衰退，僅微調解碼器亦遠不及完整方法。限制在於：作者指出流場幾何與訓練損失指標並不直接等同解碼技能品質或環境成功率，且失敗分析顯示解碼成功與文字約束正確仍不足以保證可靠執行，物件類別混淆與進度維護失誤仍是主要瓶頸。
papers.title: SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching
papers.title_zh: SkillFM：透過潛在流匹配為 LLM 代理生成技能

links.title: Disentangling Self-Distillation: Measuring and Modeling Acquisition and Retention

evidence: Abstract: 'we train every combination of the three axes, on Qwen2.5-7B and Ministral-3-3B across ordinary and contradictory tasks, totaling 1,200 adaptation runs' (also Table 3a: 2 sources x 5 couplings x 2 KL x 5 tasks x 2 models x 3 lr x 2 seeds = 1200)

Sec 4 Evaluation: 'Significance along one binary axis is assessed, per model and task, with a Wilcoxon signed-rank test over matched pairs: two runs that share learning rate and the other two axes and differ only on the tested one, averaged over seeds.'

Table 5 (Rollout-source axis): median paired difference (teacher - student, pp) on 'contradictory (60)' is +8.0*** for Qwen2.5-7B and +8.3*** for Ministral-3-3B, with retention gaps of -0.0 and -0.9***

Sec 6.2: 'on Qwen a moving teacher beats the frozen one at every rate up to 0.10, for a median retention cost below half a point; on Ministral the gain peaks earlier, at 0.05, and turns into a loss at 0.25'

Sec 6.3: 'Most self-distillation families end above that front (17 of 20 on Qwen, 14 of 20 on Ministral, Tab. 9)' and 'SFT keeps that lead, at 3 to 21 points of retention, everywhere except Qwen on tool-alpaca and chemistry'

Sec 7 Conclusion (limitations): 'Our experiments cover five tasks, two model families and two seeds per configuration, with one form of context, a reference response. Other contexts, and lambda, kappa and rho_phi measured on the LLMs, are open.'

Reproducibility statement: 'The code, produced datasets, and results are shared through an GitHub repository. This includes the new datasets produced in the work (math-contradiction, spatial, spatial-contradiction), for which the size, templates, examples and generation process are available in Apps. B and C.'

App B.2: math-contradiction construction uses SymPy checks ('We discard an example if this computed answer matches the converted reference answer') and 'GPT-5 mini separately audits the full solution for arithmetic, algebraic, and base-semantic consistency', retaining 5,772 of 6,325 audited examples

App F.2.1: controlled-model coupling sweep quantifies the peak: 'Moving from a frozen teacher to the sample-mean acquisition optimum alpha=0.0025 raises acquisition from 24.05 to 28.83 points and teacher utility from 0.755 to 0.830, while retention loss increases from 24.25 to 28.71 points'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper (self-distillation vs SFT for adapting Qwen2.5-7B and Ministral-3-3B), squarely matching the Large Language Models and Training & Optimization preferences; not a domain application. Novelty lies in a unifying three-axis taxonomy (rollout source, teacher coupling, KL direction), a fully crossed 1,200-run empirical grid, and a controlled finite autoregressive model explaining acquisition-retention trade-offs, resolving conflicting prior conclusions. Rigor is strong: matched-pair Wilcoxon tests with Holm correction, an SFT baseline over a wider LR grid, programmatic dataset verification (SymPy checks, GPT-5-mini audits), and a well-specified controlled model with 96 seeds, cross-fitted coupling selection, and structural checks. Evidence is quantitative and hedged (e.g., teacher rollouts add ~+8pp on contradictory tasks with near-zero retention cost; coupling peak is task/model dependent; 17/20 and 14/20 self-distillation settings dominate the SFT Pareto front), though effect sizes for KL direction are small and only two seeds per configuration. Generalizability is decent but explicitly scoped: two model families, five tasks, one privileged-context form, instruction-tuned models only. Reproducibility is high with claimed code, datasets, and all run results in a GitHub repository plus detailed appendices, though the link is a placeholder in the text.

primary_link.title: Disentangling Self-Distillation: Measuring and Modeling Acquisition and Retention

papers.summary: Self-distillation with privileged context adapts a language model from demonstrations by letting the model, once conditioned on a reference response, teach its context-free copy token by token. Our taxonomy reveals existing methods differ along three entangled axes: (i) the rollout source (student or teacher), (ii) the teacher coupling (frozen, or an exponential moving average of the student at some coupling rate) and (iii) the KL direction (reverse or forward), yet these axes are usually studie
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對「具特權脈絡的自蒸餾」提出統一框架。作者指出既有方法其實只在三條軸線上分歧：回應 rollout 來源（學生或教師）、教師耦合方式（凍結或以指數移動平均 EMA 追隨學生），以及 KL 方向（反向或正向），但文獻往往只固定其中一軸，導致結論互相衝突。研究將所有自蒸餾法與傳統 SFT 化為同一目標函數，在 Qwen2.5-7B 與 Ministral-3-3B 上，橫跨一般任務與矛盾任務（如九進位數學、旋轉方位），完整交叉三軸共 20 種設定、1,200 次訓練。主要發現有三：rollout 來源主要在任務與預訓練行為相牴觸時才顯著，教師 rollout 能大幅提升獲取且幾乎不損保留；教師耦合在每個任務上影響最大，獲取隨耦合率上升、超過任務特定速率後下降，因此「凍結較好」與「移動較好」其實是同一條曲線的兩端；KL 方向的保留代價則取決於模型，在 Qwen 上正向 KL 較耗保留，在 Ministral 上則否。作者另建構一個小型受控自迴歸模型重現上述趨勢，並將其連到初始策略信心、脈絡強度與特徵重疊三個因子。限制在於僅涵蓋五個任務、兩種模型家族、每組兩個隨機種子，且只測試單一脈絡形式；與 SFT 相比，自蒸餾多半贏在獲取與保留的權衡，而非單一獲取指標。此研究價值在於提供一致的評估地圖，說明該先調哪一軸取決於任務與模型。
papers.title: Disentangling Self-Distillation: Measuring and Modeling Acquisition and Retention
papers.title_zh: 拆解自蒸餾：量測與建模獲取與保留

links.title: DoGBench: Can Agents Meet Expert Standards for User-Facing Documentation?

evidence: Abstract: 'The benchmark contains 292 items from open source projects... The highest-scoring agent reached 47.3 out of 100 on the 117-item held-out split' with failure rates (45.5% task-completion gaps, 36.6% technical inaccuracies) from a 1,267-patch audit.

Section 4.4 (Human validation): 'mean priority-weighted recall against maintainer criteria is 0.892' and 'the scoring model agrees with the post-adjudication human reference on 310 criteria (93.9%)'; the paper notes this is 'not blinded agreement between two humans'.

Section 3.2 (Contamination controls): 'agents work in fresh Docker containers with identity-masked repositories and no network access'; earlier pilot found '31% of runs retrieved the source pull request despite identity masking'.

Section 6.3 (Ablations): source-event-date ablation reports 'every repository-clustered interval includes zero, so the comparison provides no statistically conclusive evidence of a cutoff effect'; documentation-scale ablation CI [−2.81, +0.69] includes zero.

Section 9.3 (Limitations): 'Some abstention labels... rely only on the absence of a related documentation change within a 90-day audit window', acknowledging asymmetric label noise; Section 9.4 admits single-run evaluation with no pass@k or run-to-run variance.

Appendix B.2: generated rubrics cover '90.9% of 242 maintainer-validated criteria', pooled Spearman 0.755 and Krippendorff alpha 0.805 between generated and maintainer rubric scores; Section 8.4 concedes scaffolding interventions were 'explored informally but did not systematically compare' against a baseline.
Section 9 Disclosure: 'Two authors are affiliated with Promptless, a company that builds documentation agents' — a disclosed potential conflict of interest.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed agentic benchmark paper squarely in high-weight preference areas: coding agents, tool use, LLM evaluation, and software documentation. Novelty is solid—the abstention/patch decision and user-facing documentation focus are claimed as firsts and are differentiated from code-facing doc benchmarks (CoDocBench, CodeWikiBench, SWD-Bench)—though rubric-based LLM-judge scoring of open-ended edits is an established pattern (RubricBench, Mei et al.). Rigor is strong: maintainer validation of rubrics (0.892 priority-weighted recall on 21 items; 93.9% scorer agreement on 330 criteria), contamination controls (sealed Docker, identity masking, cutoff and footprint ablations), and an unusually candid limitations section (single-run design, asymmetric abstention labels from a 90-day window, LLM-judge dependence, disclosed vendor affiliation). Evidence is quantitative with clustered bootstrap CIs and a 1,267-submission failure audit, but validation subsets are small, the P0 60-point cap is policy rather than estimated, and mechanistic explanations (coarse rewards, stopping rules) are speculative links to prior work. Generalizability is decent across OSS ecosystems but limited to English docs and incremental maintenance. Reproducibility is aided by released harness/dev split and a public site, yet private held-out rubrics and proprietary judge models constrain exact replication.

primary_link.title: DoGBench: Can Agents Meet Expert Standards for User-Facing Documentation?

papers.summary: We introduce DoGBENCH (Documentation Generation Benchmark), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for generating and maintaining real user-facing software documentation. It asks whether an agent can produce documentation that experienced technical writers would accept in review. The benchmark contains 292 items from open source projects, including Helm, PostHog, and Mautic. Each item gives the agent a pre-change repository and a trigger, such as a code pull request or a reported documentation ga
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出 DoGBench，號稱首個針對「真實使用者導向軟體說明文件」之撰寫與維護所設計的基準。問題在於：既有文件基準多聚焦程式導向的 docstring、程式碼摘要或內部開發文件，且都假設人類已判定文件需要更新，從未檢驗代理是否能判斷「何時不該改文件」。DoGBench 收錄 292 個開源項目（含 Helm、PostHog、Mautic），每項提供變更前的儲存庫與觸發事件（程式碼 pull request 或使用者回報的文件缺口）；205 項需產出修補，87 項正確行為是拒絕修改，且僅有一次機會。評分採與維護者驗證過的工作專屬 rubric，涵蓋準確性、完整性、讀者指引、放置位置與儲存庫慣例，並以 P0 缺陷設 60 分上限，複合分數結合修補品質與正確棄權。實測七個代理，117 項保留集最高僅 47.3 分。另審查 1,267 份修補，最常見缺陷為任務完成缺口（45.5%）、技術不準確（36.6%）與概念或參考覆蓋不全（32.5%）；軌跡分析指出三大成因：只描述介面卻未檢視讀者如何使用（36.0%）、未查證決定性證據而以看似合理的假設填空（33.1%）、找到第一個看似合理的文件表面就停止而遺漏其他受影響頁面（30.1%）。限制包括單次執行、無網路、棄權標籤證據較弱、低資訊密度文字可能被低估。其意義在於顯示前沿模型搭配前沿 harness 仍難以一次產出專家級使用者文件，並公開評測框架供後續研究。
papers.title: DoGBench: Can Agents Meet Expert Standards for User-Facing Documentation?
papers.title_zh: DoGBench：代理能否達到使用者導向說明文件的專家標準？

links.title: Stress-Testing LLM Lie Detectors: Role-Play Failures and Spurious Correlations

evidence: Abstract: introduces dataset of 8,916 human-reviewed on-policy responses from three LLMs with 15 anti-factual personas; evaluates eight prior probes; proposes a linear probe achieving strongest overall performance
Section 3.3: shared-persona prefill (SPP) places both truthful and anti-factual responses under the same persona system prompt to remove the system-prompt-as-label confounder

Section 6, Table 2 (Llama 3.3 70B): Goldowsky-Dill RepE drops 0.862 to 0.438 and Cooney DYL 0.901 to 0.328 under SPP; all prior probes fall below chance on the compliance confounder; proposed probe reaches 0.980/0.976 on-policy/SPP and 1.000 on all three confounder tests
Appendix F, Tables 11-12: failures replicate on Gemma 3 27B and Gemma 4 31B, e.g. Zou RepE 0.982 to 0.201 and Cooney DYL 1.000 to 0.171 under prefill

Appendix G, Table 14: ablation shows EOT extraction and chat-template adaptation improve the Marks/Bürger baseline (0.628 to 0.899) and forced-opposite training yields 0.981/0.975, with the Cities & Translation-only variant matching the full probe
Appendix H, Table 15: assistant-prefill control raises mean AUROC from 0.676 (SPP) to 0.798, showing SPP failure is not generic off-policy sensitivity
Appendix D.1 and D.3: log-likelihood verification (honest mean -1.68 vs lie -3.35 on personas; perfect reversal on likelihood test set) validates confounder construction
Section 7: acknowledged limitations include single-turn system-prompt personas, models limited to at most 70B parameters, and likely unidentified additional confounders

AI use statement and Section 3.2: dataset built via agentic pipeline (Claude Opus 4.8) from human seeds with Llama 3.3 70B judge filtering and first-author manual verification; code at GitHub and dataset at HuggingFace, but no inter-annotator statistics or confidence intervals reported
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic LLM safety/interpretability work: probes internal activations of Llama 3.3 70B, Gemma 3 27B, and Gemma 4 31B for lie detection under role-play, directly matching LLM, AI safety, alignment, and interpretability preferences. Core contributions are real: an 8,916-sample human-reviewed on-policy anti-factual persona dataset (Section 3), a shared-persona prefill control that removes the system-prompt shortcut (Section 3.3), three confounder tests (Section 4), and evaluation of eight replicated prior probes (Section 5.2). Evidence is quantitative and replicated across three models, with useful controls: likelihood verification (Appendix D.1/D.3), layer-selection controls (Appendix B.2), assistant-prefill ablation ruling out generic off-policy sensitivity (Appendix H), and a component ablation showing forced-opposite training drives robustness (Appendix G, Table 14). Key weaknesses temper the score: the proposed probe is trained to defeat exactly the tested confounders, making its perfect 1.000 confounder scores partly by construction (acknowledged in Section 6); human review is single-annotator; no error bars or significance tests; findings limited to single-turn, English, binary-answer settings and models ≤70B (Section 7); two model families only. Novelty is solid but builds on Liars' Bench, Schouten et al., and Sturgeon et al., with the on-policy dataset being the clearest new asset. Code and dataset release plus detailed judge prompts support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Stress-Testing LLM Lie Detectors: Role-Play Failures and Spurious Correlations

papers.summary: Lie detection probes aim to predict from a language model's internal states whether its output is truthful or dishonest. However, role-play complicates what "truth" means for an LLM: language models can adopt a wide range of personas that take very different claims to be true, including personas whose beliefs clearly contradict reality, such as a conspiracy theorist. In this work, we investigate whether lie detection probes reliably flag falsehoods generated under such an anti-factual persona or
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文檢驗大型語言模型（LLM）的測謊探針是否可靠。所謂測謊探針，是從模型內部活化狀態預測其輸出是否誠實的線性分類器。作者指出，「角色扮演」讓「真」的定義變得曖昧：模型能模擬各種人設，包括相信與現實明顯牴觸的主張者（例如陰謀論者）。他們提出核心問題：當 LLM 扮演反事實人設時，測謊探針會依預設助理人設的信念來標記虛假陳述，還是改為追隨當前人設的信念？為此，作者建構了含 8,916 筆人工審核、on-policy 生成回應的資料集，涵蓋三個 LLM 與 15 種反事實人設，並設計「共享人設前綴」（SPP）設定，讓誠實與虛假回應都置於同一反事實人設系統提示之下，以避免探針單靠系統提示就能分辨標籤。結果顯示，八個既有探針在此設定下多半失效，SPP 下部分探針甚至低於隨機水準。作者進一步建構三個混淆因子資料集，使真值分別與可能性、人設信念、指令遵循呈反相關，發現既有探針普遍強烈追蹤這些在訓練資料中與真值虛假相關的概念，尤其所有既有探針在遵循度測試上皆低於隨機。最後，作者提出一個以基礎事實題加上「強制相反答案」訓練的簡單線性探針，在三項混淆測試與人設壓力測試上皆達最強表現。限制包括僅研究單輪對話、模型規模上限約 700 億參數，且可能仍有未被識別的混淆因子。此研究凸顯現行測謊探針離可靠仍遠，並指出訓練資料須讓真值與混淆概念去相關。
papers.title: Stress-Testing LLM Lie Detectors: Role-Play Failures and Spurious Correlations
papers.title_zh: 壓力測試 LLM 測謊器：角色扮演失效與虛假相關

links.title: Consensus and Factual Dynamics in Large Populations of Interacting Language Models

evidence: Section 3.1-3.2: Rheon models each agent response as an O(n) semantic spin plus a binary factual spin; Eraclitus-4.7M is generated from 432 configurations (6 prompts x 12 sizes x 6 temperatures) across a 1D ring/2D torus/3D torus/mean-field ladder, totalling 4,767,840 LLM calls with Qwen3-14B (4-bit) as the frozen backbone.

Appendix C, Table 8: the LLM-as-a-judge (Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct) is validated against two blind human annotators on 1,063 stratified responses; pooled kappa=0.760/0.791 and 98.58% raw agreement on Prompts 2-6, while Prompt 1 shows systematic label inversion (34% agreement, kappa=0.025), leading to its principled exclusion.

Section 4.1 / Figure 4: the hallucination-minimising temperature depends on coupling — 2D at N_a=256 repairs at T=0.1 (Delta rho=-0.98) and 3D at N_a=216 (-1.00), whereas mean-field repairs best at T*~1.0 (-0.81) with near-zero repair at cold settings (-0.20 at T=0.1).

Table 2 / Section 5 Insight 4: Pearson correlation between semantic cohesion and factual accuracy rises from mean +0.09 (t=0) to +0.15 (t=10) with a maximum of +0.36 and several non-significant configurations, supporting the claim that unanimity never certifies correctness.

Appendix E, Tables 9-10: the geometry ladder 1D<2D<3D<MF in final cohesion holds under all four sentence encoders (MF c_bar ~0.92 in every case), and per-configuration cohesion rankings are encoder-invariant (Spearman 0.899-0.962).

Section 5 'Scope and limitations': homogeneous population (one frozen model, one prompt per run, no personas or adversaries) on regular geometries within a ten-sweep horizon; Appendix A.6 specifies a 2,160-file Parquet layout (~39 GB) with full row schema, while Section 6 states code and corpus 'will be made publicly available', i.e., release is promised not verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope LLM research: multi-agent populations of interacting LLMs, consensus/hallucination dynamics, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. The physics-inspired Rheon framework (O(n) semantic spins + Ising factual spins, Glauber dynamics, geometry ladder, temperature as thermal disorder) is a genuinely novel analytical lens on agent consensus, backed by a large 4.7M-response released corpus. Rigor is strong: fixed 100-token outputs, top_p=1 so temperature is the only noise channel, embedding whitening, finite-size-floor-corrected cohesion, 5 independent trials, human validation of the judge including transparent documentation of its Prompt-1 label inversion, and 4-encoder robustness checks. Evidence is broad but partially thin: pivotal temperature-geometry interaction claims (e.g., cold optimum only under local coupling with large populations) rest mainly on one prompt and R=5 trials with very large dispersion (rho=0.50±0.58 in MF), and cohesion-accuracy correlations are weak (max r=+0.36, many non-significant). Generalizability is limited by a single frozen Qwen3-14B backbone, six FreshQA prompts, homogeneous agents, and a 10-sweep horizon, all acknowledged by the authors. Reproducibility is high on paper (seeds derived from configuration, full schema, judge template, Algorithm 1, ~39 GB artifact) but release is promised rather than confirmed.

primary_link.title: Consensus and Factual Dynamics in Large Populations of Interacting Language Models

papers.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as populations of interacting entities, in which consensus --agreement on a shared answer-- emerges as a collective, unengineered behaviour. Prior work on LLM consensus shows that agents can cross-verify their answers and converge towards more factual responses, treating agreement as a proxy for correctness. However, these studies usually fix a single interaction structure, leaving open how consensus depends on how agents interact. We a
papers.summary_zh:
這篇論文關切的問題是：當大量由同一個凍結語言模型複製出來的代理人互相讀取彼此答案、反覆改寫時，族群會不會收斂出共同答案，而這個共識究竟是對的還是錯的。作者指出，過去關於 LLM 共識的研究多半固定單一的互動結構，因此無法回答「共識如何取決於代理人之間的連接方式」。

方法上，作者提出 Rheon 框架，把族群重鑄為一個演化中的 O(n) 自旋系統：每個代理人的回應被拆成兩個耦合自旋——語意自旋是文本嵌入經白化與單位正規化後的向量，記錄「說了什麼」；事實自旋則是二元 Ising 變數，記錄「是否正確」。互動幾何構成一條「維度階梯」，從 1D 環、2D 環面、3D 環面到全耦合的平均場圖，取樣溫度 T 扮演熱擾動來源，並以類 Glauber 的非同步動力學演化。

作者橫掃 432 種配置（六個提示、十二種族群規模、六個溫度），每個配置跑五次獨立試驗，共約 477 萬筆回應，並以 LLM-as-a-judge 標註事實性，釋出為 Eraclitus-4.7M 語料。

主要發現有四：共識幾乎是普遍結果，且在最初幾次更新中就大致底定，連通度越高收斂越快越完整；但事實結局無法由初始狀態預測，少數正確者有機會扭轉幻覺多數，顯示其動力學並非對稱的投票者模型；取樣溫度對事實結果是真實的控制變數但非單調，最冷的近貪婪設定並非一律最安全，最佳溫度取決於耦合方式（區域耦合偏好低溫、全域耦合則需要中間溫度）；語意凝聚與事實準確度呈正相關，互動會強化此關聯，但相關係數最高僅約 +0.36，無法保證共識即正確。

限制方面，族群是同質的（單一凍結主幹、每次執行單一提示、無角色設定），且結論僅在十次更新的視窗內成立；事實軸依賴自動標註，在帶假前提的提示上雜訊最大，其中 Prompt 1 的標註甚至被系統性反轉，因此被排除於整體分析之外。

這項工作的意義在於：它把多代理人 LLM 系統的共識視為可觀測的宏觀湧現性質，提供順序參數與溫度控制等統計物理工具，並提醒實務部署不應以「一致性」當作正確性的代理指標，且溫度必須與互動拓樸匹配。
papers.title: Consensus and Factual Dynamics in Large Populations of Interacting Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型交互語言模型族群中的共識與事實動態

links.title: Trust the Critic More

evidence: Abstract: 'AC2 exceeds GRPO's peak validation score of 18.5% using 2.5× fewer decoding FLOPs'
Section 4.1: 'AC2 first exceeds GRPO's peak mean score of 18.50% at 0.79e20 FLOPs compared to 1.99e20 for GRPO. This is a 2.5× compute efficiency gain over GRPO'
Section 3.1: problem is 'ready' when three conditions hold, including mean critic error below τ_global and a tighter per-problem τ_local
Section 4.4: 'the group-mean value mean_i(v_i) has mean absolute error (MAE) 0.065, compared with 0.211 for the prefix value V_θ^π(s)'; advantage 'Pearson correlation is 0.388'
Section 4.3: 'AC2 w/ 2k chunks peaks at 16.62% at step 100 and falls to 13.57% at step 120'; local-readiness ablation score 'falls from 13.56% at step 30 to 13.10% at step 40'
Appendix A.2: 'Because this configuration changes the continuation length and the prefix-cut spacing together, the comparison does not isolate either change'
Appendix B: 'The per-step Pearson correlation is r=0.874' between decoding FLOPs and GPU hours; mean-based FLOPs estimates fall 4.01-5.51% below exact costs
Appendix A.3: 'AC2 and GRPO plateau at roughly the same score' for best-of-16
Section 6: 'local readiness requires epoching the training data... In the non data constrained setting, this epoching is not realistic'
Section 4: 'We use DeepSeek-V4-Flash to judge proof correctness, scoring each generated proof from 0 to 7'
Section 5: 'to our knowledge AC2 is the first method to date to use λ=0 for LLM RLVR'; components have precedent in Le Critique, BPCO, GenAC, SPO, VinePPO
Footnote: 'Code available at https://github.com/WhenWen/AC2'; Table 4 lists full hyperparameters including τ_global=0.20, τ_local=0.18, chunk length b=10,000
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core on-topic LLM research: a new RLVR algorithm (Actor-Critic with Action Chunking) for training Qwen3-4B on mathematical proof reasoning, directly touching LLM (2.5), Reasoning/CoT (2.5), RL (1.5), Training & Optimization (1.5), and Scaling & Efficiency (1.5) preferences. Novelty is solid but not breakthrough: the paper itself concedes its three ingredients (privileged critic, readiness gating, chunking) each have precedent (Section 5), with the claimed novelty being the first λ=0 GAE advantage estimator that removes terminal-reward dependence in LLM RLVR (Section 5: 'to our knowledge AC2 is the first method to date to use λ=0'). Rigor is strong: tuned GRPO baseline (Appendix A.1), a Prefix GRPO control isolating replay state distribution, careful FLOPs accounting with GPU-hour correlation r=0.874 (Appendix B), and many ablations. Evidence is weakened by single runs with no seeds/error bars, LLM-judge rewards (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Section 4) with no reported judge validation, moderate advantage correlation of 0.388 (Section 4.4), a confounded chunk-size ablation (Appendix A.2 admits it 'does not isolate either change'), and honest reporting that best-of-16 scores plateau equally for AC2 and GRPO (Appendix A.3). Generalizability is limited: one model, one domain (Olympiad proofs), and the authors acknowledge local readiness requires epoching data, which 'is not realistic' in single-epoch regimes (Section 6). Reproducibility is high: code URL, full hyperparameter table (Table 4), verbatim critic prompts, and exact FLOPs formulas.

primary_link.title: Trust the Critic More

papers.summary: Standard language model RL algorithms credit every token of a long rollout with the same advantage determined by the terminal reward. Actor-critic methods can provide finer-grained credit assignment, but learned critics are generally considered too inaccurate to trust when training LLMs with RL. In recent works, even when a critic is present, it is used only for baseline estimation, so every trajectory must be rolled out to its terminal reward. We introduce Actor-Critic with Action Chunking (AC2
papers.summary_zh: 標準的語言模型強化學習（如 GRPO）把整條 rollout 視為單一動作，所有 token 共用同一個由終端獎勵決定的優勢值，信用分配相當粗糙：一個結尾的小計算錯誤就可能懲罰整條正確推理。演員—評論家方法理論上能提供更細緻的信用分配，但學得的評論家（critic）通常被認為太不準確，因此既有作法最多只把它當作 baseline，仍須把每條軌跡 rollout 到終端獎勵。本文提出 Actor-Critic with Action Chunking（AC2），改以「動作分塊」為信用單位：從回放緩衝區中的前綴切出起點，只生成約一萬個 token 的短續寫，再由評論家對分塊末端狀態評分，因而在更新時完全不需觀察終端獎勵。作者用三項設計讓評論家式信用分配變得可靠：一是「局部就緒度」，只有在評論家在該題目上足夠準確時才採用評論家式更新；二是在有參考解答時把正確解法放進評論家提示中；三是以一萬 token（而非單一 token）為分塊單位。實驗在 FineProofs-RL 上訓練 Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507，於 IMO-ProofBench 評估。AC2 以約 2.5 倍更少的解碼 FLOPs 超越 GRPO 的峰值平均分 18.5%，訓練步數少 25%，且峰值分數更高（20.57% 對 18.5%）；解碼 FLOPs 與 GPU 時數在主實驗中高度相關。消融顯示局部就緒度、提供參考解與一萬 token 分塊皆為必要，縮小分塊至 2k、只保留正確軌跡或移除局部就緒度都會使表現下滑。限制在於局部就緒度需要對訓練資料做多輪 epoch 才能取得「真值」估計，在非資料受限的單輪情境下並不實際，作者將其列為未來工作。

links.title: Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization

evidence: Abstract: SCAPO improves AIME 2024–2026 accuracy over GRPO by 5.63 and 4.17 points on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base; verified against Table 1 (27.71 vs 22.08; 11.88 vs 7.71).

Section 2 / Figure 3 / Appendix C.3 Table 5: d-filtered decoding raises frozen Qwen3-4B-Base accuracy from 15.8% to 30.0% on a 1,000-question DAPO-Math-17K panel (202 incorrect-to-correct vs 60 correct-to-incorrect transitions).

Section 3.2–3.4: Fixed-response teacher-forced probing (Eq. 5–6), group-relative standardized stability (Eq. 7–8), and detached negative-only advantage augmentation Ã = A + λ·sg(u⁻) (Eq. 9) with schedule λ=λ0 for n≤N0 (Eq. 11).

Section 4.3 Table 2: Ablations on Qwen3-1.7B-Base show negative-only semifactual credit (avg 17.65) beats random shuffle (13.65), counterfactual answer-changing perturbations (11.68), all-sign (15.65), and positive-only (14.05).
Section 4.4 / Figure 5: semifactual probing and credit construction account for only 1.8% of measured training runtime in the 4B experiment.
Appendix A Limitations: experiments limited to dense Qwen3 1.7B/4B on DAPO-Math-17K; larger scales, MoE/hybrid architectures, and broader domains remain untested.

Reproducibility Statement + Appendix E (Table 6, Table 7, Table 3): code released at github.com/DtYXs/SCAPO on EasyR1, full hyperparameters, generation prompts, and per-benchmark sample counts provided.

Appendix D: Lemma D.1 bounds the auxiliary gradient perturbation by λH with H=RB/2; Theorem D.2 shows the augmentation term in the stationarity bound decays as N0/T after the finite augmentation phase.

Table 8: yearly AIME/AMC/HMMT/NoOp/ThinkBench breakdowns corroborate aggregate claims; SCAPO best on 6/8 in-distribution metrics at 4B (Minerva and OlympiadBench won by FIPO) and 8/8 at 1.7B, matching the abstract's 'most benchmarks' phrasing.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning/RLVR methodology paper, squarely in scope. SCAPO augments GRPO token-level advantages with a detached, negative-only stability signal derived from teacher-forced probability drift under answer-preserving semifactual prompt perturbations; the diagnostic finding that drift-filtered decoding lifts frozen Qwen3-4B-Base from 15.8% to 30.0% without weight updates is a genuinely interesting, novel contribution distinct from span-masking (CF-GRPO) and future-KL (FIPO) credit methods. Rigor is solid: five matched baselines sharing data/reward/protocol, ablations on credit source (random shuffle, counterfactual) and sign, a stochastic-gradient perturbation bound (Appendix D), and an efficiency analysis (1.8% runtime overhead). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent (AIME 27.71 vs 22.08 at 4B; 11.88 vs 7.71 at 1.7B; OOD wins on NoOp/ThinkBench/GPQA at both scales), but drawn from single runs without variance or significance reporting, and the λ0/N0 augmentation schedule risks eval-tuned hyperparameters. Generalizability is limited by the paper's own admission (Appendix A) to dense Qwen3 1.7B/4B on DAPO-Math-17K math domain; GPQA transfer is suggestive but narrow. Reproducibility is strong: full hyperparameters (Table 6), exact perturbation prompts (Table 3), evaluation counts (Table 7), and released code on EasyR1.

primary_link.title: Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet their predictions remain sensitive to task-irrelevant prompt features. We investigate this sensitivity through semifactual prompt interventions that preserve the underlying problem and its answer. Our analysis reveals substantial variation in token-level sensitivity and shows that suppressing high-drift token candidates during decoding improves reasoning accuracy wit
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文關注 RLVR（以可驗證獎勵進行強化學習）下大型語言模型推理的穩健性問題。作者指出，現行主流的 GRPO 會把同一個由最終答案正確與否推導出的優勢值（advantage）平均套用到回應中的每一個 token，因此可能在強化有用推理的同時，一併強化模型對提示中與題目無關特徵的虛假依賴。研究團隊以「半事實提示干預」（semifactual prompt intervention）切入：在不改變數學問題與正確答案的前提下，改寫措辭、加入輕微錯字、套上無關情境或附掛無關內容，再以教師強制（teacher forcing）方式量測固定回應中每個 token 機率的漂移程度，並以有界對稱距離作為敏感度代理指標。診斷結果顯示 token 層級的敏感度高度異質：反思標記與篇章連接詞的漂移分別為整體平均的 2.74 倍與 2.32 倍，而數學符號與數字僅約 0.47 倍與 0.37 倍；在不更新權重的情況下於解碼階段抑制高漂移候選 token，可使 Qwen3-4B-Base 在 1,000 題診斷集上的正確率由 15.8% 提升至 30.0%。據此，作者提出 SCAPO：先在同一個提示群組內對四個擾動的漂移做標準化、平均後再標準化，得到群組相對穩定度分數，僅保留其負值部分並以停止梯度方式加上一個小幅修正項到 GRPO 優勢上，使相對不穩定的 token 獲得較低的優勢，且穩定本身不額外給獎勵。修正僅在訓練前期施加，之後回到標準 GRPO。實驗在 Qwen3-4B-Base 與 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 上訓練 DAPO-Math-17K，SCAPO 於 AIME 2024–2026 分別較 GRPO 提升 5.63 與 4.17 個百分點，在兩個規模的多數數學基準與全部三項分布外基準（NoOp-AIME、ThinkBench-AIME、GPQA-Diamond）上取得最佳成績，且達到 GRPO 最終 AIME 準確率所需的最佳化步數不到一半。消融實驗顯示，以答案改變的反事實擾動取代半事實擾動、或改用全符號與僅正值修正，表現皆較差，支持「對症下藥地降低不穩定 token 的信用」這一設計。效率方面，半事實探測與信用建構僅占 4B 實驗訓練執行時間約 1.8%，因其重複使用已抽樣回應且僅限於前期階段。限制在於訓練僅涵蓋 1.7B 與 4B 稠密模型及數學推理領域，更大規模、更多架構（如 MoE 與混合模型）與其他領域的效益仍待驗證。

papers.title_zh: 半事實反事實信用增強策略最佳化（SCAPO）

links.title: Beyond the Shadows of Plato's Cave: Evaluating False Memory in Autonomous Agents via Counterfactual Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: 'FAME achieves AUROCs of 76.2%-96.7% across false-memory settings, and outperforms the best baseline by 3.4%-23.3% across realistic benchmarks, spanning math reasoning (GSM-Symbolic), code generation (GitChameleon), and complex reasoning (BigBench-Hard)'
Sec. 3.1: structural causal model of belief update with 3-step counterfactual framework (Pearl 2009); Prop. 1 and Thms. 1-3 stated with proofs in App. B.1-B.4

Sec. 5.1: 'We leverage Llama-3B in the experiments. We obtain the hidden states at the 14th layer'; AUROC metric; five baselines including cloud distance, task vector, input similarity, logit confidence
Table 1 (Sec. 5.2): FAME 0.922/0.966/0.869/0.762 across spurious keeping/removal, environment shift, knowledge conflict vs. best baseline 0.782/0.751/0.788/0.652
Fig. 4 (Sec. 5.2): 'overlapping answer confidence distributions between correct and false memory answers' demonstrating answer-only monitoring fails
Table 2 (Sec. 6): realistic benchmarks, FAME best in all six settings, e.g., 0.786/0.790/0.860 (GSM), 0.716 (Git), 0.815/0.861 (BBH)
App. D.2 (Table 3): ablations with 10 random subsamples show removing expectation drops AUROC to 0.445-0.559 and random-direction g_O to 0.464-0.503
App. D.4 (Tables 5-7): FAME outperforms baselines on Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-3B with per-model layer sweeps (16th/14th/36th layers)
App. C.2: readout direction g_O built from J=50/40/20 held-out query pairs per template; ground-truth labels 'used solely for evaluation'
Sec. 7: limitation - 'FAME requires access to agent hidden states and counterfactual queries'; Sec. 6.1: 'we curate and release a suite of templates' (40 GSM, 18 Git, 11 BBH)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic for the curator's preferences: an LLM-agent memory evaluation framework (Agents 2.5x, LLMs 2.5x, Reasoning 2.5x, Interpretability 1.8x, RAG/knowledge-conflict 1.8x) spanning math reasoning, code generation, and complex reasoning benchmarks. FAME formalizes 'false memory' via an SCM, proves counterfactual/concept-drift identifiability (Props/Thms 1-3 with proofs in App. B), and realizes it training-free from residual-stream hidden states with admissible-region boundaries. Novelty is solid though it assembles known ingredients (task/function vectors, ICL-as-concept, Mahalanobis cloud distance, ETT); the answer-free detection of belief failures invisible in answer confidence distributions (Fig. 4) is a genuinely interesting contribution. Rigor is good: controlled taxonomy settings (Sec. 5), realistic benchmarks (Sec. 6, Tab. 2), ablations (App. D.2: random-direction and expectation-swap controls collapse to ~0.45-0.55 AUROC), robustness checks (App. D.3), and cross-LLM generalization (App. D.4, Llama-8B/Mistral-7B/Qwen2.5-3B with layer sweeps). Weaknesses: main experiments use only a 3B model; template pools are small (40/18/11); threshold selection and readout-direction construction rely on curated held-out queries (App. C.2, Eq. 36); white-box hidden-state access limits applicability (acknowledged in Sec. 7); ground truths are author-constructed. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent (Tab. 1 AUROCs 0.762-0.966 match abstract claims), but effect sizes come from modest-scale curated settings. Reproducibility is moderate: counterfactual templates are released, Alg. 1 and hyperparameters are specified, but no explicit code release for the framework itself.

primary_link.title: Beyond the Shadows of Plato's Cave: Evaluating False Memory in Autonomous Agents via Counterfactual Reasoning

papers.summary: Autonomous agents increasingly rely on memory to generalize beyond their training environments. However, agents are bounded by what they have seen and believed, and leveraging such memories in unseen environments can introduce biases into their internal beliefs. We formalize this phenomenon as \textit{false memory}, which can arise from spurious correlations, environment shifts, and knowledge conflicts. Despite its importance, false memory is difficult to evaluate because it stems from agent int
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出「虛假記憶」（false memory）這個問題：自主代理雖靠記憶把訓練環境所學延伸到新情境，但記憶中可能糾纏著誤導性的內在信念，在環境變遷、虛假關聯或知識衝突下反而有害。作者指出，既有做法多半把虛假記憶與一般泛化失敗混為一談，只看可觀測的答案，或以獎勵設計與昂貴的微調來建立評估資料，難以真正觸及內部信念。為此，他們提出 FAME，一個免訓練、免生成答案的框架：透過反事實查詢對查詢做介入，觀察代理在隱藏狀態中所誘發的潛在概念如何漂移，再判斷該漂移是否跨越由記憶所界定的容許區域。理論上，作者以結構因果模型證明反事實的可辨識性，並將概念漂移形式化為 ETT，進一步證明概念漂移與答案偏好之差呈線性投影關係，使評估可在生成答案前完成。實驗涵蓋虛假關聯、環境變遷與知識衝突三類設定，AUROC 介於 76.2% 至 96.7%，在 GSM-Symbolic、GitChameleon 與 BigBench-Hard 等現實基準上較最佳基線高出 3.4% 至 23.3%。研究也發現，答案本身的信心分布幾乎無法區辨虛假記憶，且漂移幅度大不代表虛假記憶，關鍵在於是否跨越邊界。限制在於方法需取得代理隱藏狀態與人工設計的反事實查詢，尚未支援自動生成，未來可朝此方向發展。其貢獻在於把虛假記憶確立為可評估的內在信念現象，並釋出反事實模板。
papers.title: Beyond the Shadows of Plato's Cave: Evaluating False Memory in Autonomous Agents via Counterfactual Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 走出柏拉圖洞穴的陰影：以反事實推理評估自主代理的虛假記憶

links.title: Revisiting On-policy Adversarial Black-Box Distillation: Calibrating Groupwise Reward Geometry for Effective Advantage Construction

evidence: Abstract: proposes GRGC, a two-stage framework (Gaussian groupwise OT calibration + policy-side group power modulation), and states code is available at https://github.com/2018cx/GRGC

Section 3.2/Appendix C, Proposition 1: Jensen's inequality shows the BT critic loss is uniquely minimized at zero within-group student dispersion on fixed-mean slices, diagnosing the critic-to-advantage mismatch
Section 4.1: teachers are API-based GPT-5 and Doubao-Seed-2.0; students are Qwen2.5-Instruct 1.5B/3B and Llama-3.2-Instruct 1B/3B; 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs; group size N=8, lambda_OT=0.01, gamma=1.5
Table 2: on LMSYS with GPT-5 teacher, GRGC reaches 50.19 score / 45.3% win vs GAD 48.44 / 25.1% for Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct
Table 5: ablation isolating CGC and PGM; CGC alone at 1 epoch (47.52) is below GAD (48.44) for Qwen2.5-3B, which the text in Section 4.2 explicitly discusses
Table 8: measured training overhead of 0.11% (Qwen2.5-1.5B) and 0.06% (Qwen2.5-3B) per step
Appendix G.10, Tables 20-21: five-seed judge evaluation with 95% CIs (e.g., GRGC mean 50.19, std 0.03) showing gains exceed judge-sampling variability
Tables 17-19 (Appendix G.7-G.9): rule-based IFEval, Math500 (49.6% vs GAD 44.0%), Minerva Math and Gaokao-MathQA gains provide judge-free corroboration
Appendix J: acknowledges the method inherits GAD's cost, being slower than SeqKD, a real tradeoff
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology work: black-box distillation from frontier API teachers (GPT-5-Chat, Doubao-Seed-2.0) into small open students via GAD-style adversarial critics and GRPO, directly hitting the LLM, RLHF/alignment, and training preferences. The paper contributes a genuine diagnosis (Proposition 1: the Bradley-Terry critic objective, via Jensen's inequality, uniquely favors collapsed within-group student reward dispersion at fixed mean, which harms GRPO advantage construction) and a two-part fix (Gaussian groupwise OT calibration on the critic; signed-power reward modulation before advantage computation). Novelty is moderate: OT regularization and reward shaping are standard tools, the setting is an increment on GAD, and the theory (Jensen, Cauchy-Schwarz, Lipschitz bounds in Appendix C) is elementary though correct and well-integrated. Rigor is strong: component ablations (Table 5), alternatives for both calibration prior (Table 6) and transform (Table 7), hyperparameter sensitivity (Tables 12-13), mechanism diagnostics (Tables 1, 9, 10), honest discussion that CGC alone underperforms GAD at 1 epoch, complexity analysis (Appendix H), and an explicit limitations section (Appendix J). Evidence is broad and consistent: 2 teachers x 4 students x 2 training sets, four eval sets, three judges (Qwen2.5-72B, GPT-OSS-120B, humans), judge-free IFEval/Math500/Minerva/Gaokao results (Tables 17-19), and multi-seed CIs (Tables 20-21). Weaknesses: reliance on LLM-as-judge whose reference is generated by the same judge family (mitigated but not eliminated), students capped at 1-3B, theory offers sufficiency-type guarantees only, and effect sizes on some OOD sets are modest. Reproducibility is good: code link, pseudocode (Appendix E), full hyperparameters and eval prompts, though teachers require paid API access.

primary_link.title: Revisiting On-policy Adversarial Black-Box Distillation: Calibrating Groupwise Reward Geometry for Effective Advantage Construction

papers.summary: Black-box distillation is a practical route for transferring capabilities from API-accessible large language models that expose only text outputs into smaller student models. Recent on-policy adversarial methods such as GAD improve over SeqKD by forming an adversarial loop between a critic and a student, where the critic provides rewards for GRPO-based student policy optimization over the student's sampled responses. However, GRPO computes advantages from the within-group relative rewards of stu
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對同策略對抗式黑箱蒸餾中的「批評者到優勢」介面錯配提出診斷與修正。黑箱蒸餾只能取得教師模型的文字輸出，GAD 等方法以批評者線上提供獎勵，供 GRPO 對學生自身取樣的回應群組做策略最佳化。然而批評者的 Bradley–Terry 目標只在區分教師與學生回應，作者證明在固定群組均值下，該目標嚴格偏好組內零離散度，因此獎勵群組容易塌縮、邊際脆弱，使分組優勢訊號不穩定。為此提出 GRGC 兩階段框架：批評者端以高斯分群最佳傳輸校準，將排序後獎勵對齊群組中心化的高斯分位數，帶來非塌縮的尺度與平滑的排序間距；策略端再以群組冪次轉換重塑獎勵，在保持批評者排序的前提下放大可用的組內邊際。理論上並連結優勢差距與分組 softmax 代理模型的一步策略分離，以及優勢誤差對裁剪式 GRPO 代理目標的有界擾動。實驗涵蓋 GPT-5 與 Doubao-Seed-2.0 兩位教師、Qwen2.5 與 Llama-3.2 多種學生規模、LMSYS 與 Dolly 訓練集，於分布內外基準、GPT-OSS 評審與人類偏好評估上皆優於 SeqKD 與 GAD，且額外開銷低於 0.11%。限制在於方法仍建立於 GAD 之上，需依賴對抗式批評者與同策略 rollout，絕對訓練成本高於純監督式基線。

links.title: Learning Functional Subspaces for Neural Network Compression

evidence: Abstract: 'At −70% compression, LSP brings Llama-2-7B to 10.9 WikiText-2 perplexity and 42.2% mean zero-shot accuracy, versus 13.3 and 36.0% for the strongest baseline'
Table 1 / Section 3.1: one of the two LSP variants attains the lowest perplexity in all 12 model–ratio settings, with the margin growing with compression ratio
Section 2.1: learnable orthogonal projector P = I − UU^T optimized end-to-end with frozen weights using unconstrained V with fused QR orthonormalization

Appendix A.7 (Limitations): 'the measured-KL allocation is a local surrogate... no global-optimality guarantee'; Appendix B quantifies joint KL exceeding summed isolated costs by 2.1–4.3× on Llama-2-7B and 1.5–14× on ViT
Table 6 (Appendix B): three-seed mean ± standard deviation for all main LSP results, e.g. Llama-2-7B −70% LSP 10.94 ± 0.12 perplexity

Section 3.2 / Table 3: matched-size single (CIFAR-100 only) vs diverse calibration pools isolate calibration-shift robustness; LSP shows largest transfer gain (+6.6 to +7.1 points) from pool composition

Section 3.3 / Table 5: measured CUDA-graph decode throughput on GH200 (LSP 221 tok/s vs 191 for SVD-LLM at −70%); Appendix E notes latent-cache memory and context capacity are analytic estimates from factor widths

Appendix B: exhaustive hyperparameters, baseline tuning sweeps, identical calibration budgets across methods, held-out validation selection; however, no public code release for LSP itself is stated in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological paper on low-rank compression of pretrained transformers (LSP) that learns which weight subspace to remove end-to-end against a global objective (KL distillation or task loss) with frozen weights. It squarely targets LLM efficiency (Llama-2-7B, Qwen3-4B, OPT) plus a secondary ViT experiment, matching LLM and efficiency-related preferences but not the highest-weight topics (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLM). The core idea—replacing local closed-form subspace selection (activation energy, layer-wise reconstruction, curvature surrogates) with globally learned orthogonal projectors, tied groups, whitened initialization, and measured-KL rank allocation—is a genuine advance, though the paper itself situates it as bringing the known local-to-global shift in structured pruning into low-rank compression, tempering novelty. Rigor is high: a proven proposition, a complete algorithm, ablations of initialization/tying/allocation, three-seed variance, matched calibration budgets, and swept baselines. Evidence is strong with consistent quantitative tables and measured throughput; caveats include analytic (not measured) latent-cache memory figures and domain specialization when calibrating on the WikiText-2 training split. The limitations section candidly admits the allocation surrogate is additive and non-optimal (joint KL exceeds summed isolated costs by 2.1–4.3× on Llama-2-7B). Generalizability is demonstrated across decoder LLMs with different attention routing and a ViT, but is confined to transformer linear layers; no explicit public code release for LSP is stated despite exhaustive implementation detail.

primary_link.title: Learning Functional Subspaces for Neural Network Compression

papers.summary: Modern transformers pair impressive capabilities with substantial memory and compute demands. Low-rank weight factorization reduces both while keeping the matrices dense, and thus efficient on standard hardware. Existing methods, however, choose the subspace to remove from each weight matrix with local closed-form criteria: activation energy, layer-wise reconstruction error, or a quadratic approximation of the loss. These criteria ignore how errors propagate through the network, so at high compr
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出，現有低秩壓縮方法（如 ASVD、SliceGPT、SVD-LLM、Swift-SVD）都以「局部」準則挑選要丟棄的子空間，例如活化能量或逐層重建誤差，忽略誤差如何隨深度累積，因此在高壓縮率下效能崩潰。作者提出「可學習子空間投影」（LSP）：對每個線性層，或共用同一輸入的綁定群組（Q/K/V、gate/up），指派一個正交投影器，所有投影器在凍結預訓練權重的前提下，以全域目標聯合最佳化，預設目標是對稠密模型輸出分布的 KL 散度，亦可改用原訓練損失（LSP_T）。投影器以白化 SVD 截斷初始化，並依每個投影器在模型輸出上造成的 KL 除以節省參數量來分配秩。訓練後投影器合併成標準低秩因子，綁定群組共用一個因子，因此部署模型中不含 LSP 專屬運算，並可在注意力中快取單一窄潛在向量取代完整的 keys 與 values。在 OPT-125M/1.3B、Qwen3-4B、Llama-2-7B 與 ViT-B/16 上，LSP 在 12 個模型—壓縮率設定中取得最低困惑度，且優勢隨壓縮率擴大；在 Llama-2-7B 壓縮 70% 時困惑度為 10.9，優於最強基準的 13.3，而未經學習的初始化為 222.8，零樣本平均準確率 42.2% 對 36.0%。推論端解碼速度最高為稠密模型的 1.56 倍，於 128k 上下文下權重加 KV 快取記憶體減少 13.5 倍。限制在於：以 KL 量測為基礎的秩分配屬區域代理，缺少全域最佳性保證；壓縮本身仍需量測與訓練成本；且唯有 KV 在輸入側綁定時，潛在快取才真正帶來效率收益。此工作的重要性在於把壓縮準則由局部統計量推進到端到端的功能子空間，並兼顧準確率與推論效率。

links.title: EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery

evidence: Abstract: 'raises OpenEvolve's normalized discovery gain from 74.1% to 78.0% with GPT-5.6-Luna and from 61.3% to 82.3% with Gemini-3.8-Flash, whereas Qwen3.5-9B does not benefit'
Section 3.3: gate returns decision g_t in {no-op, look-up, retrieve} based on knowledge state K_t, connecting outer solution loop and inner query loop (Eq. 3)
Section 5.1 / Figure 8(a): 'Across 4,324 retrievals, hypothetical evidence scores correlate strongly with the selected candidates' evaluated scores (Spearman ρ=+0.86)'
Table 1(b): gating ablation — Knowledge Gap 84.5% on Denoising vs Heuristic 60.6% and Random 58.5%; 100.0% vs 99.5% on Erdős
Table 1(d): cross-scaffold ΔNDG — EvoDuet improves OpenEvolve (+23.5%, +84.5%), Top-K (+46.7%, +63.6%), and EvoX (+55.1%, +37.8%) on Sums/Diffs and Denoising
Appendix B.4: inference settings (R=3, J=1, M=5, D=3, temperature 0.7, top-p 0.95, 32,768 output tokens) and per-decision call/web-search budgets
Appendix D.1 Table 4: per-task NDG mean±std and best over four runs for Qwen3.5-9B and GPT-5.6-Luna with and without oracle documents (overall +10.3% / +4.0%)
Appendix D.3 Table 6: inner-loop budget ablations on Denoising — R=3 best at 81.77%, R=5 drops to 34.28%; J=1 best at 81.77%

Section 4 and Appendix F: Qwen3.5-9B 'shows a 14.4% decline at N=1' and algorithm-engineering group NDG declines in four of six settings; limitations section explicitly lists backbone generalization concerns
Appendix E.1: audit of 8,200 iterations from 82 GPT-5.6-Luna runs; 'Direct code copying occurs in 19 GPT-5.6-Luna iterations (0.2%)' and public-artifact reuse documented in Appendix K
Appendix B.5: DeepEvolve comparison 'was not rerun with the same model or search budget'; published scores used on Molecule and Burgers (Table 1(c))
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper: bi-level co-evolution of solutions and web-search queries with frozen LLMs, knowledge-gap retrieval gating, and LLM-predicted evidence scores for evolutionary program discovery. Highly relevant to Agents & Tool Use, RAG/query refinement, LLMs, and code/program synthesis. Novelty is solid but incremental over DeepEvolve (sequential search coupling) and EvoX (meta-loop), with the bi-level gate and hypothetical evidence scoring as the main new mechanisms. Rigor and evidence are strong: 21 paired tasks, 3 backbones, 4 seeds, ablations on gating (Table 1(b)), inner-loop budgets (Table 6), cross-scaffold integration (Table 1(d)), behavior audits, and failure analysis; limitations are candid (Qwen3.5-9B declines, AHC tasks drop). Caveats: some baseline scores (DeepEvolve) use published numbers rather than matched reruns, NDG anchors to SimpleTES-reported bests, and headline means use best-of-four runs in figures. Reproducibility is aided by pseudocode, prompt templates, call budgets, and full program listings in appendices, though no explicit artifact URL beyond a project page link is verified in-text.
topics: LLM agents and web tool use
RAG / retrieval gating and query optimization
evolutionary program search for scientific discovery

primary_link.title: EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery

papers.summary: Evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can stall when progress requires external knowledge the model lacks. Supplying relevant documents helps, but simply adding web search tool can keep returning the same pages as solutions change. We introduce EvoDuet, a bi-level optimization method that co-evolves solutions and search queries with fixed model parameters. At each iteration, a retrieval gate lets the LLM assess its knowledge gap and choose to retrieve new documents, reuse stored
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型驅動的演化式搜尋在需要外部知識時易於停滯；單純加入網頁搜尋工具又常反覆檢索相同頁面。本文提出 EvoDuet，在模型參數固定的前提下，以雙層最佳化共同演化「候選解」與「搜尋查詢」。每輪由知識缺口檢索閘門決定要檢索新文件、重用既有文件，或直接生成；內層迴圈依「假設證據分數」預測各文件可帶來的分數並排序文件、精煉查詢，外層迴圈則平行生成候選並記錄實測結果以供後續檢索參考。在 21 項最佳化任務上，每輪單一候選時，EvoDuet 將 OpenEvolve 的正規化發現增益由 74.1% 提升至 78.0%（GPT-5.6-Luna）、由 61.3% 提升至 82.3%（Gemini-3.8-Flash），Qwen3.5-9B 則未受益；平行生成可再提升。最佳結果在八項任務超越先前最佳分數、三項持平，於 Denoising 以約 6.9 倍較低估計成本勝過 SimpleTES，並可與 Top-K、EvoX 等既有鷹架整合。限制包括：較弱模型常誤用或未用檢索內容、演算法工程任務未穩定改善，以及部分結果依賴公開解答或見解的再利用，且預測有益的檢索仍可能產生更差的候選，須由評估器驗證。

links.title: Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution

evidence: Abstract: claims Qwen3.5-27B TGC 49.6%→63.6% on AppWorld Challenge and GPT-5.4-mini pass^1 72.7%→81.9% on τ²-Bench Telecom, with code at a GitHub URL.
Section 3.1: defines mutually disjoint D_evo, D_val, D_test; states 'It never uses D_test or updates θ' — proper held-out protocol.
Section 4.1: both evolution methods (Meta Harness and ScholarEvolve) use GPT-5.4 through Codex and 'receive the same allocated search rollout budget per setting'; results are mean ± SD over 3 runs.

Section 4.4, Table 2: cumulative ablations removing topic-guided selection, module-wise mutation, then research guidance monotonically decrease TGC/SGC for both backbones (e.g., Qwen 81.4→80.0→78.6→76.8 TGC).
Section 4.4, Table 3: combination outperforms strongest single module (Qwen +3.5 TGC / +12.3 SGC on dev), and standalone rankings do not predict best composition.
Appendix A.3: 95% paired bootstrap interval for Qwen's gain on tasks exceeding the training API maximum is [-0.7, 19.6], crossing zero — honestly reported uncertainty.
Appendix D, Table 7: full disclosure of all 20 paper-derived candidates with standalone deltas and 90% intervals; three sharply negative candidates (e.g., -67.8, -45.6) were measured and excluded.
Appendix A.5: failure taxonomy annotated by an LLM ('Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor via OpenRouter', temperature zero) with a frozen codebook — a moderate evidence limitation.

Appendix A.2, Table 5: lifelong evolution across three reconstructed publication windows improves TGC 69.00→81.55 while Meta Harness fluctuates (69.00→69.64); windows are retrospectively reconstructed from the arXiv index, not a live deployment.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-LLM research: evolving an agent harness (tools, context, skills, memory, workflows) around a fixed LLM backbone, matching Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLMs (2.5), memory/context, and coding-agent preferences; squarely in scope, not a pure domain application. Novelty is a solid but incremental contribution over ADAS/AFlow/DGM/Meta Harness/AgentSquare: the distinctive elements are literature retrieval with topic-modeling-driven orthogonal exploration, module-isolated mutation with crossover, and retrospective lifelong evolution via publication windows. Rigor is strong: formal disjoint evo/val/test splits with frozen-selection protocol (Sec. 3.1), matched search budget vs. Meta Harness, two benchmarks, two backbones, 3-run means with SD, bootstrap retention rule (Eq. 4), cumulative ablations (Table 2), module composition analysis (Table 3), and a detailed failure-taxonomy protocol (Appendix A.5) — though only one automated baseline is compared, validation sets are small (57/74 tasks), and the failure annotation is LLM-performed. Evidence strength is high: headline numbers (49.6→63.6 Challenge TGC; 72.7→81.9 pass^1) match Table 1, candidate-level deltas with 90% intervals are disclosed including sharply negative candidates (Appendix D, Table 7), and a generalization CI crossing zero is honestly reported (Appendix A.3). Generalizability is decent (transfer to unseen Amazon/Gmail apps and beyond training API maxima) but limited to two interactive tool-use benchmarks and dependent on expensive frontier meta-agents (GPT-5.4 via Codex). Reproducibility is supported by a claimed code URL, seeds, serving configs, and module code excerpts, though much depends on proprietary models.

primary_link.title: Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution

papers.summary: Language agents are expected to solve increasingly complex tasks, creating a growing need for continual improvement. One promising approach is to evolve the agent harness, the software that governs tool use, memory management, and task execution, while keeping the underlying language model fixed. Recent methods automate this process by using a meta coding agent to modify the harness based on execution feedback. However, relying on that agent's existing knowledge and observed failures can restric
papers.summary_zh: 語言代理（language agent）日益需要處理複雜任務，持續改進成為關鍵需求。現行做法多以 meta coding agent 依執行回饋修改 agent harness（掌管工具使用、記憶管理與任務執行的軟體），但受限於模型既有知識與已發生的失敗，探索範圍狹窄、設計知識不足且適應被動。本文提出 ScholarEvolve，借鏡人類研究者研讀文獻的習慣，將 harness 演化方向依五個模組（工具介面、脈絡管理、技能、記憶、代理工作流程）組織，先以 auditor 歸因失敗軌跡並抽象出能力缺口，再產生檢索查詢，透過 arXiv 取得論文，並以 TopicGPT 式的提示式主題模型建立機制分類、篩選與模組內輪替選取，確保探索涵蓋不同機制家族。研究者代理讀取全文與官方程式碼後產出 mutation blueprint，由 coding agent 實作單模組變異並通過可執行健康檢查；接著以驗證集上的個別增益做加法預測，挑選模組組合做 crossover 與整體評估，再以 paired bootstrap 下界決定是否保留新冠軍。由於新論文可週期性引入，框架具備主動式終身演化能力。實驗在 AppWorld 與 τ²-Bench 上進行：Qwen3.5-27B 於 AppWorld Challenge 的任務目標完成率由 49.6% 提升至 63.6%，在 Normal 由 69.0% 升至 81.4%；GPT-5.4-mini 於 τ²-Bench Telecom 的 pass@1 由 72.7% 提升至 81.9%。消融顯示主題導引選擇與模組化變異皆有貢獻，模組組合常優於最佳單一模組，且能泛化至未見的 Amazon、Gmail 應用。限制在於殘餘失敗仍集中於需求追蹤與證據覆蓋，失敗分類依賴標註模型，且比較基準與搜尋預算的設定會影響結論；但其以文獻驅動、固定骨幹權重的做法，為代理系統的持續演化提供了可複用且可終身更新的路徑。
papers.title: Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution
