links.title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?

evidence: Section 4.2 / Table 2: Claude-Fable-5.1 reaches overall GDD Fidelity 77.0 with 98.7% verifiable rate; mean fidelity drops from 71.1 (Small) to 51.1 (Big), showing compilability does not imply faithfulness.
Section 4.4 / Table 3: adding dependency context increases playtest violation coverage from 71.1% (398/560) to 80.2% (449/560), with a 95% paired-game bootstrap interval of 6.1-13.0 points.
Section 4.5 / Figure 6: three-axis requirement feedback reaches 74.3 vs 67.0 for self-revision on 50 Big GDDs after two rounds (10.9% relative), from the same initial builds and revision agent.

Section 4.6: contract construction achieves 93% citation overlap across five runs on Big vs 57% for a naive judge; evaluator correlations are 0.72 (source) and 0.85 (replay), with playtest verdict agreement 0.910 (Small) / 0.888 (Big) versus a 0.959 re-run baseline.
Appendix B.5 / Table S10: 8.8-17.7% of rule-score pairs differ by >=0.25 across contract generations, quantifying judge-induced variability.

Appendix J Limitations: benchmark uses 100 synthetic GDDs for 2D single-player Phaser games; generative contract construction 'cannot fully eliminate omissions or evaluator bias'; only three 3D Three.js demonstrations.
Abstract: code and datasets available at https://a2z-gamespec-bench.github.io; Appendix C documents serving (vLLM, B300 GPUs, ~1,100 GPU-hours) and ~900 wall-clock evaluation hours.
Appendix F.1.2 / Table 4(a): dependency weighting changes source-code scores by only 0.38 points on average (max 3.71) at alpha=0.5, with rankings unchanged, honestly reporting a small effect.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark for LLM coding agents on end-to-end game development from long-form GDDs, squarely within scope: agentic coding evaluation (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming) with LLM-as-judge components and nine frontier LLM agents. Core contributions are a frozen Dependency-Aware Contract extracted before build inspection, three evidence axes (source inspection, scenario replay with adaptive frame selection, code-as-policy adaptive/adversarial playtesting) linked to the same requirements, and dependency-weighted scoring. The combination is a solid but somewhat incremental advance over GameGen-Verifier keypoints, WebGrader flow contracts, and DSG-style prerequisite graphs, which the paper itself acknowledges. Rigor is unusually strong for a benchmark paper: 9 agents x 100 GDDs x 3 builds x 3 judgments, contract-stability experiments (>=0.999 graph agreement; 93% vs 57% citation overlap vs naive judge), judge-agency sensitivity tables with costs, axis-omission reversal rates, continuous weight-sensitivity analysis, and bootstrap CIs on the key diagnosis result. Evidence is largely model-judged without human ground truth, and judge score flips of 8.8-17.7% under predicate variation temper confidence, though the paper is transparent about this. Generalizability is limited: 100 synthetic GDDs, 2D Phaser primary setting, only three Three.js demonstrations, and no human-authored specifications. Code/datasets are claimed at the project page with extensive prompts and cost details, but exact reproduction depends on proprietary frontier models.

primary_link.title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?

Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating inte
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出 A2Z GameSpec-Bench，用來評估編碼代理在端到端遊戲開發中，能否忠實落實長篇遊戲設計文件（GDD）。過去以遊戲開發為主題的基準多採用精簡規格，難以檢驗長篇 GDD 中彼此相依的需求；作者觀察到，單靠原始碼審查等單一軸線，會漏掉執行期才浮現的設計違反。方法上，團隊以代理式撰寫流程產出 100 份 GDD（50 份 Small、50 份 Big，平均分別約 14,085 與 26,297 個 token），並將每份 GDD 轉為「相依感知契約」（Dependency-Aware Contract），記錄規則、不變式與前置相依關係；契約在建置前凍結，跨代理與跨修訂輪次保持一致。評估結合三條互補軸線：原始碼靜態審查、情境式重播（以代理生成的 Test Policy 重播固定輸入，並用自適應取幀取得視覺證據），以及以 Code-as-Policy 實作的自適應遊玩測試（含正常遊玩與針對性對抗測試）。主要結果顯示，高可編譯率與可執行率並不代表高 GDD 忠誠度：Claude-Fable-5.1 的可驗證率達 98.7%，整體 GDD Fidelity 僅 77.0；在 100 款 GPT-5.6-Sol 遊戲中，規則本地通過率為 72.4%，但要求所有上游規則也通過時降至 22.7%。加入相依脈絡可將已記錄遊玩測試違規的覆蓋率由 71.1% 提升至 80.2%。在 50 份 Big GDD 上，需求層級回饋經兩輪修訂後，整體 GDD Fidelity 相對自我修訂提升 10.9%。限制在於基準以 Phaser 的 2D 單人遊戲與合成 GDD 為主，僅附三款 Three.js 3D 遊戲示範延伸性；契約建構與證據判讀仍依賴生成式模型，難以完全排除遺漏與評估偏誤。此基準的意義在於把評估從「能不能跑」推進到「是否忠於設計」，並提供可據以修訂的需求層級診斷。
papers.title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?

links.title: Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts

evidence: §1 & Table 1: claims first unified law over N, D, R, S/E; prior looped laws use 'linear; unbounded' or 'power law; unbounded' mappings and concurrent looped-MoE works fix recurrence at R=2.
§3.2 Fig. 2(c): bounded mapping achieves held-out RMSE 0.0092 (R), 0.0128 (N), 0.0049 (D) vs power-law 0.0313/0.0211/0.0073 and linear 0.2566/0.1106/0.0882, fitted on R≤8 and extrapolated to R=16.
§3.3 Fig. 3(c): sparsity-conditional bounded mapping RMSE 0.0100 (held-out R) and 0.0047 (held-out E) vs sparsity-independent bounded 0.0190/0.0075.
Appendix C.4 Table C.3: 100-refit bootstrap 90% CIs — κ1 [0.3658,0.3723], κ2 [1.3896,1.4243], θ [0.3183,0.3350]; joint-optimum configurations identical across refits.

§4.3 Table 2: A0.3B-1.3B LoopMoE at R∈{4,5} matches A0.6B-2.9B MoE on reasoning (BBH 31.5, GSM8K 41.5 vs 29.8, 42.9) but trails Overall (46.7 vs 50.2); test-time recurrence R=1→5 yields +10.3 Overall (36.6→46.9) at up to 1.8× inference compute.
Appendix C.2: 'N_act∈{1.6,2.4}B, expert counts E>16, and recurrences R>8 lie in the extrapolation range of the fitted law' for the 300-candidate joint optimization.

§3.2/§4.1: authors caveat that the asymptote is 'a property of the mapping rather than a guarantee beyond the observed recurrence range' and restrict to standard middle-cycle looping, leaving 'other strategies to future work'.

Appendix C.1 & C.3: full training details (64 H100s, batch 3,072, AdamW betas 0.9/0.95, sigmoid gating, aux-loss-free balancing) and fitted coefficients reported (Table C.2, fit RMSE 0.0037); Table D.1 specifies lm-eval tasks, shots, and metrics; no code or model release is stated.
Appendix B Table B.1: measured expert-path diversity Ψ rises with E and R (e.g., 1.70 at E=8, R=8), empirically motivating the sparsity-conditional mapping.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM architecture/scaling paper with strong preference alignment (MoE, looped/recurrent transformers, scaling laws, pre-training, test-time compute). The contribution — the first scaling law jointly modeling recurrence and sparsity via a bounded, sparsity-conditional effective-parameter mapping that subsumes dense, looped, and MoE laws (Table 1, Props. A.1-A.2) — is a genuine if incremental advance over prior single-axis or fixed-R laws (Parcae, Iso-Depth, SMELT). Rigor is high: a 4-axis sweep (>1000 observations), held-out evaluation on unseen R=16, E=16, N, D showing the bounded mapping beats linear (0.2566→0.0092 RMSE) and power-law (0.0313→0.0092) alternatives, a shared-θ ablation, and 100-refit bootstrap CIs (Table C.3). Evidence is concrete: trillion-token matched-compute validation (Table 2) supports the ~2× reasoning-parameter-efficiency claim (BBH 31.5/GSM8K 41.5 at R=4 vs 29.8/42.9 for the 2× larger MoE) and honestly reports trailing Overall (46.7 vs 50.2) and higher inference compute (1.5×). Deductions: laws fitted at ≤2.4B/500B tokens with extrapolated configs used in the joint optimization (App. C.2 admits R>8, E>16, larger N are outside the fitted range); only one saturating functional form is tested against unbounded alternatives, no other bounded-form ablation; looping strategy fixed to middle-cycle (§4.1 defers others); no code/data release; collapsed bootstrap intervals may overstate confidence under extrapolation.

primary_link.title: Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts

papers.summary: Looped transformers and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) offer complementary routes to efficient scaling: recurrence increases computational depth at fixed parameters, while MoE sparsity expands total capacity at fixed active compute. Yet existing scaling laws model recurrence or sparsity in isolation. In this work, we introduce Loop Scaling Laws, the first scaling law to jointly model recurrence and sparsity alongside model size and data. At its core is a bounded, sparsity-conditional recurrence mappin
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理的問題是：現有縮放定律要嘛只描述迴圈（recurrence），要嘛只描述稀疏性（MoE），兩者無法共同建模。作者提出「Loop Scaling Laws」，首度把模型大小、訓練資料量、迴圈次數 R 與專家數 E 納入單一函數形式。核心是一個有界的、以稀疏度為條件的迴圈對映：每次迴圈所帶來的等效參數增益遞減，總增益收斂到有限上界，而稀疏度（以 active-parameter ratio m 描述，係數設為 κ_j m^{-θ}）會同時抬高並延後這個飽和點。方法上，作者在 N_act、D、E、R 四軸上做大規模訓練掃描，並以分階段非線性擬合估計係數；此定律可還原稠密、稠密迴圈與非迴圈 MoE 等既有定律為特例。主要證據為：在有界對映下，對未見的 R、E、N、D 外推所得 RMSE 明顯低於線性或冪律對映；14 項下游基準顯示稀疏性帶來約 3 倍有效參數效率，迴圈在推理任務上帶來約 2 倍總參數效率；在約 1.5×10^22 FLOPs 的兆級 token 訓練下，A0.3B-1.3B 迴圈 MoE 在多數推理指標上追平大兩倍的非迴圈 MoE，並可透過測試時調整迴圈次數進行 on-demand 算力縮放。限制方面，飽和上界屬於對映的漸近性質而非觀測範圍外的保證，部署記憶體僅計入權重、未含 KV cache 等執行時狀態，且部分最佳化配置落在外推區間。其意義在於把迴圈與稀疏性定位為互補的參數效率縮放軸，並以擬合定律在算力與記憶體預算下給出可操作的架構選擇準則。

links.title: LLM Persona Unlearning

evidence: §3.5: 'NPO reduces ES from 0.219 to 0.042 and EM from 0.979 to 0.800, but TF increases only from 5.3 to 8.5' — diagnostic motivating persona-level (not content-level) unlearning.
§5.2 Table 1: 'PaCE achieves the highest TF in all 12 settings' with honest utility costs (e.g., Llama Sycophantic GU 68.65→65.78; Hallucinating GU 68.65→63.87).
§5.3 Fig. 4a: 'PaCE's TF drops from 99.5 to 75.5 for Sycophantic and from 90.5 to 70.5 for Hallucinating' under PAIR-inspired Attack@5 — candidly reported residual accessibility.
§5.4 Table 2: loss ablation on Gemma-4-12B Sycophantic — Full PaCE TF 59.2 vs 18.3 (erase-only) and 14.9 (anchor-only), supporting the joint objective.
Appendix C.2: persona and quality scores from 'a frozen DeepSeek-V4-Flash judge' (0–4 ordinal levels with null handling); no human or independent-judge validation is reported.

Appendix C Table 5: only 4 of 15 full-parameter settings 'exceed the prespecified gap of 20' (NativeGap diagnostic), with most settings marked 'Fail' — the paper transparently flags weak initial separation in many settings.
Appendix E: PaCE evaluated over a 4×3 grid (λ∈{0.5,1,3,5}, m∈{0,1,2}) = '12 configurations per setting and 180 runs in total'; baselines get ~15 configs each — comparable tuning budgets.
Appendix G: 'the reported operating points use one training seed' and 'independent judges and human assessment would strengthen the analysis' — acknowledged limitations affecting evidence strength.
§F.5: training-loop runtime of 29.6s per 25 updates for PaCE vs 156.1s for NPO on one H200 NVL — efficiency evidence scoped to loop time only.
§F.7: 'Full responses accompany the source archive' but no explicit public code or benchmark release URL is provided anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely within preferred topics: it formulates weight-level persona unlearning for LLMs (Llama/Qwen/Gemma), touching LLM safety (sycophancy, jailbreak elicitation, harmful personas), interpretability (persona-vector directions, causal layer probing), and model editing. Novelty is solid but derivative: the 'erase-and-anchor' objective adapts persona-vector steering (Chen et al. 2025) and single-direction refusal editing (Arditi et al. 2024) into a persistent weight edit, and the paired forget/retain benchmark is the main new artifact. Rigor is above average: six models, five personas, six unlearning baselines with ~15-config grids each, a 180-run PaCE sweep, loss ablations, margin/anchor sensitivity, LoRA scaling to 27B-70B, and honest adversarial/multi-turn/cross-lingual probes that expose residual accessibility (TF falls 99.5→75.5 for Sycophantic under Attack@5). Evidence is weakened by circularity risks: prompts are generated by DeepSeek-V4-Pro and all TF/CP/RQ judgments come from a frozen DeepSeek-V4-Flash LLM judge with no human validation, only 4 of 15 settings pass the prescribed NativeGap diagnostic (Table 5), a single seed (Appendix G admits this), and no significance testing beyond clustered bootstrap CIs in TF-only tests. Generalizability is decent across families, sizes, and languages, but limited to prompt-elicited personas on instruction-tuned models in English. Reproducibility is strong on hyperparameters, algorithm pseudocode, and full judge/data templates, but no explicit public code/data release is stated (only 'full responses accompany the source archive', §F.7).

primary_link.title: LLM Persona Unlearning

papers.summary: Pre-training equips large language models (LLMs) with a broad repertoire of behavioral patterns associated with roles, styles, values, and goals. Post-training teaches conditional enactment and makes a helpful Assistant the default, but it does not erase alternative modes from the weights; explicit prompts can therefore elicit personas that repeatedly shape judgment, language, and action. In open-weight settings, runtime controls can be removed, motivating persona unlearning: a weight-level edit
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出「人格卸除學習」（persona unlearning）這個新問題：大型語言模型在預訓練階段學到大量與角色、風格、價值與目標相關的行為模式，後訓練只是讓「有幫助的 Assistant」成為預設，並未從權重中抹除其他模式，因此明確的提示詞仍可誘發特定人格，持續影響判斷、語氣與行動。在開放權重場景下，執行階段的控制可被移除，作者主張必須在權重層級進行編輯，使指定人格難以被誘發。為此他們建立 PersonaUnlearnBench，涵蓋 Llama、Qwen、Gemma 三個家族共六個模型與五種人格（諂媚、幻覺、無禮、冷漠、邪惡），以同題配對的忘除／保留集、未見指令改寫與四軸評估進行測試，並發現既有卸除方法無法可靠抹除目標人格而不損害生成品質或一般能力。作者接著提出 PaCE（Persona Contrastive Erasure），以同題的目標與理想回應對比找出人格方向，透過因果探測選層，將目標提示狀態推離目標模式並對齊配對回應的正交分量。實驗顯示 PaCE 在多數設定中能一致壓制目標人格並維持回應品質，但仍有可量測的一般能力取捨，且在更強誘發下存在殘餘可存取性。此工作把卸除學習從內容層級推進到行為層級，對模型安全與持久控制具重要意義。

links.title: Values as Style: Disentangling Values from Semantics with One-Way Mixing for Low-Damage LLM Steering

evidence: Abstract: method achieves comparable alignment (0.750 vs 0.748), higher BERTScore (0.938 vs 0.923), and fewer contradictions (5.1% vs 7.6%) against validation-selected prompting on LLaMA-3.1-8B

Section 4.8: matched 2x2 study reports paired improvements of 0.025 [95% CI: 0.011, 0.039] for alignment and 0.015 [0.007, 0.023] for semantic similarity from one-way mixing under fixed inference gating

Section 4.11 / Appendix G.3: dimension-matched controls show Topic-from-zv 0.190 and Value-from-zs 0.210 vs 0.421/0.603 for a random split, with empirical chance 0.102/0.127 and off-diagonal leakage admitted to remain above chance

Appendix G.5-G.6: per-evaluator breakdown (GPT-4o/Kaleido/ValueLlama) for judge dependence and a blinded 320-item human comparison with method-specific Krippendorff's alpha 0.42-0.68, explicitly flagged as meaningful rater disagreement
Appendix A.3: interface training costs 7.4 GPU-hours per backbone with 58M trainable parameters (~0.7% of 8B model)
Appendix C/D: full SVQ generation and human-validation protocols are documented verbatim, but no code or dataset release URL is provided anywhere in the paper
Appendix G.7: transfer to Moral Foundations taxonomy, three-turn dialogues, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-14B (full method Align .756, SemSim .880, FRR .037) supports breadth claims
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work on inference-time value steering via activation editing, strongly matching LLM, AI safety/alignment, and interpretability preferences. The asymmetric one-way semantic-to-value mixing with stop-gradient, adapted from vision disentanglement, is a genuine but incremental design contribution atop established steering (RepE/ActAdd), swap-consistency, GRL, and decorrelation techniques. Rigor is high: matched 2x2 mixing-by-gating factorial, dimension-matched split probes with chance controls, loss ablations, judge calibration, OOD and site sweeps, three-seed reporting. Evidence is credible but leans on LLM stance judges (circularity partially addressed via per-evaluator and non-GPT checks), human inter-rater agreement is only moderate (Krippendorff's alpha 0.42-0.68 on outputs), and gains over the strongest baseline (LinearAdd align 0.770) are framed as trade-off wins rather than absolute alignment wins. Generalizability is supported by two primary backbones plus Mistral/Qwen-14B, Moral Foundations transfer, dialogue, and scaling/noise tests, but scope stays within value steering at <=14B scale with single-site edits. Reproducibility benefits from full hyperparameters and verbatim data/judge prompts, yet no code or dataset release is stated.

primary_link.title: Values as Style: Disentangling Values from Semantics with One-Way Mixing for Low-Damage LLM Steering

papers.summary: Value steering should change an LLM's normative priorities while preserving the scenario, facts, and task constraints underlying its answer. Conventional activation edits often change both. We introduce an editable semantic-value interface on frozen residual states, with a one-way semantic-to-value pathway that grounds value recognition in context. Stop-gradient blocks feedback through this pathway; swap consistency, topic de-confounding, and decorrelation encourage selective codes. At inference
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理一個常被忽略的問題：對大型語言模型做價值引導時，往往連情境、事實與任務限制一起被改掉。作者主張好的價值控制應該只改變規範性優先順序，而保留答案背後的實體、數量、因果與主題。方法上，他們在凍結的殘差串流狀態上建立一個可編輯的「語意—價值介面」，用兩個輕量編碼器分別取出語意碼與價值碼，並設計單向的語意到價值混合路徑，搭配 stop-gradient 阻斷反向回饋，再以交換一致性、主題去混淆與去相關正則化塑造具選擇性的表徵。推論時固定語意碼、只置換價值碼，並把重建差異注入殘差串流；另可選擇將更新投影到語意子空間之外，並以價值相關性分類器決定是否介入。在 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 與 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，此介面在價值對齊相當時提升語意保留、降低良性拒答；與驗證集挑選的提示法相比，對齊為 0.750 對 0.748、BERTScore 為 0.938 對 0.923、矛盾率為 5.1% 對 7.6%。2×2 消融實驗進一步分離「訓練期混合」與「推論期閘控」兩種機制，指出兩者互補；分維度探針也顯示價值與主題的交叉可預測性下降。限制在於：潛在分解並非唯一，殘餘跨因子資訊仍可量測，人類評分者一致性偏中等，且研究主要集中於 7B/8B 規模與短對話。其意義在於把價值控制從單一稠密方向推進到可分解、可選擇性編輯的表徵介面，為降低附帶語意損害提供可操作路徑。

Appendix C: attacker model fixed to z-ai/glm-5.1; R=5, N=12, G=10 (Mode A), G=6 (Mode B), iter=3; several thousand runs per stack

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM red-teaming attack on skill-scanning defenses for agents, matching Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming, and LLM preferences. Novelty is real but incremental over dense prior work (SkillJect, SkillAttack, SkillHarm): the persistent cross-generation attacker memory and the GAN-style co-evolving detector are claimed as firsts (Section 2). Rigor is solid: 5 replicates, 12 attack types, 10/6 generations, blind-vs-informed ablation, disclosed timeout exclusions (Table C.1), and a static-only ablation (Table D.4). Evidence is weakened by a single fixed attacker model (Appendix C), success judged by a verdict LLM sharing the attacker's model that never sees SKILL.md (Table B.2), and no significance testing beyond sample std. Generalizability is limited: only SkillSpector is attacked; commercial scanners are explicitly 'a conjecture rather than a result' (Limitations), and the adaptive detector is a custom layer rather than a deployed defense. Reproducibility is aided by detailed appendices, pinned model versions, SkillSpector commit hash, and stated code/memory release, but no repository URL appears in the text.

papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出，目前用於審查 AI 代理技能（skill）的安全掃描器存在結構性弱點。作者以 NVIDIA 開源的 SkillSpector 為代表目標，該框架結合確定性的靜態規則檢查（regex、AST、taint、YARA 等 64 條規則）與 LLM 語意判官，再以 LLM 後設分析器過濾發現，最後輸出 0 到 100 的風險分數，低於 20 分即視為安全。論文提出白箱攻擊者 Pretext：它完整掌握偵測規則與語意分析提示，透過反覆迭代改寫技能包，把惡意載荷從程式碼搬到自然語言敘述，使靜態分析完全失效；同時把惡意行為包裝成技能宣稱的合法用途，並將指令拆散到多個檔案，讓逐檔審查的語意層無法察覺整體意圖。實驗涵蓋 12 種木馬攻擊類型，使用 glm-5.1 作為攻擊者，對上 glm、qwen3t 與 gpt-oss 三種受害者與偵測器組合。在凍結偵測器的 Mode A 下，攻擊成功率最高達 97%（對 qwen3t 為 96.7%）；在偵測器也會共同演化的 Mode B（GAN 式對抗）下仍可達 77%。作者另外以自我收斂度、可塑性、偵測器涵蓋率與平均反制延遲等指標追蹤雙方共演化動態，發現自適應偵測器之所以降低攻擊成功率，主要來自大量誤判良性技能（部分情境誤判率達 62%），而非真正學會精準辨識惡意意圖，因此安全性提升其實是以代理可用性為代價。限制在於尚未驗證對商業閉源掃描器的遷移效果，作者僅推測其靜態加 LLM 的同構設計可能同樣脆弱。此研究提醒：技能驗證不應只靠安裝前的單層掃描，而需在工具執行、能力限制與沙箱等環節加入多層防禦。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core topic is LLM-based agents and harness/scaffolding design for autonomous ML engineering, directly matching the highest-weighted preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Code). The paper is methodologically careful: budget-, backbone-, and hardware-matched ablations (Sections 4.1-4.4), a defined statistical protocol with paired-by-task bootstrap CIs (Appendix A.5), matched comparisons against four open-source harnesses (Section 5.1, Appendix D), documented baseline-tuning effort (Appendix D.3), and contamination checks (Appendix F). Evidence supports the headline no-worse-than claims (e.g., Table 15: Malena GLM 5.2 self-select medal 62.5% vs AiScientist 47.1%; Table 5 significant medal-rate advantages over manual search), though several percentile comparisons have overlapping CIs and the paper itself concedes limited statistical power (Limitations; Appendix G.1). Novelty is moderate: the 'harness adds little over a strong coding agent' conclusion is anticipated by cited SWE-bench harness-evolution and single-agent-baseline work (Section 1), with the MLE-specific systematic ablation ladder and trace analysis (Section 5.2, Appendix E) being the main new contributions. Generalizability is bounded by reliance on Kaggle-derived MLE-bench, current frontier backbones, and mostly single-worker settings. Reproducibility is good but no explicit code release is stated; HuggingFace identifiers, task lists, fix diffs, and statistical methodology are provided (Reproducibility statement, Appendices A.1-A.5).

primary_link.title: How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?

papers.summary: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made significant progress on public leaderboards. Often motivated by progress stagnation over long-horizon cycles and limited Large Language Model (LLM) primitives, modern MLE agents are deployed on top of increasingly elaborate machinery: multi-agent orchestrators, dedicated retrieval subagents, and more. While such harnesses expand, the use of more primitive but improved coding agents - where LLMs have direct access to the execut
papers.summary_zh:
這篇論文質疑當前自主機器學習工程（MLE）agent 愈疊愈複雜的設計趨勢。過去的 MLE 系統多半把 LLM 包在精心打造的「harness」裡：搜尋樹、程式族群、記憶階層、專職檢索子代理、多代理協作等，理由是單次 chat completion 無法執行程式、檢視資料或對錯誤反應。作者指出，現代 LLM 已具備工具使用能力，可直接在 coding agent 環境（如 OpenCode）中讀寫檔案、執行程式與除錯，因此重新檢驗這些機制是否還有價值。

方法上，作者在同一套程式碼基底中，於固定 LLM 主幹、硬體與時間預算下，逐層拆解四類常見干預：執行環境、搜尋策略（Chain、Greedy、UCB1、Best-of-N）、自主性（單一長 session 的 Malena）與多代理協調（委派、平行、廣播）。主要基準為 MLE-bench 的 30 項任務，另在 NatureBench 的 40 項開放科研任務上驗證。

結果顯示，coding agent 環境是唯一顯著有效的干預；其餘機制在配對統計檢定下皆無顯著增益。Malena 在 GLM 5.2、Kimi K3、DeepSeek V4 等前沿主幹上，皆不遜於甚至超越 MLEvolve、AiScientist、Arbor、ScienceFlow 等開源 SOTA harness；GLM 5.2 下 Malena 奪牌率 62.5%，最佳外部 harness 僅 47.1%。軌跡分析顯示，能力足夠的 coding agent 會自行進行自適應搜尋，兼顧罕見技術與後期效能導向的精修，並重用既有檢查點與工具程式碼。

限制包括：結果高度依賴 MLE-bench（有已知任務準備問題與污染疑慮）、統計檢定力受限、多代理協調僅做小規模消融、以及 Malena 與外部 harness 可能存在調校投入不對稱。作者以 Dolos 程式碼相似度與嵌入相似度兩種方式檢查污染，未發現異常。整體意涵是：對已具備自主工作能力的模型而言，手工 harness 的邊際報酬極低，槓桿在模型與其所獲得的執行環境，而非外圍框架。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-agents work on memory compaction: persistent attention-derived context graph for query-conditioned history selection in coding agents, evaluated on two agentic coding benchmarks with two open backbones. Novelty is solid but incremental over AttnCompress/ContextWeaver/KV-eviction lines: the persistent graph surviving KV-cache expiration, no-model-call selection, and revival of omitted blocks are the differentiators, backed by three motivating attention studies. Rigor is good: seven baselines in three groups, ablations (Table 2), prefix-caching interaction (Fig. 5), black-box proxy attention (Table 3), bootstrap CIs in Appendix B.2, and detailed cost accounting. Weaknesses: headline ~95% latency reduction is an estimate dominated by baseline compaction overhead (ReCAP cold TTFT reduction over Full is only 59.9%/50.8%, §5.3) and ReCAP retains more context than summarization on SWE-Together (15,344 vs 5,239 tokens, Table 1); users are simulated by GPT-5.4 (§5.1); benchmarks are coding-only; no hyperparameter sensitivity analysis; Random outperforming Full on LiC-Qwen (75.2 vs 65.6) suggests noisy benchmark dynamics; only two SWE-Together replicates. Reproducibility is strong: full hyperparameters (Table 5), algorithms, baseline prompts (C.5), hardware/software versions, and a public code link in the abstract.

primary_link.title: Persistent Context Graphs for Efficient Memory Compaction in LLM Agents

papers.summary: As LLM capabilities advance, agents are tackling increasingly complex tasks over longer horizons. Their growing interaction histories make memory compaction essential for staying within context windows and reducing prefill cost. Existing methods summarize the history or compress its KV cache, often adding model computation to preserve information for future requests. A new user request can change which history matters, but reassessing that history with the model requires re-encoding it if the KV
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理 LLM Agent 在長時間互動下的記憶體壓縮問題。Agent 的互動歷史會不斷累積，不僅超出有限脈絡視窗，也讓重複的 prefill 成本成為執行負擔；然而既有方法各有難處：摘要式壓縮會丟失細節，KV cache 壓縮則須為未來請求保留狀態，而查詢導向的淘汰在後續查詢改變時會失效。使用者思考時間往往占據工作階段絕大多數，快取常在空檔後過期，此時壓縮器若要評估歷史相關性，就得重新編碼整段歷史。作者先以觀察研究指出三件事：注意力集中在少數歷史區塊、過去注意力可預測下一輪會重用的內容、而新進請求會重新分配注意力（在 32 個任務中，改變目標所導致的注意力位移約 10.1%，改寫措辭僅約 5.3%）。據此提出 ReCAP：把推論時本就計算出的注意力保存為「持久性脈絡圖」，節點是帶有累積重要性的歷史區塊，邊則記錄區塊間的依賴關係。新請求抵達時，方法結合儲存的重要性、請求與區塊的識別字重疊度，並沿依賴邊擴張取回支持性脈絡，全程僅需圖走訪與字串比對，不需額外模型呼叫，也不依賴 KV cache。在 SWE-Together 與 Lost-in-Conversation 的程式任務上，搭配 Qwen3-Coder 與 gpt-oss，相較 Codex 預設摘要可降低約 95% 的壓縮與冷啟動延遲，SWE-Together 的歷史脈絡約減半且品質相當，LiC 準確率較完整歷史分別提升 19.8 與 41.2 分。圖譜僅需數十 KB 記憶體，且能與 prefix caching 互補；以小型 Qwen3-0.6B 代理模型取得注意力亦幾乎不損成效。限制在於需要可讀取注意力的模型或代理、依賴超參數設定，且實驗集中於程式與工具使用情境。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper on continual alignment: learns fixed-length soft prompts per alignment requirement over a frozen backbone (AlignFormer, Q-Former-style) with a composability regularizer anchoring prompts to sentence-embedding geometry, enabling inference-time weighted blending. Directly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, alignment/RLHF, prompting, training/optimization). Novelty is moderate: it combines known ingredients (prompt-based continual learning, task arithmetic, Q-Former distillation), but the geometry-transfer regularization for composable prompts is a genuine contribution. Rigor is solid: two incremental settings, 8 baselines incl. CPPO/LifeAlign, MTL upper bound, ablations (Table 4), prompt-length study (Table 9), blending-operator comparison (Table 12), judge-robustness check across 4 LLM judges (Table 8), and 3 backbone scales. Key weaknesses: all evaluation is LLM-as-judge on small test sets (200 examples per stage, 83 for TruthfulQA; Appendix A.1), no seeds/error bars or significance tests, no human evaluation, and personalization is scored as weighted combinations of stage-wise metrics rather than end-user studies. Headline numbers trace to tables: Average Last 0.737 vs MTL 0.748 (98.5%) on Qwen3.5-9B and 0.692 vs 0.743 (93.1%) on Llama-3.1-8B (Table 1); 2.6-4.3x training-time savings verified against Table 13 (1.94h vs 8.34h task-inc; 4.10h vs 10.69h pref-inc). Note DualPrompt nearly matches on Qwen task-incremental Last (0.737 vs 0.755), so the 'only frozen-backbone method' claim holds only on the average. Generalizability is decent (two families, 4B-9B, SFT objective variant in Table 7) but limited to supervised requirements and <=6 stages, with zero-shot unseen definitions explicitly deferred. Reproducibility is good on paper (hyperparameters, prompts, protocols in Appendices A-B, D), but code is only promised 'upon acceptance'.

primary_link.title: Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts

papers.summary: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank,
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理「終身對齊」（lifelong alignment）的難題：已部署的 LLM 常需隨時間吸收新的對齊需求（新任務或新偏好），但自然語言指令只能提供間接、粗略的控制，而 post-training 雖適應力強，卻得反覆更新主幹參數，既耗費算力，又容易造成災難性遺忘，且一旦合併便難以拆分或依使用者重新加權。作者提出 Ready2Blend，把對齊控制從「主幹參數」轉移到「提示」上：AlignFormer（Q-Former 的變體）以需求文字為條件，將每個需求映射成固定長度的連續提示，存進模組化的 alignment prompt bank，主幹與既有提示全程凍結；composability regularization 則把預訓練句編碼器的語意幾何轉移到提示空間，以 point-wise 與 pair-wise 一致性讓獨立學到的提示在向量算術下仍能有意義地混合。推論時只需對提示做加權平均，即可依需求子集即時調整行為，提示長度不隨需求數量增加。在任務增量與偏好增量兩種情境下，Ready2Blend 是唯一能在凍結主幹條件下追平 post-training 類方法的做法，平均 Last 分別為 93.1%–98.5% 的聯合訓練上界，且訓練時間比 CPPO 與 LifeAlign 少 2.6–4.3 倍。額外實驗顯示它支援推論時加權個人化、對需求順序幾乎不敏感，且 SFT 目標同樣可行。限制在於其效能仍依賴需求定義與監督資料的品質，未見定義時的泛化能力尚待未來研究。

links.title: Synthetic Pre-pretraining Survives Scale, but Not as a Grammatical Prior

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: claims first systematic PPT study spanning five PPT tasks, four PT mixtures, 500M-7B parameters, and up to 100B tokens; 'saving at least 21B PT tokens at the 3B scale'

Section 5.1/Figure 2: k-Shuffle Dyck improves downstream average in 9 of 12 scale-mixture pairs (mean gain 1.6 among them); Control stays within -0.2 to +0.4 of PT-Only, isolating the synthetic-data effect
Section 5.2/Table 2: verbatim retrieval NLL improves in all 12 pairs (stable in 7) while BLiMP gains are stable in only 1 of 12, undermining the grammatical-prior account
Section 6/Table 3a: raising math share from 1.3% to 17.0% leaves average PPT gain ~unchanged (2.0 vs 1.9); Marin\DCLM (no web text, 82% code) collapses gain to +0.2

Section 6/Table 3b and Appendix Table 14: formal and non-formal tasks (Dyck +1.3, MP-Struct +0.9, NCA +1.2) all help while Set, lacking positional retrieval, degrades by -7.2, supporting the retrieval hypothesis
Section 6/Table 4 and Table 15: on Marin 3B, PPT reaches 62.3 average after 63B tokens vs PT-Only 62.0 after 84B; gains persist at 7B (positive at every budget up to 75.5B)
Footnote 3: 'Compute constraints limit 7B evaluations to the Marin mixture (up to 75.5B PT tokens) and k-Shuffle Dyck' - a scope limitation
Appendix B.2: three-seed replication on Marin 3B shows downstream gain varies by only 0.2 points (seed means +1.9/+1.9/+1.7) and BLiMP sign instability (+0.9 to -0.3) reproduces

Reproducibility Statement: code, preprocessing and training guides at github.com/gucci-j/verify-ppt-at-scale; checkpoints and datasets on Hugging Face Hub (verify-ppt); Appendix A.2 gives full hyperparameters, software versions, and GPU-hours (PPT = 4.74% of wall-clock)
Section 6: authors concede 'We leave a direct ablation of OLMo3, and the property responsible for this gap, for future work'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM pre-training science: a well-designed scale study showing synthetic pre-pretraining (PPT) benefits persist from 500M to 7B and up to 100B tokens, while refuting the grammatical-prior explanation in favor of a long-range retrieval mechanism. Relevance is solid but not maximal: it targets the LLM/training/scaling/synthetic-data clusters rather than the highest-weighted agent, reasoning, or Japanese-LLM preferences, and is English-only. Novelty is good - first systematic PPT evaluation at scale plus a credible overturning of prior attribution (Hu et al. 2025) - though the mechanism claim remains task-level inference rather than mechanistic analysis. Rigor is strong: controlled PT-Only and text-warm-up Control baselines (Section 4.2), checkpoint averaging with SDs and a 'stable' criterion, averaging-window sweeps (Table 10), and 3-seed replication on the key 3B Marin config (Appendix B.2, gain varies only 0.2 points). Evidence is extensive and quantified (Tables 2-4, 14-16): downstream gains in 9/12 scale-mixture pairs, verbatim NLL reduced in all 12 pairs (stable in 7) vs BLiMP stable in 1/12, 13x math-share increase leaves gain unchanged while removing web text collapses it to +0.2 (Table 3a), and 100B-token runs show PPT reaching PT-Only's 84B-token quality. Weaknesses: single runs for most grid cells, 7B limited to one mixture and one PPT task (footnote 3), the OLMo3 anomaly is left unexplained, and no formal significance testing. Generalizability is broad by design but constrained by the SmolLM3 architecture and English benchmarks. Reproducibility is excellent with full hyperparameters, compute costs, and public code/checkpoints/datasets.

primary_link.title: Synthetic Pre-pretraining Survives Scale, but Not as a Grammatical Prior

papers.summary: Pre-pretraining (PPT) on synthetic non-natural language data improves token efficiency during language model pre-training (PT). Prior work attributes this gain to a grammatical prior, i.e., a structural inductive bias learned during PPT that transfers to natural language grammar. However, PPT has only been tested on models of at most 1B parameters and PT budgets below 2B tokens on predominantly web text. It is unknown whether PPT is effective at larger scales and under more realistic PT data mix
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文檢驗「前置預訓練」（pre-pretraining, PPT）——即在正式預訓練（PT）之前，先讓語言模型在合成非自然語言序列（如 k-Shuffle Dyck 這種交錯括號語言）上暖身——其效益能否在更大規模與更真實條件下成立。過去研究多半只在 1B 參數以下、PT 預算低於 2B token、且以網路文本為主的語料上驗證，並將增益歸因於模型學到可移轉到自然語言語法的「語法先驗」。作者因此系統性橫跨五種 PPT 任務、四種 PT 資料混合（C4、Marin、SmolLM3、OLMo3）、四種參數規模（500M 至 7B），並將 PT 預算延伸至 100B token。結果顯示，PPT 的 downstream 效能與 token 效率增益確實能隨規模維持，在 3B 規模可省下至少 21B PT token，7B 亦仍為正；但增益與語法可接受度（BLiMP）並不一致，反而與長距離擷取（verbatim retrieval）較為吻合，且只有需要「取回序列中特定較早位置」的任務（k-Shuffle Dyck、MP-Struct Core、NCA）有效，只追蹤是否看過某 token 的 Set 反而嚴重退化。資料混合方面，數學佔比提高 13 倍不影響增益，但完全移除網路文本後增益幾乎消失。限制在於多數設定僅單次執行、7B 只涵蓋 Marin 與 k-Shuffle Dyck，且 OLMo3 增益偏弱的原因未釐清。此研究指出未來 PPT 任務設計應以長距離擷取為目標，而非模仿自然語言語法的階層結構。
papers.title: Synthetic Pre-pretraining Survives Scale, but Not as a Grammatical Prior
papers.title_zh: 合成前置預訓練可通過規模考驗，但並非以語法先驗的形式

links.title: AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents

evidence: Sec 1: central question — 'can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning?'
Sec 3.2: tools are 'exposed through Model Context Protocol (MCP)' for render, query, and pose-edit operations; mesh vertices and faces hidden.
Sec 4.2/Table 1: strongest system reaches 59.4% SR vs 80.9% part accuracy; open-source systems lag (Qwen 11.9% overall SR, DeepSeek 0%).

Appendix B.1: 'Pairwise comparisons use two-sided randomization tests with 100,000 draws... Holm correction covers 56 tests'; 'Astra's descriptive advantage over Fable is not significant under this family-wise correction'.
Appendix A.3: source-level comparisons 'do not constitute a matched reproduction of those published runs' — published numbers retained with original implementations.
Appendix E: robustness tests are 'small-sample, single-run findings remain exploratory'; 25 baselines, one run per perturbed condition.

Sec 5 Conclusion: evaluation 'concerns free-space geometry and does not establish collision-free or physically stable assembly'; 'unknown pretraining exposure also prevents claims of contamination-free generalization'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark/environment paper squarely in the Agents & Tool Use space: general-purpose LLM agents (GPT/Claude/Qwen/DeepSeek-based systems) perform 3D assembly via MCP tool calls with rendered observations, evaluated execution-style after OSWorld. The agentic and LLM-evaluation framing is central, not incidental, so it avoids the out-of-scope 'pure robotics/vision' bucket, though the 3D-assembly domain itself is application-flavored. Novelty is solid for a benchmark (cross-domain unification of furniture/industrial/fracture assembly under a shared MCP interface with geometric scoring) but incremental in mechanism. Rigor is unusually high: standardized initializations, bootstrap CIs, 100k-draw randomization tests with Holm correction over 56 comparisons, threshold-sensitivity and metric-concentration diagnostics, and honest acknowledgment that the Astra-vs-Fable advantage is not significant and that specialized-method comparisons use published numbers without matched reproduction (Appendix A.3). Evidence is strong for the core capability/precision-gap claims (80.9% PA vs 59.4% SR) but weaker for cross-method comparisons and single-run robustness/refinement studies. Generalizability is decent across three domains and eight systems yet bounded by free-space geometry, unknown pretraining contamination, and no physical-validity guarantees. Reproducibility benefits from detailed prompts, seeds, harness versions (Codex CLI 0.155.1, Claude Code 2.1.272) and a project page, but no explicit code/data release is stated in the text.

primary_link.title: AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents

papers.summary: The task of 3D assembly requires translating an understanding of parts and their relationships into precise spatial arrangements. Can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning? To investigate this question, we introduce AssemblyWorld, an interactive 3D environment in which agents inspect rendered views and manipulate supplied rigid parts, guided by images or assembly manuals when available. Agents perceive part
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個核心問題：未經組裝任務專門微調的通用型代理，能否僅透過視覺互動完成三維組裝？作者提出 AssemblyWorld，一個互動式三維環境，代理只能觀察算繪後的 2D 視圖、選擇視角，並透過 MCP 工具平移或旋轉剛體零件，無法直接存取網格頂點或面；最終組裝結果以幾何指標評估。在此環境上，他們建構 AssemblyWorldBench，涵蓋 PartNet、IKEA-Manual、AssemblyBench 與 Fantastic Breaks 四個資料集，共 80 個物件、100 項任務，橫跨家具、工業組裝與破裂重組三個領域。八個代理系統的比較顯示，最強系統達到 80.9% 零件準確率，但完整組裝成功率僅 59.4%；開源系統在執行可靠度與組裝精度上明顯落後閉源對手。視覺參考圖能提升較強系統的表現，軌跡分析則顯示代理會反覆檢視與修正，但仍留下定位殘差。作者也嘗試將代理與專門幾何模型（如 GARF）雙向串接，發現組合順序會影響成效。限制在於自由空間幾何評估、單次執行、兩片段重組的小樣本，以及未知的預訓練污染風險。
papers.title: AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents
papers.title_zh: AssemblyWorld：以通用型代理重新思考三維組裝

links.title: Advancing Entropy-Level Credit Assignment in RLVR via Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization

evidence: Section 3.2, Table 1 and Figure 2: global entropy varies 0.315 (hard) vs 0.221 (easy) and deviates up to 80% across positions, while proximal entropy stays ≈0.00988, empirically corroborating Proposition 1's invariance claims.
Section 5.1, Table 7/8: full training setup (ROLL/VeRL, DeepMath-103K/DAPO-Math-17K, G=8, lr 1e-6, εh=0.28, W=101, 2×H200) enabling reimplementation.
Section 5.2, Table 2: 3-run results; PEPO best mean on all models (Qwen3-4B 58.01±0.14 vs GRPO 50.15±0.43; Llama-3.2-3B 21.00±0.15 vs GRPO 19.31±0.20), with per-run values in Appendix Table 14.
Section 5.4, Table 4: transfer test — PESPO mean 58.93 vs SPO 57.13 while global-entropy variants degrade (S-Entropy Adv. 54.65), supporting the confounder claim in the single-stream setting.
Section 5.5, Table 5: causal token-replacement intervention; proximal entropy recovers the GRPO checkpoint's 33.33% accuracy at 10% replacement budget vs 30% for global entropy.
Appendix B: proof of Proposition 1 — exact shift invariance and approximate trend invariance under condition |f'(t)|·W/2 ≪ 1, with numerical check (≈0.004 for T=2000, W=101).
Appendix F.1, Table 10: held-out LiveCodeBench (1,055 problems) pass@1 46.35% PEPO vs 31.75% GRPO and 41.04% 80/20, with difficulty/platform breakdown and a caveat on the 9-problem Codeforces subset.
Limitations section: no comparison to value-based methods (PPO), coding evaluation limited to one LiveCodeBench split and Qwen3-4B; agentic tool use and multi-turn dialogue untested.
Appendix D, Table 9: wall-clock overhead check — PEPO 1d19h45m vs GRPO 1d19h25m on Qwen3-4B, supporting the negligible-overhead claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology: value-model-free RLVR (GRPO/SPO) with a new token-level credit assignment signal (proximal entropy), evaluated on mathematical reasoning and held-out code. Preference relevance is very high (LLM reasoning + RL + training methodology). Novelty is moderate: the method is an incremental but well-motivated refinement of entropy-based advantage shaping (80/20, Entropy Adv., GTPO, ARES), with the local-vs-global reference frame and confounder analysis (prompt difficulty, positional trend) as the main conceptual contribution plus a simple invariance proof. Rigor is solid: formal Proposition 1 with proof conditions stated, 3 seeds with SDs, per-run tables, ablations (window size, weighting decomposition, temperature), causal token-intervention, runtime overhead check, and honest reporting of baselines degrading (Llama AIME25) and of ablations lacking uncertainty. Evidence is fairly strong but 3-run SDs overlap for some comparisons (e.g., Qwen3-1.7B AIME24 PEPO 21.74±1.06 vs Entropy Adv. 21.44±1.81), and no PPO/value-based baseline. Generalizability is demonstrated across 2 model families, 2 frameworks, 2 algorithms, and code transfer, but mainly math; authors acknowledge limited code coverage and no agentic/multi-turn tests. Reproducibility is good (full hyperparameter tables, frameworks, datasets, edge handling, per-run results) though no code-release statement. Venue claim ('NeurIPS 2026') was not credited.

primary_link.title: Advancing Entropy-Level Credit Assignment in RLVR via Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization

papers.summary: Value-model-free RLVR methods such as GRPO assign uniform advantages to all tokens in a rollout, ignoring that tokens contribute unequally. Recent methods use token entropy as an importance proxy but compute it globally across the batch, conflating importance with prompt difficulty and positional trends. We argue that importance should instead be measured relative to the local context of each token. We introduce proximal entropy, a local measure of token importance relative to neighboring tokens
papers.summary_zh: 在可驗證獎勵強化學習（RLVR）中，GRPO 等無價值模型方法對同一條 rollout 的所有 token 給予相同優勢值，忽略了各 token 貢獻不均的事實。近期做法改以 token 熵作為重要性的代理指標，卻在整個 batch 的全局尺度上計算，把重要性與題目難度、生成位置趨勢混為一談。作者主張重要性應相對於 token 自身的局部脈絡來衡量，因而提出「近端熵」：以每個 token 為中心、在滑動視窗內取 softmax 的局部不確定性度量，並證明它對序列層級的常數平移（即題目難度）完全不變，對平滑單調的位置趨勢亦近似不變。據此設計的 PEPO 以近端熵對逐 token 優勢值加權，並僅施加於正獎勵 rollout，總優勢量級與 GRPO 一致。實驗在 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B 與 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上、於 MATH500、AMC、AIME 2024/2025 進行，PEPO 全面優於 GRPO 與 80/20、Entropy Advantage 等 batch 層級基線；在單流 RL（SPO）設定下，全局熵方法甚至低於基線，而 PESPO 仍穩定提升。將近端熵直接替換進 80/20 也能帶來增益，說明局部參考框架本身即為關鍵。限制在於主要評測集中於數學推理，程式生成僅涵蓋一個 LiveCodeBench 切分，且未與 PPO 等基於價值模型的方法比較。
papers.title: Advancing Entropy-Level Credit Assignment in RLVR via Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: 以近端熵策略最佳化推進 RLVR 中的熵層級信用分配

links.title: AutoDataBench: A Data-centric Testbed for Accelerating Auto Research

evidence: Abstract & Section 3: testbed isolates data intelligence via data diagnosis, organization, and construction, holding non-data factors fixed; tasks span tool use, retrieval, knowledge injection
Section 3.2: agents prohibited from example-by-example processing; bulk operations via code and auxiliary models (Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B)

Section 3.3.1 & Appendix A.1 Table 3: 40k corrupted xLAM-derived pool, seven corruption operators with probabilities and counts (42.19% corrupted), LoRA-tuned Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct, macro AST accuracy, hidden BFCL OOD

Section 4.1 & Table 1: seven frontier LLMs, three runs per LLM-task (63 total), mean ± sample std, ID-best and OOD at ID-selected checkpoints; Kimi-3 overall 60.68, tool-use ID means 80.82-81.98 vs oracle 81.65
Section 4.3 & Appendix A.4 Table 7: 61/63 runs improve, mean first-to-best gains 8.11/6.46/4.91 points; paper states changes do not isolate causal contribution
Section 4.4 & Figure 3: prediction-enabled runs, one run per model-task, 4 of 6 below standard-run mean; authors hedge that differences 'lean negative'

Section 4.5 & Table 2 / Appendix A.5: 5B-token matched mid-training from Qwen2.5-Coder-14B, 8M-token trajectory corpus upsampled 10x (1.6% of tokens), identical SFT; gains +0.79 to +5.66 (largest on SWE-bench Multilingual), single pair of runs, no variance reported
Title-page footnotes: github.com/AutoDataBench/AutoDataBench and huggingface.co/AutoDataBench availability claims; seeds (42) and full optimizer settings given in A.5
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly preference-relevant: a benchmark evaluating frontier LLM agents' ability to diagnose, organize, and construct training data, spanning tool use, retrieval/embeddings, knowledge injection, and mid-training data reuse. Novelty is moderate: it builds on MLE-bench, DCA-Bench, Curation-Bench, and PostTrainBench, but the isolation of 'data intelligence' with fixed training pipelines, hidden OOD 'benchmaxxing' probes, a prediction-of-data-effects behavioral probe, and trajectory reuse as mid-training data is a meaningful combination. Rigor is solid: fixed pipelines, random and expert/oracle baselines, three runs per LLM-task (63 runs) with std, hidden OOD sets, and detailed corruption operators (Appendix A.1). Weaknesses: no significance testing, the prediction experiment is a single run per model-task (Section 4.4), behavioral analysis is explicitly non-causal (Section 4.3), and the data-engine transfer uses one control-treatment pair without repeats, so small deltas like +0.53 MBPP Plus may be noise (Table 2). Evidence is extensive and hedged appropriately, but the strongest headline claim (SWE-bench Multilingual +5.66) rests on a single comparison. Reproducibility is aided by public code/data links, seeds, and full hyperparameters (Appendix A.5), though reliance on proprietary frontier APIs limits exact replication.

primary_link.title: AutoDataBench: A Data-centric Testbed for Accelerating Auto Research

papers.summary: Existing auto-research benchmarks often entangle multiple sources of improvement, including training frameworks, hyperparameters, compute budgets, and data, making it difficult to attribute why one frontier agent outperforms another to specific research capabilities. In this work, we isolate and systematically evaluate Data Intelligence: an agent's ability to understand, manipulate, and improve the data that shapes model capabilities. We introduce AutoDataBench, a controlled testbed built on a c
papers.summary_zh: 既有自動化研究基準常把訓練框架、超參數、算力預算與資料混在一起，難以判斷前沿代理（agent）的優勢究竟來自哪一項研究能力。本文把「資料智慧」單獨抽離，定義為代理理解、操作與改善訓練資料的能力，並提出 AutoDataBench 這個受控測試平台。其概念框架涵蓋資料診斷與修補、資料組織、資料建構三個面向，對應三個精心設計的最佳化任務：在刻意汙染的 function-calling 資料上訓練工具使用模型、在固定對比學習管線下為檢索模型建構訓練資料、以及在固定離線蒸餾管線下由語料建構問答以注入新知識。所有任務都固定非資料因素（訓練流程、工具、來源資料與資源預算），代理只能反覆檢查資料、提出介入、送交訓練並依回饋調整，每個任務另保留一組未公開的 out-of-distribution 評估，用來檢驗策略是否只是「benchmaxxing」。實驗涵蓋 GPT、Claude、Kimi、DeepSeek、GLM 與 Qwen 等七個前沿模型，每組三次標準運行。結果顯示：工具使用任務上多數模型的平均 ID 準確率達 80.82–81.98，明顯優於隨機基準 70.45，接近專家清理參考值 81.65；檢索任務上 GPT-5.6-Sol 的 ID 平均 40.46 已逼近專家 40.62，但所有模型 OOD 都低於專家的 34.76，且 ID 與 OOD 排名出現反轉；知識注入方面多數模型達到或超越專家 Novel 準確率 48.40，Kimi-3 平均達 60.60。行為分析指出 63 次運行中有 61 次較初始資料進步，平均首輪至最佳增益分別為 8.11、6.46、4.91 分。作者另要求模型在訓練前預測分數，結果顯示預測能大致追蹤檢索表現，但六組中有四組最佳分數低於標準運行平均，暗示顯式預測可能帶來額外負擔。最後，把 800 萬 token 的自動研究軌跡上採樣十倍、以 5B token 預算進行 mid-training，再搭配相同 SFT，可提升五項程式評測，其中 CRUXEval 輸入預測由 72.00 升至 74.12、SWE-bench Multilingual 由 27.67 升至 33.33。整體而言，本文的貢獻在於把資料決策與可量測的學習結果直接連結，並同時把基準當成可再利用的訓練資料來源；限制在於各項介入的因果貢獻未被逐一隔離，且部分任務缺乏重複運行的不確定性估計。
papers.title: AutoDataBench: A Data-centric Testbed for Accelerating Auto Research
papers.title_zh: AutoDataBench：以資料為核心的測試平台，加速自動化研究

links.title: Safety of Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems

evidence: Abstract: reward-guided attack raises mean harmful-compliance from 27.9 (benignly trained links) to 76.9 across three topologies and four safety benchmarks.
Section 3, Table 1: benign latent link training raises aggregate ASR from 4.4→31.1 (2-agent), 3.2→31.7 (sequential), 12.5→20.8 (mixture) while all agent parameters remain frozen.

Section 3, Figure 2: first-token refusal probability drops from 0.82/0.84 (receiver alone/text) to 0.29 with trained link; forcing 'Sorry' prefix lowers compliance 31.1→1.6, supporting the shallow-alignment interpretation.
Section 4.1, Table 2: supervised optimization raises aggregate compliance 27.9→75.6 but cuts MATH500 from 67.2%→30.7%; 10% data poisoning alone raises it to 58.2.
Section 5.2, Table 4: reward-guided repair reduces aggregate harmful compliance from 70.3 to 4.8 averaged over nine attack-topology pairs, e.g., mixture RL attack 95.9→2.5.
Appendix B.3: the attack judge J_ψ is implemented with the StrongREJECT judge, which is also one of the four evaluation benchmarks, creating a potential optimization-evaluation overlap.
Appendix A.4: official HarmBench classifier and StrongREJECT evaluator used; authors claim PKU-derived attack pools have no exact overlap with the four safety benchmarks (held-out transfer).
Appendix C.2 and C.3: poisoning sweep shows ASR saturating near 20% contamination; a single Refiner→Solver link attack yields 70.0 vs 67.0 for all links, indicating localized vulnerability.
Appendix A.1/A.3: models limited to 1B-8B (Llama-3.2, Qwen2.5/Qwen3, Gemma-3), link sizes 27.3M-111.2M, AdamW lr 5e-4 on a single H100; no seed or variance reporting; no code-release statement found.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic: safety of LLM multi-agent systems, learned latent communication links as a new attack surface, GRPO-based reward-guided attack/repair, and standard red-team benchmarks (HarmBench, StrongREJECT, JailbreakBench, AdvBench). The core finding—benign link training alone raises aggregate ASR from ~4-12 to ~21-31 with frozen agents (Table 1)—is novel and well-motivated, and the forced-refusal-prefix and first-token analyses (Fig. 2, C.5) give a credible mechanistic account via shallow alignment. Rigor is solid: three topologies, four safety plus two utility benchmarks, poisoning-rate sweep, single-link attack-surface analysis, supervised-vs-RL ablation, and claimed held-out query separation (A.4). Weaknesses: only small open models (1B-8B) and a single benign math training task limit generalizability; no seeds, error bars, or significance tests; the attack reward uses the StrongREJECT judge (B.3) which is also an evaluation benchmark, risking optimistic inflation on that metric; no code release is stated despite detailed hyperparameters and templates. Overall a strong, in-scope safety paper with convincing effect sizes (27.9→76.9 attack; 70.3→4.8 repair) but moderate statistical and scale caveats.

primary_link.title: Safety of Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems

papers.summary: Latent communication enables multi-agent systems to exchange information directly in internal representation space, reducing the token, computation, and latency overhead of text-based communication. To this end, lightweight trainable links are introduced to map the sender's representations into the receiver's input space. In this work, we show that even benign link training can increase harmful compliance relative to text-based communication while the underlying safety-aligned agents remain unch
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討多代理系統（multi-agent system）中以「潛在通訊」（latent communication）取代文字訊息時所衍生的安全風險。潛在通訊的作法，是讓代理之間直接交換內部表徵，並以可訓練的輕量連結（link）把發送端的隱藏狀態映射到接收端的輸入空間，藉此降低 token 用量、推論延遲與運算成本。作者指出，即使底層 LLM 參數完全凍結、連結僅以良性資料訓練，有害順從程度仍會相對文字通訊明顯上升；以三種拓樸、四項安全基準衡量，平均有害順從分數由文字模式的 4.4 至 12.5 上升到 20.8 至 31.7。攻擊面進一步擴大：直接以有害問答對監督最佳化連結，平均分數可達 75.6，但良性任務表現明顯下降；僅汙染約 10% 訓練資料亦能將平均分數推升至 58.2。作者另提出免目標回應的強化學習攻擊，以 GRPO 搭配 LLM 評審的純量獎勵，同時獎勵有害順從與良性任務表現，平均分數達 76.9，並在三個拓樸中的兩個勝過監督式攻擊，且兩項良性效用基準的平均準確率更高。機制分析顯示，良性監督訓練使接收端首 token 拒答機率由 0.82 降至 0.29，但強制以 I、No、Sorry 開頭即可回收大部分效果，顯示拒絕能力並未消失，而是被推向較不易進入拒答軌跡的狀態。最後，作者把獎勵改為懲罰有害順從並獎勵正確作答，僅更新連結即可修復受損系統：九組攻擊與拓樸配對的平均有害順從分數由 70.3 降至 4.8。限制在於評估集中於三種特定拓樸與有限模型組合，修復後 GPQA-Diamond 準確率仍低於乾淨連結基準，且部分修復設定使 MATH500 表現下滑。整體而言，本研究主張安全對齊不能只看個別代理，而必須把多代理系統視為整體，通訊介面的訓練本身即屬系統對齊的一部分。
papers.title: Safety of Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems

links.title: Replay on Demand: An Emergent Curriculum for Balancing Adaptation and Forgetting in Continued Pretraining

evidence: Section 4.1: on Legal/Nemotron-12B, RoD reduces validation-loss forgetting by 43% vs 10% fixed replay (0.125 to 0.071) and task-based forgetting from 6.7 to 4.9 points at matched adaptation (0.967).

Appendix B.3 'Runs and compute': 'We use seed 42 throughout training and run each experimental condition once. Accordingly, the reported frontiers are single-seed estimates'; conclusions rest on patterns recurring across settings, not repeated runs.

Section 4.3 (Fig. 5a): component ablation shows RHO-based selection within a fixed replay allocation largely maintains the random-selection trade-off; gains emerge only when adaptation and replay compete jointly, isolating the contribution.

Appendix C.3.3 (Fig. 10): vulnerability-to-sampling-ratio correlation r=0.88 for Nemotron-12B German, 0.76/0.66/0.45 elsewhere; Legal-Qwen correlation rises from r=0.20 to r=0.69 after excluding one influential multilingual source.

Section 4.4 / Table 1: curricula built by Qwen3.5-4B remain effective for the 35B target (8.75x gap: adapt 1.751, val. forgetting 0.024 vs no-replay 0.483), and a 4B reference recovers native 9B RoD trade-off.

Appendix C.2 and D.3-D.4: authors acknowledge proxy replay (Nemotron corpus for Qwen) yields weaker coupling between validation-loss and task-based forgetting, with the residual gap concentrated in reasoning/mathematics and multilingual tasks.

Appendix A.1-A.2: derivation of source-specific scores from the RHO objective via three stated approximations; joint top-k optimality shown under a PL-type condition (Eq. 21) and treated as a local marginal-utility surrogate, not a guarantee.

Section 3.3 and Reproducibility statement: implementation on NeMo-RL with code released at https://github.com/bethgelab/replay-on-demand; Algorithm 1, optimizer settings (Adam beta1=0.9, beta2=0.95, lr 1.2e-4), batch 1024x4096, and data preprocessing detailed in Appendix B.

Appendix C.1 (Fig. 6, Table 4): robustness checks showing fixed-replay trained to convergence (up to 2.27x budget) still does not beat RoD's 1x frontier, and RoD does not improve when continued ~20% beyond its budget.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically relevant LLM-training paper: dynamic replay allocation for continued pretraining via source-specific reducible losses (adaptation scored against a domain specialist, replay against the pretrained model), with joint top-k selection letting the replay share emerge. Strongly matches LLM/training/data-selection preferences; Japanese/agent/safety preferences are not addressed. Novelty is moderate: it composes RHO (Mindermann et al.) with base-relative forgetting signals; the joint allocation rule and its derivation are the main new elements, and the paper honestly positions itself against adaptive-mixture and replay-selection prior work. Rigor is high: 5 model-domain settings across Nemotron/Qwen 4B-35B, fixed-replay sweeps, model-merging, max-replay off-budget reference, component and candidate-multiplier ablations, convergence checks for both RoD and baselines, and a formal derivation with explicitly stated approximations; but every condition is a single seed 42 run, which the authors themselves flag, and several frontier claims are qualitative ('reaches or improves'). Evidence is concrete (Table 3 full frontier numbers, Table 1 cross-scale table, correlation analyses with outlier handling), yet single-run and partly loss-centric. Generalizability is well tested across families, scales (8.75x curriculum transfer) and native vs. proxy replay, with clear limits: needs a representative replay pool and an adaptation reference, and the loss signal decouples from capability retention for proxy replay (reasoning/math gap in Appendix C.2). Reproducibility is strong: Algorithm 1, full hyperparameters, data recipes, evaluation suite, seed, and a public code repository.

primary_link.title: Replay on Demand: An Emergent Curriculum for Balancing Adaptation and Forgetting in Continued Pretraining

papers.summary: Continued pretraining enables language models to adapt to new domains and knowledge, but often at the cost of forgetting previously acquired capabilities. Replay can mitigate this trade-off, but fixed replay mixtures allocate training independently of the model's actual retention needs. We introduce Replay on Demand (RoD), which instead derives the replay allocation from the model's learning dynamics. RoD jointly prioritizes adaptation samples by their remaining learning potential and replay sam
papers.summary_zh: 持續預訓練（CPT）能讓語言模型吸收新領域知識，卻常以遺忘既有能力為代價。回放（replay）雖可緩解此權衡，但固定回放比例無法反映不同能力與資料來源間異質的遺忘程度，也無法隨訓練動態調整。作者提出「隨需回放」（Replay on Demand, RoD），以可縮減損失（reducible loss）為基礎，讓適應樣本依「剩餘學習潛力」、回放樣本依「相對預訓練模型的遺忘量」各自評分，再透過聯合 top-k 選取讓兩者競爭同一訓練預算，使回放比例與組成由模型當下的學習與遺忘狀態自然湧現，無需事先指定。實驗涵蓋 Nemotron 與 Qwen 兩大家族、4B 至 35B 參數、法律與德語兩種適應領域：RoD 在單次執行下即達到或超越需掃描多個回放比例的固定回放前緣，也優於模型合併；分析顯示回放會集中到較易遺忘的來源，並隨訓練逐步增加與重新分配。消融實驗指出增益主要來自聯合競爭，而非單一資料流內的選擇。限制包括：仍需具代表性的回放資料、序列層級損失與下游能力遺忘並非等價（代理回放時尤甚）、以及需額外的前向評分與離線參考模型成本；不過跨規模實驗顯示課程可由較小模型建構後轉移，最差距達 8.75 倍。

papers.title_zh: 隨需回放：在持續預訓練中以湧現式課程平衡適應與遺忘

links.title: Can Computation from Earlier Problems Help LLMs Solve New Ones?

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: STAIR captures earlier-turn keys/values in a fixed bank, learns query redirection with 12,288 trainable parameters on a frozen backbone, and improves mean T2–T4 Avg@4 by up to 11.67 pp over Native on AIME 2025 across three Qwen models and four benchmarks.

Section 2.2/Figure 2C: interaction response retains cross-history nearest-neighbor overlap of 48.06% and 46.50% vs 11.73%/12.08% shuffle control at layer 19, despite occupying only 0.69%/0.66% of displacement energy—supporting a recurring problem-dependent history effect.

Section 4.3/Table 3: shared-T1 AIME 2025 T2 ablations show STAIR 48.33% Avg@4 vs Native 21.67%, Bank-free 36.67%, Random-reflector 37.22%, Direct reflected-read 41.67%, K–V pairing 33.06%; all interventions improve over Native, so the learned differential read over intact K/V pairs is the best but not uniquely beneficial control outcome.
Section 4.2/Table 2: gains are benchmark-dependent—Qwen3.5-9B GPQA-Diamond shows STAIR 75.93 Avg@4 below Native 79.88, while MATH-500 AIME improvements are consistent across models.
Section 6 (Limitations): authors state reflector directions are fitted on mathematical data, GPQA transfer varies by model, and 'Current evidence covers four-turn sessions in the Qwen family.'
Section 4.4/Table 4: STAIR (12,288 params) adds +3.61 Avg@4 over Native; LoRA (4,128,768 params) reaches 39.44; LoRA+STAIR reaches 43.33, indicating complementary effects with weight adaptation.

Appendix C.3/C.4 and Table 13: detailed scoring with training-overlap exclusion (six AMC23 problems removed), matched seeds, bank-prefix study (2K/8K/32K/full = 35.00/43.33/39.17/48.33 Avg@4), and runtime costs (median +0.81 s, +6.60 GiB peak memory); however, no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology work squarely matching top preferences: LLMs (Qwen3/3.5), attention/transformer internals, mathematical reasoning, and KV-cache/memory for inference. The central question (can computation from completed independent problems aid new ones) is fresh, and the mechanism—learned Householder query reflections producing a differential readout of a frozen historical K/V bank with only 12,288 trainable parameters—is a novel combination of cache-reuse and parameter-efficient ideas beyond Transformer-XL/Memorizing Transformers/Prompt Cache. Rigor is strong: crossed-history replay with additive decomposition, shuffle controls, Bank-free/Random-reflector/Direct-read/K–V-permutation ablations, a LoRA joint-training comparison, and honest reporting of mixed outcomes. Evidence is tempered by small evaluation sets (AIME 30 problems, AMC23† 34), no significance testing, a surprisingly low Native T2 baseline in the shared-T1 study against which all interventions improve, no uniform gains over Vanilla (e.g., Qwen3.5-9B GPQA: STAIR 75.93 vs Native 79.88), and no code release despite exhaustive protocol appendices. Generalizability is limited to four-turn sessions and the Qwen family, as the authors themselves state; out-of-domain transfer to GPQA is inconsistent. Reproducibility is high on paper detail (training settings, scoring rules, exclusion lists, runtime) but lacks an artifact availability claim.

primary_link.title: Can Computation from Earlier Problems Help LLMs Solve New Ones?

papers.summary: Large language models often solve independent problems in the same conversation. Can computation from earlier problems help them solve new ones? To answer this question, we first conduct preliminary experiments showing that retained history can raise or lower later-turn accuracy, even within the same domain. To understand these effects, we use controlled replay to isolate internal state changes specific to each problem-history pairing. Across different histories, these changes preserve similar r
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常在同一个對話中依序解決多个彼此独立的問題。本文探討一個直觀但少被系統檢驗的問題：前幾輪問題留下的計算結果，對當前新問題究竟是助力還是阻力？作者先在 MATH-500 與 GPQA-Diamond 上做初步實驗，发现保留歷史有時提升、有時拉低後續輪次的正確率，即使在同一領域內也因模型與任務而異。為了理解這種差異，他們以凍結骨幹進行受控重播，將表徵位移分解為問題效應、歷史效應與交互反應，发现交互反應雖只占總位移能量不到 1%，其最近鄰結構卻在不同歷史間穩定重現，遠高於隨機置換控制組；配對分析也显示答案同時出現由錯改對與由對改錯。基於此，作者提出 STAIR（Stale-Token Attention for Inter-query Reuse）：在固定 bank 中保存早期回應生成時的 key/value，並學習一組 Householder 反射方向，讓當前查詢在 prefill 階段重新導向讀取位址，骨幹完全凍結，僅訓練 12,288 個參數。在三个 Qwen 模型與四个基準上，STAIR 相對於未修改的 Native 在 AIME 2025 上最高提升 11.67 個百分點（T2–T4 平均 Avg@4）。消融显示，破壞 K/V 配對或改用隨機反射均會降低效果，而與 LoRA 聯合訓練還能再增益。限制在於目前僅涵蓋 Qwen 家族的四輪對話，且 bank 會隨對話變長而增加儲存與 prefill 成本；反射方向是否真能跨領域遷移仍待更大規模訓練混合驗證。此工作的重要性在於把「已完成問題留下的計算」視為可學習讀取的資源，而非僅是佔用上下文的負擔。

links.title: Offline Guidance, Online Reasoning: Reusing LLM Feedback for Small Language Models

evidence: Abstract/Sec 1: 'RLC improves the average performance of a 7B SLM by 7.97 percentage points, bringing it on par with a 32B SLM' and 14B by 5.93 points
Table 1 (Sec 5.1): RLC (7B) average 55.42 vs ReBalance 50.74, PDS 50.47, STEER (7B→32B) 48.27, GlimpRouter 51.38
Table 3 (Appendix C.1.1): Mean Value ablation drops average accuracy 3.14–4.55 points across scales, RLC wins 14 of 15 model-dataset comparisons
Table 5 (Appendix C.2): 14B Bank→32B transfer +7.42 points vs 32B Native; reverse 32B Bank→14B only +1.08, showing asymmetric transfer
Table 6 (Appendix C.3): Router outperforms both Native-only and Bank-only strategies in all 15 comparisons, e.g. 3B avg 47.67 vs Bank 41.88
Table 7 (Appendix C.4): RLC matches or beats online Qwen3-Max direct feedback at 3B/7B with >70% fewer total output tokens; 14B -1.32 points at ~half tokens
Appendix C.6: one-time teacher API cost US$52.80 for three Banks, amortized vs US$7.10 per direct-feedback sweep
Appendix A.1: AIME24/25 contain 30 problems each and AMC24 45 problems, small test sets without reported variance limit statistical strength
Sec 5.1/Appendix B.4: hyperparameters fully specified (top-3, τ_sim=0.95, (α_p,α_r)=(0.5,0.25), -4th layer); Appendix D provides exact prompts; GitHub code link given in Abstract
Appendix B.1: SLMs are Qwen2.5-3B/7B/14B-Instruct with teacher Qwen3-Max only; no non-Qwen SLM family is evaluated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper squarely in scope: LLM-SLM collaboration, chain-of-thought reasoning improvement, activation steering, and retrieval-based experience reuse with no online LLM calls. The proposed mechanism (persisting teacher-guided hidden-state corrections as state-conditioned key-value pairs retrieved by the frozen SLM) is a sensible and somewhat novel combination of activation steering, retrieval, and routing, though it builds on established components (RISER, PDS already compose skills/prototypes with routers). Rigor is good: two baseline families, four ablations (prefill/decode-only, Mean Value, injection layer, router Native/Bank/Router), bidirectional cross-scale transfer, cost amortization analysis, and validation-selected hyperparameters; however, no variance estimates or significance tests are reported and several test sets are tiny (AIME 30, AMC24 45 problems per Appendix A.1), making per-dataset deltas of one or two problems statistically fragile. Quantitative claims are internally consistent (7B: 47.45→55.42 = +7.97; 14B: 51.77→57.70 = +5.93) and supported by detailed tables. Generalizability is limited to the Qwen2.5 family with a single Qwen3-Max teacher and math/GPQA-style tasks; cross-family transfer is untested. Reproducibility is strong: code URL, full hyperparameters, prompts (Appendix D), and algorithm pseudocode (Appendix E), though the teacher requires a commercial API.

primary_link.title: Offline Guidance, Online Reasoning: Reusing LLM Feedback for Small Language Models

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities but are often costly to access through commercial APIs, while small language models (SLMs) are easier to deploy locally yet remain weaker in reasoning. This capability-deployment gap has motivated LLM-SLM collaboration, which aims to improve SLM reasoning using LLM capabilities while preserving the deployment advantages of SLMs. Existing approaches mainly follow two paradigms. Knowledge distillation uses LLM-generated answers and r
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理大型語言模型（LLM）推理能力強但多半只能透過商用 API 存取、而小型語言模型（SLM）便於在地部署卻推理較弱之間的落差。既有做法分為兩類：知識蒸餾需離線微調 SLM 參數，成本較高；線上協作則在推論時反覆呼叫 LLM，且針對特定問題產生的指導在用完後即被丟棄，無法幫助後續遇到相似推理狀態的題目。作者提出「可重用潛在修正」（Reusable Latent Correction, RLC），把黑箱 LLM 一次性的自然語言指導，轉換為存於 SLM 隱藏空間的持久修正經驗。方法分兩階段：離線階段以中介層與最終層預測的不一致程度估計步驟不確定性，找出可疑步驟後請 LLM 給出局部指導，再讓凍結的 SLM 重新生成該步，並比較指導前後的隱藏表徵，抽出「過程修正」與「結果修正」向量；只有能導向正確答案的修正才以鍵值對存入外部經驗庫，鍵為錯誤發生前的推理狀態。線上階段完全不呼叫 LLM，SLM 依當前隱藏狀態檢索最相似的修正並加權聚合，於 prefill 與 decode 兩階段分別注入隱藏狀態，另以輕量路由器決定是否啟用經驗庫。實驗在 MATH500、GSM8K、GPQA-Diamond、AMC24、AIME 上以 Qwen2.5-3B/7B/14B 驗證：不改參數、不線上呼叫 LLM 的情況下，3B 與 7B 版本分別略勝原生 7B 與 32B，14B 版本平均可與原生 72B 相當，且輸出長度未顯著增加；跨規模轉移實驗顯示由 14B 建立的經驗庫可讓 32B 平均提升 7.42 個百分點，反向僅 1.08 個百分點，存在明顯不對稱。與線上直接回饋相比，RLC 準確率相近但總輸出 token 大幅減少；推論延遲僅增加約 3% 至 4%，且在十五組比較中有十三組快於對應的更大原生模型。消融顯示每次檢索的修正需與當前狀態對應，改用全域平均修正會下降 3.14 至 4.55 個百分點；路由器亦優於固定啟用經驗庫。限制在於離線建庫仍需教師 API 成本（三種規模合計約 52.80 美元）、路由器需額外訓練，且修正效果具任務與狀態依賴性，錯配的介入可能擾動原本正確的推理軌跡。
papers.title: Offline Guidance, Online Reasoning: Reusing LLM Feedback for Small Language Models

links.title: Capture the lifecycle: KV Cache management in ReAct Agents with KVTether

evidence: §1/§8.2: claims latency reductions up to 26.3% vs LMCache and 17.4% vs MORI, and cost reductions 40.0%/33.2%, matched consistently in abstract, intro, and evaluation
§2.4: trace analysis quantifies liveness failure (zombie KV up to 36.3% of LMCache capacity) and ordering failure (71.0-95.0% of LRU evictions wrong-direction)
§6.2/§8.3.2: MRU justified by reuse-interval clustering (e.g., 87.5% of Agent-X returns within 2-4s) and validated by ablation: wrong-direction evictions drop from 65.6-92.3% to 25.7-38.7%
§8.1: replay methodology uses random prompts with recorded token counts and simulated tool waits; single model GLM-4.7 (358B) on a 3-node GB200 cluster
§2.5: Continuum, CacheWise, and MORI are cited and critiqued as prediction-based, but only MORI is evaluated in §8; no head-to-head with TTL-style policies
§8.4 Table 5: integration across six harnesses (Codex, SWE-agent, OpenCode, Hermes, Agent-G, OpenClaw) requires 14-162 manager lines plus 12-54 function lines
§8.5: overhead quantified (<100us per primitive, ~350ms per 256K-token KV-scope mapping, estimated 2.0% of average 19.96s LLM call)
No code/data availability statement; Agent-X and Agent-G traces are internal to 'a large cloud provider' and not releasable
llm_evaluation.rationale: Systems paper on lifecycle-aware KV cache management for ReAct LLM agents; squarely in scope for the highest-weighted preferences (LLM serving, agents/tool use, inference efficiency, long-context memory). The harness-to-cache lifecycle export via eight message-level primitives plus state-prioritized admission with MRU in the suspended tier is a coherent, moderately novel contribution — the individual mechanisms (state machine, MRU) are simple but well-motivated by trace analysis (zombie KV up to 36.3%, 71-95% wrong-direction LRU evictions). Evaluation is fairly rigorous: three workloads (two production traces + Codex/TerminalBench), five load points, two baselines, clean two-way ablations isolating lifecycle tracking and recency optimization, integration measurement across six harnesses (26-216 LOC), and overhead quantification (~2.0% of LLM call time). Deductions: prediction-based baselines (Continuum, CacheWise) are criticized in §2.5 but never compared head-to-head; replay uses synthetic random prompts with recorded token counts on a single model (GLM-4.7); cost is estimated from DeepSeek pricing rather than measured; all workloads are coding agents, limiting breadth; no artifact/code release and the two production traces are internal and unavailable, hurting reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Capture the lifecycle: KV Cache management in ReAct Agents with KVTether

papers.summary: Efficient serving of long-context reasoning-and-acting (ReAct) agents relies on KV cache reuse to reduce large language model (LLM) prefill latency and monetary cost. However, a semantic gap exists between agent harnesses and the underlying serving stack. Through context mutation, tool execution, and subagent coordination, context messages may become actively engaged, permanently discarded, and temporarily unused, while the serving stack only observes accesses to the corresponding KV cache. This
papers.summary_zh: ReAct 代理在數十至數百輪推理與工具呼叫中，脈絡可累積至數十萬 token，KV 快取重用因此成為降低 prefill 延遲與成本的關鍵；但代理框架與推論服務堆疊之間存在語意落差。框架以訊息層級操作（append、replace、remove、fork、one_off 等）決定訊息的邏輯生命週期，而底層只看到 token 前綴與快取分頁，無法分辨 KV 是仍在使用、永久捨棄或暫時閒置。作者以雲端業者兩條生產軌跡與 Codex 基準分析，發現兩種失效：一是生命週期結束後仍占位的 zombie KV，在 LMCache 中最高占 36.3% 容量；二是 LRU 的錯誤方向驅逐，71.0–95.0% 的驅逐把較晚才會重用的 KV 留下、反而趕走較早重用的 KV。KVTether 透過八個訊息層級語意原語在框架端輸出生命週期事件，由事件驅動管理器將訊息事件轉譯為 KV 生命週期狀態（Pinned、Active、Suspended、Expired、Temporary），再由狀態優先的快取引擎先繞過或回收已死 KV，並在 Suspended 層內採用 MRU 以因應不確定的重用間隔。在 12 張 GB200 的三節點叢集上，相較 LMCache 與 MORI，端到端延遲最多降低 26.3% 與 17.4%，估計任務成本平均降低 40.0% 與 33.2%；整合至六個代理框架僅需 26–216 行。限制在於 MRU 僅為方向性啟發式、仍非精確預測，且部分軌跡事件為離線重建；其貢獻在於指出生命週期語意必須由應用層輸出，而非由下層推測。
papers.title: Capture the lifecycle: KV Cache management in ReAct Agents with KVTether

links.title: When a Kindergartener Solves Calculus: Measuring Capability Leakage in Role-Prompted Reasoning Models

evidence: Section 3.1: RoleCapBench contains 1,568 four-option multiple-choice questions uniformly sampled at 392 per level across Elementary, Intermediate, High School, and A-Level, sourced from NYSED Grades 3–8, Regents, and A-Level exams.
Section 5.1 / Table 3: Under Identity, above-role accuracy is 0.844 (Gemma), 0.898 (Qwen), 0.811 (OLMo) while role voice scores are 1.389/1.504/1.218, evidencing RCL.
Section 6.1: Injection reduces AA relative to Identity by 0.346 (Gemma), 0.371 (Qwen), 0.562 (OLMo), but IA drops by 0.042, 0.058, and 0.370 respectively, showing model-dependent overconstraint.
Section 4.1 / Appendix E: RV, CC, and RC are scored 0–2 by a single automated judge (GPT-OSS-20B, temperature 0) with no human validation of judge agreement reported.
Section 5.5 / Figure 4: Two larger Gemma variants (26B-A4B, 31B) show comparable task accuracy across the role ladder, indicating scaling does not mitigate RCL.
Limitations: conclusions scoped to English educational assessments, one benchmark composition, three open-weight checkpoints, and prompt-conditioned inference-time interventions.

Abstract footnote: 'All artifacts including scripts and evaluation data will be released upon acceptance' — conditional artifact availability; Appendices C–F provide full prompt templates, grading rules, and sampling parameters.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences: it studies reasoning LLMs under role prompting with CoT-style variants, an LLM-judge evaluation, capability-control/sandbagging implications, and an inference-time prompt-based intervention. The identified phenomenon (role-capability leakage) is a genuinely fresh angle separating role voice from capability ceilings, and the curriculum-grounded RoleCapBench gives a defensible capability boundary definition. Rigor is solid: 1,568 curated MC questions, 3 similar-scale open-weight models, 8 prompt ablations, explicit TA/IA/AA decomposition, reported per-role standard deviations, and detailed grading rules. Key quantitative claims check out internally (e.g., AA reductions of 0.346/0.371/0.562 for Injection in Section 6.1 match Table 3). Weaknesses: qualitative RV/CC/RC metrics rely on a single unvalidated 20B judge with high variance (RV std up to 0.823), no statistical significance testing, the mitigation is a somewhat incremental guidelines-plus-prefill combination with model-dependent failures (OLMo IA collapse of 0.370), and generalizability is admittedly narrow (English educational assessments, three checkpoints, one benchmark composition). Artifacts are only promised 'upon acceptance', slightly limiting reproducibility despite full prompt templates and sampling parameters in Appendices C, E, F.

primary_link.title: When a Kindergartener Solves Calculus: Measuring Capability Leakage in Role-Prompted Reasoning Models

papers.summary: We investigate the problem of role-capability leakage (RCL), in which a role-prompted reasoning model generates convincing in-role text while continuing to exhibit capabilities on benchmarks that exceed those implied by the assigned role. For example, when a model is prompted to assume the role of a kindergarten student, one might expect its performance on a mathematics benchmark to reflect kindergarten-level ability rather than expert-level proficiency in solving calculus problems. We introduce
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出「角色—能力外洩」（role-capability leakage, RCL）此一被忽略的現象：被指派角色的推理模型雖能產出語氣與身分相符的文字，卻仍展現超出該角色應有水準的答題能力。作者以標準化教育評量建構 RoleCapBench，涵蓋幼兒園、小學、國中、高中、大學與大學教師六種角色，以及小學至 A-level 四個課程層級，共 1,568 題四選一英文選擇題，並設計八種提示變體，藉由任務準確率、角色內準確率、角色外準確率，以及由 GPT-OSS-20B 評分的角色語氣、能力一致性與推理連貫性進行評估。實驗顯示，Gemma-4-E4B-IT、Qwen3.5-4B 與 OLMo-3-7B-Think 在單純角色提示下角色語氣分數約 1.218–1.389，但角色外準確率仍高達 0.811–0.898，即使明示要求對齊角色能力水準也僅能微幅改善。作者因此提出推論時介入法 Injection，結合角色專屬能力準則與預填回覆前綴；結果可將角色外準確率最多降低 0.562，且多數模型角色內準確率僅下降不到 0.058。限制在於僅涵蓋英文教育類選擇題、三組開放權重模型與固定評判協定，OLMo 更出現過度拒答；但其揭示角色提示僅是軟性先驗，對角色模擬、教育應用與代理系統安全俱有警示意義。

links.title: Explore-on-Graph: Hybrid Embedding-LLM Reasoning for Knowledge Graph Question Answering under Incompleteness

evidence: Abstract: XoG recovers missing reasoning paths from learned graph structure; combines type-level entity-relation statistics with KG embeddings, LLM as semantic selector; claims up to 33% token reduction vs planning-based approach.

Section 4.1: Incompleteness protocol IKG-20/40/60/80% removes crucial triples following GoG; KGE retrained on pruned graph; datasets WebQSP, CWQ (Freebase) and BRINK (Wikidata5m); code at https://github.com/colab-nyuad/XoG.

Table 1 (Sec 4.2): XoG GPT-3.5 Hits@1 83.7 WebQSP CKG / 77.6 IKG-40% vs PoG 82.0/69.7 and GoG 78.7/66.6; GPT-4 XoG 85.7/83.5; CoT-without-KG baselines (76.0/54.1 for GPT-3.5) used to argue gains are not parametric memorization.
Table 2 (Sec 4.4): total tokens per question reduced up to 33% vs PoG on WebQSP IKG-40% (8,409 vs 5,634); ~12s per question with KGE scoring only ~0.3s.
Table 4 (Sec 4.6): ablations show w/o Link Prediction drops 83.7->76.2 (CKG) and w/o Relation Selection 83.7->82.9 (CKG) but 77.6->73.8 (IKG-40%); acknowledged non-monotonic IKG-40/80 result.
Table 6 (Appendix B): retrieval gaps account for 84-93% of errors across sparsity, selection errors 6-16%, supporting the claim that retrieval quality is the bottleneck.
Table 7 (Appendix C): six backbones (GPT-3.5, Qwen3-32B, LLaMA-3.3-70B, GPT-4, GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8) with no single model best on both datasets.
Table 5 (Sec 4.7): on BRINK incomplete XoG F1 0.52 vs PoG 0.34, StructGPT 0.40; but StructGPT 0.81 beats XoG 0.71 on complete graphs, and supervised GNN-RAG 0.68 remains higher.

Limitations: synthetic incompleteness may not reflect real-world patterns; ComplEx chosen for efficiency; applying XoG to a new KG requires accessible entity-type information for the co-occurrence matrix.
Appendix A: ComplEx trained with LibKGE, ~5 hours on one NVIDIA A100 on Freebase; co-occurrence matrix built in a linear pass, supporting offline-cost claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM methodology paper: LLM+KG multi-hop QA addressing incompleteness via embedding-based link prediction and type-relation co-occurrence statistics rather than LLM-generated facts, with the LLM as pruning/selection agent in a planning-exploration-reasoning loop. Preference relevance is high (LLMs, RAG/knowledge grounding, reasoning/CoT, agents, prompting all central). Novelty is moderate: the loop and sub-question tracking are explicitly borrowed from PoG (Sec 3.3, 3.5), and the core contribution is a sensible hybrid of KGE link prediction (ComplEx), type-statistics relation curation, and hierarchical bucket prompting rather than a new paradigm. Rigor is solid: controlled incompleteness protocol (IKG-20/40/60/80 following GoG, Sec 4.1), ten baselines across supervised and training-free regimes, six backbones (Appendix C), module-level ablations (Table 4), sensitivity analyses (Tables 3, 5/Fig 5), efficiency accounting (Table 2), and error decomposition (Table 6); but no variance or significance testing, some baselines copied from GoG, and the non-monotonic IKG-40%>IKG-80% ablation is only hand-waved. Evidence is mostly consistent with claims (33% token reduction matches Table 2; BRINK caveat about StructGPT beating XoG on complete graphs is honestly reported in Sec 4.7), though PoG incompleteness numbers are own reruns and figure-derived sparsity curves are approximate. Generalizability is moderate: validated beyond Freebase on Wikidata-based BRINK, but requires KG entity-type structure for the co-occurrence matrix and synthetic incompleteness protocols (Limitations). Reproducibility is good: public repo, KGE training details (LibKGE, A100, ~5h, Appendix A), bucket size and module specs given, though full prompts live in the external repo.

primary_link.title: Explore-on-Graph: Hybrid Embedding-LLM Reasoning for Knowledge Graph Question Answering under Incompleteness

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly combined with knowledge graphs (KGs) to ground reasoning in structured evidence. However, most LLM-based KGQA methods rely on traversing existing graph edges and become unreliable when reasoning paths are broken by missing facts. Alternatives that ask LLMs to generate missing knowledge risk introducing hallucinated evidence. We introduce XoG (eXplore-on-Graph), a framework for multi-hop question answering over incomplete KGs that recovers missing rea
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理的是知識圖譜問答（KGQA）在圖譜不完整時的可靠性問題。現有 LLM-based KGQA 多半依賴沿著既有邊進行圖走訪，一旦多跳推理路徑上的關鍵三元組缺失，走訪就會提早中斷；另一類做法是讓 LLM 直接生成缺失事實，卻會引入幻覺或過時資訊。作者提出 XoG（eXplore-on-Graph），改用「圖譜接地」的復原策略：以型別層級的實體—關係共現統計篩出可能關係，並以知識圖譜嵌入（ComplEx 搭配連結預測）取回可能缺失的尾實體，再讓 LLM 扮演語意篩選者與推理者，整個流程嵌在迭代式的 planning–exploration–reasoning 迴圈中。為了控制候選膨脹帶來的雜訊，作者提出階層式分桶提示策略，把龐大的候選關係集切分後分別剪枝再合併，並用 DistilBERT 對實體候選做語意過濾。實驗在 WebQSP、CWQ 以及 Wikidata 為基礎的 BRINK 上進行，依 GoG 的協定以 IKG-20% 至 80% 移除關鍵三元組。結果顯示 XoG 在完整圖上仍具競爭力，在圖譜不完整時則穩定優於同樣不做 KGQA 任務專屬訓練的方法；此優勢跨多個 LLM backbone 成立，顯示單靠更強的 LLM 無法解決圖譜證據缺失，同時相較最接近的 planning 方法 PoG 最多可減少約 33% 的 token 消耗。消融顯示移除連結預測的影響最大，而錯誤分析指出剩餘錯誤主要由檢索缺口而非 LLM 選擇失誤造成。限制在於復原模組依賴 KGE 品質與實體型別資訊，且評估所用的不完整性屬合成式移除，未必反映真實世界的長尾與類別不均缺失。
