links.title: Who Owns That? Evaluating Ownership Intuitions in Large Language Models

evidence: §2.2: 109 recruited, one excluded after failing an attention check, leaving 108 participants and 4,536 complete allocations
§2.3: 24 LLM configurations, five valid responses per configuration per scenario, yielding 5,040 checked allocations
§3: human-model similarity 0.6982 vs human-human 0.7002; model-model similarity 0.8290 with Holm-adjusted p<0.001 for both comparisons
§5: creator allocation decrease from grass to gold is 43.13 points in humans vs 21.04 in models (difference 22.09, 95% CI [15.61, 28.61])
§7: limitations state participants recruited in China, everyday-object scenarios, five responses per configuration constrain distribution estimates, and judgments are untested in realistic settings
Appendix C.1-C.2: table of model identifiers and inference settings plus verbatim system and user prompts provided
Appendix A: only one representative example per scenario type (13 types) is shown; the full 42-scenario set is not enumerated and no code or data availability statement appears
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM evaluation research: benchmarks 24 LLM configurations (GPT-4o mini, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, open-weight models) against 108 humans on a new 42-scenario Competing Ownership Attribution Task, directly serving pluralistic/distributional alignment and LLM-as-benchmark interests (§1, §2). Novelty is solid but not groundbreaking: the ownership domain is fresh, while the measurement machinery (TV distance, energy distance, distributional alignment framing) adapts established work (Meister et al., Santurkar et al.) cited in §6. Rigor is strong: pre-specified 100-point allocation task, attention checks, Holm-corrected sign-flip tests, bootstrap CIs, robustness to response averaging, within/across-model distance decomposition, and separate PCA spectra (§3, Appendix D). Evidence is quantified (human-model similarity 0.6982 vs model-model 0.8290; context deltas with CIs in §5), but only five samples per configuration per scenario limit distributional estimates (acknowledged in §7), and the consensus-classification procedure is described only at a high level (§2.4). Generalizability is constrained: single-country (China) recruitment, everyday-object scenarios, confounded context comparisons, and untested downstream behavior (§7). Reproducibility is partial: verbatim prompts and full inference-setting tables are provided (Appendix C), but only representative examples of the 13 scenario types appear (Appendix A) and no code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Who Owns That? Evaluating Ownership Intuitions in Large Language Models

papers.summary: Ownership establishes rights over the use, control, and transfer of objects. Understanding these relations is essential for AI systems to interact appropriately with people and their resources. Yet how large language models (LLMs) attribute ownership under competing claims remains unclear. We introduce the Competing Ownership Attribution Task (COAT), comprising 42 scenarios, and compare ownership allocations from 24 LLM configurations with those of 108 human participants. Overall, human-model si
papers.summary_zh: 當多個人都對同一物件提出合理主張時，所有權該歸屬於誰？這個問題對必須使用、分享或處置資源的 AI 代理至關重要，但大型語言模型（LLM）在相互競爭的主張下如何歸屬所有權，仍不清楚。作者提出「競爭性所有權歸屬作業」（Competing Ownership Attribution Task, COAT），涵蓋 42 個日常情境、五大衝突結構與 13 種情境類型，並以 100 點分配方式同時施測 108 位在中國招募的人類參與者與 24 種 LLM 設定，共取得 4,536 與 5,040 筆有效分配。研究以 total variation 距離衡量人機相似度，以 energy distance 比較反應分布，並將各情境的人類與模型反應分類為全域共識、局部共識與分散反應，另比較相關情境間的脈絡敏感度。結果顯示，人機相似度（0.6982）接近人與人之間（0.7002），但模型彼此更為同質（0.8290），且在單一答案中把點數分得更平均，正規化熵平均為 0.788，高於人類的 0.506；模型出現全域共識的情境較多（28 對 18），局部共識較少（5 對 14）。當人類形成不同觀點群時，模型可能只收斂到其中一方或落在兩者之間；當人類有共識時，模型反而可能分裂。脈絡比較亦顯示差異：材料價值上升時，模型對創造者的分配下降幅度小於人類；在後手獲得公開認可的情境中，模型提高分配而人類略降；對陪伴機器人與植物等對象的排序也與人類相反。限制包括參與者僅來自中國、情境多為日常物品、相關情境同時變動多項特徵、每組設定僅五次取樣，且取樣參數與推論通道差異使結果無法歸因於訓練本身。本研究的重要性在於指出，整體相似度會掩蓋反應多樣性與脈絡依賴性的落差，對多元對齊（pluralistic alignment）評估提供不預設單一共識的基礎。
papers.title: Who Owns That? Evaluating Ownership Intuitions in Large Language Models

links.title: Learning When and How to Intervene: A Hindsight-Distilled Sentinel for Coding Agents

evidence: Abstract: reports 'gains of up to 14% and 10%' on SWE-bench Verified Mini and Ask or Assume across sentinel scales and coding-agent families (Qwen3-Coder 30%→44%, 23%→33%).

Section 3 & Appendix A.1 (Tables 5-6): SWE-Intervene has 6,923 instances from Open-SWE-Traces/SWE-Hero/SWE-chat; two-stage human audit rejected 570/2,252 (25.3%) intervention candidates; de-duplication against all downstream benchmarks is claimed.

Section 5.2 Table 3: in-domain M-F1 81.77 (1.7B) vs 25.78-29.94 for post-hoc baselines; OOD results are weaker (RootSE T@0 9.80; R-Judge BAcc 66.14), showing a large but narrower transfer gap than the in-domain headline.

Section 5.3 Table 4c: removing distillation drops SWE-V Mini resolution 44→34 and causal teacher 36 despite 'smaller gaps in static F1'; no confidence intervals or significance tests on the 50-task benchmark (Section 5.1).
Section 5.4.2: verifiable negative analysis — cross-step KV caching flips 13/896 routing calls and reduces resolution 22/50→18/50, so full-prefix recomputation is retained.
Section 5.4.1: intervention-quality accounting (109/242 beneficial, 45.0%, vs 1.1% for SWE-PRM) supports the claim that gains reflect quality, not frequency.

Appendix A.2 Table 7: complete hyperparameters (LoRA rank 32, AdamW betas, seeds, LR schedules, DPO β=0.1) specified, but the document contains no code or dataset release statement, and annotation depends on GPT-5.5 (Section 3).
Appendix A.3: Hard-Pause proxy-user protocol with explicit information boundary; proxy API stated to be available to all baselines.

AI Use Statement: generative AI used for annotation and as LLM judges in evaluation; combined with LLM-labeled routing/feedback data, this creates a potential labeler-evaluator circularity the paper does not quantify.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic agentic-LLM paper: a lightweight (0.6B/1.7B) pre-execution sentinel for coding agents, trained via privileged hindsight distillation plus SFT/DPO feedback, evaluated on SWE-bench Verified Mini, Ask or Assume, and two OOD diagnosis benchmarks. Novelty is moderate: the three-way Allow/Redirect/Hard-Pause formulation, the SWE-Intervene dataset, and the gated hindsight-to-causal distillation (helpfulness gate, generative routing) are new, but the recipe composes known ideas (LUPI distillation, PRM-style critics, DPO). Rigor is solid: five static baselines, three end-to-end critics, eight routing ablations, cross-agent transfer (Qwen3-Coder, Devstral, Sonnet-4.6), and an honest negative KV-caching result; however, the 50-task benchmark yields 2-7 task differences with no significance testing, and in-domain static comparisons partly conflate different tasks. Evidence is detailed and mostly verifiable from the paper, but GPT-5.5 annotation plus LLM-judge evaluation introduces bias risk, and the hindsight labels are acknowledged as judgments rather than measured counterfactuals. No code/data release statement was found, capping reproducibility despite exhaustive hyperparameter tables.

primary_link.title: Learning When and How to Intervene: A Hindsight-Distilled Sentinel for Coding Agents

papers.summary: Coding agents solve repository-level tasks through sequences of actions, where a single erroneous action can misdirect subsequent decisions and increase recovery costs. Existing approaches use execution feedback for recovery or specialized checks to block errors, but deciding before execution whether intervention will benefit eventual task completion remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose HiSentinel, a hindsight-distillation framework that trains lightweight 0.6B and 1.7B sen
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理編碼代理在倉庫級任務中「一步錯、步步錯」的問題。既有做法多依賴執行後的回饋或週期性檢查，但證據顯示失敗往往在早期就已埋下，等到可觀測時已難以挽回。作者把介入時點提前到「動作提出後、環境執行前」，並形式化為三路決策：Allow（放行）、Redirect（保留動作並給予修正指引，讓代理自行重規劃）、Hard-Pause（暫停並向人類索取缺失的資訊、授權或偏好）。核心挑戰在於執行結果正是判斷動作是否恰當的最直接證據，卻在介入當下不可得。為此提出 HiSentinel，用後見蒸餾（HGID）把具特權的教師（可見已記錄的執行結果）之判斷，蒸餾進僅吃前動作情境的輕量因果學生模型，並加上「有用性閘門」與三類別生成式路由，另以 SFT 加 DPO 訓練回饋模組產生可執行的修正建議。資料方面建構 SWE-Intervene，共 6,923 個動作層級實例，經兩階段人工稽核剔除 25.3%。實驗顯示 1.7B 哨兵在域內取得 81.77 macro-F1、78.97 intervention F1，並可外移至 RootSE 與 R-Judge；端到端在 SWE-bench Verified Mini 讓 Qwen3-Coder 的解題率由 30% 提升至 44%，Ask or Assume 由 23% 升至 33%，於 Devstral 與 Sonnet-4.6 亦可見增益。作者亦誠實指出限制：標籤為後見判斷而非反事實量測、介入會增加 token 成本、跨步 KV 快取因截斷而效果有限，故仍採完整前綴重算。

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): maps 348 studies and examines 90 comparison records, 88 from 40 included studies plus two supplementary records

llm_evaluation.rationale: A critical scoping review squarely within scope: it maps 348 LLM-agent studies and analyzes 90 component-replacement comparison records, distinguishing net task-level benefit (Question A) from attribution to local decision quality (Question B). Preference relevance is high given the focus on LLM agents, tool use, routing, monitoring, termination, and evaluation methodology. The A/B framing, the recovery/disruption decomposition, and eight claim-conditional reporting items constitute a distinctive methodological angle beyond prior agent-evaluation surveys, though it is a review rather than a new method and adjacent surveys overlap (Section 1.1). Rigor is strong: documented multi-source search with explicit counts, ten-category coding scheme, adjudicated corrections (108 field corrections across 85 studies), pre-adjudication agreement of 82.7-91.4% (kappa 0.670-0.809), and disciplined statements of what co-reporting counts do not establish. Evidence strength is moderate: case-level claims are tied to quoted numbers with source locations, but the synthesis rests on eight purposively selected cases, cannot estimate prevalence, and the reporting items are explicitly unvalidated guidance. Generalizability is decent because the corpus spans many decision categories and backbones, but the three mechanisms are framed as candidates only. Reproducibility is supported by detailed appendices, logs, and provenance records, though the text names no public artifact URL, and extraction relied on model-assisted streams rather than independent human double coding, which the authors concede. Weighted total is approximately 0.76.

primary_link.title: What Can Component-Replacement Evidence Establish? A Critical Scoping Review of Local Decisions in LLM Agents

papers.summary: Background. A component replacement in a language-model agent changes an execution trajectory, potentially altering later observations, resource use, and recovery opportunities. Different evidence is needed to assess its task-level benefit and the contribution of local decision quality. Methods. This critical scoping review maps 348 studies and examines 90 comparison records: 88 from 40 included studies and two from supplementary studies. Eight purposively selected cases structure the synthesis
papers.summary_zh: 本文是一篇批判性範疇回顧（critical scoping review），關切的核心問題是：當我們替換語言模型代理（LLM agent）中的某個「局部決策」元件（例如監控、路由、停止、預算分配）時，實驗證據究竟能支持哪些推論。作者區分兩個問題：Question A 是「在受測條件下，該替換是否改善任務層級結果」；Question B 是「局部決策品質的變化是否能解釋該結果」。方法上，作者建構 348 篇研究的證據地圖，並以 90 筆比較紀錄（88 筆來自 40 篇納入研究、2 筆為補充研究）進行推論層級的分析，另刻意選取八個案例，依「被替換的決策、實際執行的比較、測量可比性、控制條件、剩餘解釋」五個問題逐一檢視。主要發現包括：222 篇報告了局部決策指標，其中 142 篇同時報告任務終點、49 篇報告代理終點，但共同報告並不代表兩者來自同一組配對比較；Outcome Monitors 支持套件層級的完成率提升，但偵測器品質的貢獻仍無法分離；First-chunk selection 只支持離線代理終點上的局部改善；Evidence-Carrying Termination 支持較少過早且無依據的終止與完成率非劣性，但未確立完成率優勢。作者並提出三個候選機制（救援與干擾、介入時機與可逆性、局部目標與下游使用之落差）以及八項依主張而定的報告項目。限制在於案例為目的性選取、任務與基準線異質，無法估計此類解耦現象的普遍率；本文亦未執行新的模型實驗。其意義在於提醒：線上執行或局部與任務指標同時改善，都不足以證明較佳的局部決策解釋了任務層級的增益，對代理評估設計與部署宣稱具方法學警示價值。
papers.title: What Can Component-Replacement Evidence Establish? A Critical Scoping Review of Local Decisions in LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 元件替換證據能確立什麼？大型語言模型代理中局部決策的批判性範疇回顧

links.title: Inference Auctions

evidence: Abstract: auction 'increases system welfare while maintaining the cache utilization and latency advantages of SGLang'; claims 12-18.6% welfare gain i.i.d. and up to 100% non-i.i.d.
Section 3.1, Theorem 3.1: average-bid DFS schedule maximizes reported welfare among DFS schedules and runs in O(M + n log nu) expected time
Section 3.2, Theorem 3.3: all VCG payments computable in O(min{M, mn} log nu) total run-time, avoiding quadratic per-user recomputation
Section 4, Theorem 4.2: pacing autobidder achieves R(T) = O(poly(C,K,gamma) * sqrt(T)) regret via reduction to Balseiro et al. (Appendix C proof sketch)
Section 4, Theorem 4.4: welfare under heterogeneous pacing bounded by 1/max_u kappa_u using node pacing condition numbers (Definition 4.3)
Section 5 Experiment Setup: SGLang v0.5.17 serving DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B on 80GB H100, Q=1024 queued queries, values from 1+Pareto(1.5), three trials with 1-standard-error bars
Appendix D.8 Table 4: replication on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; 'Welfare agrees to the unit in every experiment'
Appendix D.10: fast VCG algorithm agrees with naive computation to 1e-12; 34 ms vs 370 ms at n=1024
Section 5 / Appendix D.4: stated limitation that on short trees fitting the cache 'This is the one case where the DFS restriction buys nothing and costs 20% of welfare'
Section 7 Conclusion: open problems include multi-worker auction/routing/cache orchestration and collusion-proof design
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-infrastructures/mechanism-design paper squarely in scope: designs the first auction for LLM inference priority, with a welfare-optimal average-bid DFS scheduling rule over the request radix tree, quasilinear-time VCG payments, a pacing autobidding agent with O(sqrt(T)) regret, and a welfare-loss bound under heterogeneous pacing (condition number kappa). Novelty is genuine: prefix-aware KV-cache structure (SGLang) is interlaced with classical priority-auction theory in a way not present in prior LLM-serving or autobidding work, though the underlying tools (VCG, dual-descent pacing) are standard. Rigor is high: formal definitions, full proofs (Appendices A-C), a 50% DFS-restriction approximation guarantee (Prop. 2.4), and a careful VCG counterfactual subtlety (zeroing bids vs. eviction, footnote 4 / Appendix B). Evidence is strong: real SGLang v0.5.17 serving a 32B model on H100, three baselines (dfs-uniform, bid-sort, no-sort), 12-18.6% welfare gains i.i.d. and up to 100% non-i.i.d. with unchanged cache hit rate/TTFT, replication on Qwen2.5-7B (Table 4, welfare agreeing 'to the unit'), fast VCG verified to 1e-12 vs naive (D.10), and an honest limitation that the DFS restriction costs ~20% welfare when the workload fits in cache (Section 5 / D.4). Generalizability is limited by single-worker, saturated-queue, linear-in-fractional-priority value assumptions and exogenous batch formation; multi-worker orchestration is deferred to future work. Reproducibility is decent (public frameworks, models, datasets, detailed hyperparameters) but no code/artifact release is stated and workloads are semi-synthetic with synthetic values.

primary_link.title: Inference Auctions

papers.summary: When inference demand exceeds available compute capacity, model providers must decide which requests should be served first. Users have different tolerances for delay from an LLM API, but current priority pricing schemes compress these differences into coarse fixed-price service tiers. We design an inference auction that allows users to bid for faster service. Our auction allocates priority in an economically efficient way without sacrificing latency, and we develop fast algorithms for implement
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型推論在尖峰時段供不應求，現行做法多以二至三層固定價格服務等級區分優先權，無法反映使用者對延遲的異質偏好，導致優先權配置在經濟上缺乏效率。本文提出首個「推論拍賣」，讓使用者針對「把請求從排隊尾端移到前端」出價，價值隨請求在排程中前移而線性增加。方法的關鍵在於把可行排程限制為請求 radix tree 的深度優先（DFS）遍歷：既保留 SGLang 等前綴感知服務框架的 KV 快取重用效率，又留下調整各節點子樹順序的自由度。作者證明，最大化福利的 DFS 排程只需在每個內部節點依「子樹平均出價」由高到低拜訪子節點，可在 O(M+n log ν) 期望時間內算出；搭配 VCG 付款即可誘因相容。由於逐位使用者重算的樸素作法具二次複雜度，本文將每位使用者的福利外部性拆解為 radix tree 上的區域變化，並透過前綴和與二分搜尋，將所有付款壓到 O(min{M,mn} log ν)。針對跨批次預算限制，作者另設計配速自動出價代理，以梯度下降調整乘數，達到 O(√T) 的後悔界，並證明當同層子樹配速差異反轉 DFS 順序時，福利損失可由節點條件數上界。實驗以未修改的 SGLang 伺服器加一層排程器，在多種共享前綴工作負載上驗證：相較不看出價的具快取最佳性排序，福利提升 12% 至 18.6%，非獨立同分布出價時最高可達 100%，而快取命中率與平均 TTFT 幾乎不變；同時可保有無限制出價排序約八成的福利，後者卻使平均延遲惡化達 12 倍。限制在於請求批次的形成被視為外生、價值對分數優先權的線性假設需實驗支撐，且短樹可完全放入快取時 DFS 限制會白白損失約 20% 福利；多推論工作節點聯合編排、更豐富的延遲偏好與防勾結設計仍待未來研究。此工作示範如何把經濟目標直接嵌入 LLM 服務基礎設施，而不犧牲系統效能。

links.title: Preemptive LLM Unlearning against Forbidden Capability Acquisition via Gradient Sealing

evidence: §3.2: retrospective suppression leaves acquisition open — NPO release ES 0.112 rises to 0.326 and RMU 0.032 to 0.257 after identical acquisition; proxy look-ahead alignment pooled ρ=0.617 positive across all 24 layers; targeted attenuation reduces acquisition gain up to 24.35% (p=10%, α=100%).

§5.2 Table 1/Table 2: GSU ranks first or second in 34 of 36 TOFU model–setting–metric comparisons (e.g., Llama-3.2-1B UA90 27.87 vs 30.52 best baseline) and achieves lowest F5 on WMDP Bio (34.13) and Cyber (30.23) vs No Defense 65.36/43.83.

Appendix F shared analysis protocol: 'All observations are single runs, without multi-seed error bars or significance tests'; frozen configurations were selected using existing B2 attack evaluations and are 'development-stage diagnostics, not independent-test or equal-tuning-budget comparisons.'

§F.2 Table 6: component ablation on Qwen3.5-2B — GSU ES̄5 4.1740% vs without-seal 4.9598%, without-suppression 5.0298%, random gates 5.2196%; without-retain yields zero utility, showing ES must be read jointly with utility.

§5.3 and §F.7: benign learnability retained (validation NLL within 0.005 of No Defense after two economics epochs) and relative protection survives benign fine-tuning (5.063% vs 6.502% ES on Qwen3.5-2B).
Appendix C.1/C.2: Prop. 3.1 proved with explicit second-order remainder; minimal ReLU counterexample shows identical release scores with δ vs 1 projected gradient and ηδ² vs η one-step gain.

Appendix G: limitations acknowledged — local analysis, evaluation restricted to practical downstream fine-tuning rather than arbitrary retraining, and dependence on defender proxy set sharing acquisition pathways with future data.

Appendix D Algorithm 1 plus §E.1–E.5 provide splits, metrics (ES, UA90, UWC calibration to ≥0.95 U_ref), seeds, learning rates, and frozen configurations (Table 4); no code or artifact release statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic LLM safety paper: pre-release (preemptive) unlearning for open-weight LLMs, matching LLM and AI Safety preferences well, with secondary relevance to red-teaming/evaluation and interpretability. The problem formulation (preemptive vs. retrospective unlearning) and the gradient-sealing mechanism (pushing SiLU gate pre-activations into the negative tail to attenuate local gradients) are plausibly novel relative to cited tamper-resistance work. Rigor is solid: formal definitions, a proven one-step acquisition bound with a ReLU counterexample, a motivating failure→prediction→intervention chain, 6 models on TOFU plus Zephyr on WMDP against 8 baselines, component ablations, gate probes, and benign-adaptation checks. Evidence is weakened by single-seed runs with no significance tests (admitted in Appendix F), modest margins over NPO+SAM/ILU on several metrics, disjoint splits that still share authors, and frozen configurations selected using attack evaluations (development-stage diagnostics, also admitted). Generalizability is decent but limited to SwiGLU/SiLU architectures and two benchmarks, with a local, one-step theoretical analysis and reliance on proxy-set pathway overlap. Reproducibility is supported by pseudocode, metric definitions, and extensive hyperparameter detail, but no code/artifact availability statement appears. No instructions found in the paper text.

primary_link.title: Preemptive LLM Unlearning against Forbidden Capability Acquisition via Gradient Sealing

papers.summary: Open-weight LLMs are released not only as fixed products but also as substrates for downstream fine-tuning. This openness, however, creates legal and ethical risks because users may misuse fine-tuning to instill illicit knowledge or enable hostile operations. Model providers therefore need apre-release defense against such acquisition, motivating the problem of preemptive unlearning. Unlike retrospective unlearning, which removes capabilities already present in a fixed model, preemptive unlearni
papers.summary_zh: 開放權重的 LLM 雖便於下游微調與部署，卻也讓惡意使用者能透過微調灌入非法知識或危害性操作能力。既有研究多屬「事後遺忘」（retrospective unlearning），僅移除模型已具備的能力；本文提出「預先式遺忘」（preemptive unlearning），希望模型在釋出前即對未來、未見的攻擊資料與微調流程具備抗性。作者先以理論與實驗說明事後方法的不足：即使釋出時輸出已被壓制，禁用領域資料仍可沿內部路徑產生梯度，使能力日後被重新取得。為此提出「梯度封鎖」原則，將特定閘控的前激活值推入 ReLU 家族（如 SiLU）負尾區，使局部導數趨近零，僅用一階更新即可削弱梯度路徑。方法 GSU 先以可丟棄的複本做代理學習以暴露並定位敏感閘控，再自原始權重重啟，聯合最佳化封鎖損失、回應壓制與保留監督。實驗涵蓋多個 LLM 家族與 TOFU、WMDP 基準，在 Llama3-1B/3B/8B 與 Qwen3.5-2B/4B/9B 上於 36 項比較中多數排名第一或第二，WMDP-Bio 與 Cyber 的領域準確率亦降至最低；元件消融、閘控探針與良性微調測試支持封鎖機制，且在良性適應後仍保有相對保護優勢。限制在於評估僅涵蓋實務微調而非任意重訓，分析屬局部，且防禦依賴代理集與未來資料共享取得路徑，跨領域位移時可能需要更豐富的代理覆蓋。此工作將預先式遺忘形式化為釋出前防禦，對開放權重模型的安全治理具實務意義。
papers.title: Preemptive LLM Unlearning against Forbidden Capability Acquisition via Gradient Sealing
papers.title_zh: 以梯度封鎖實現的預先式 LLM 遺忘：防止下游微調取得禁用能力

links.title: cua-speedrun: Standardized Benchmarking of the Speed of Computer-Use Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'All code, infrastructure, and analysis are available at cuaspeedrun.com'; 'reduces evaluation time on OSWorld by 84.9% while maintaining high correlation'
Sec. 2.2: energy-distance objective (Eq. 2) and K* criterion (Eq. 3) select 50/295 OSWorld, 52/63 OSWorld2, 26/143 CUA-World, 38/184 MyPCBench tasks (Table 13)
Sec. 3.2/Fig. 3: Gemini 3 Flash Preview low→medium effort raises score 33.6%→57.6% while cutting task time 492s→268s
Sec. 3.2/Fig. 5: FastCUA cuts environment processing 12.68s→0.34s but total task time rises 89.5s→99.0s due to pre-update screenshots
Appendix B.4/Table 1: Fast I/O action-to-observation latency 2.4–27.6 ms vs 2.5–3.5 s for Gym-Anything/OSWorld
Appendix G.3/Table 14: held-out rank correlations 0.983 (partial) and 0.975 (exact) at 50 OSWorld tasks; Table 15 shows energy selection MAE 4.42 vs 5.08 stratified random and 8.08 IRT-inspired
Appendix F/Table 11: five-seed GPT-6 Astra (low) score 90.82±1.79%, time 89.54±2.16 s
Appendix H/Table 18: 295/369 tasks included via unanimous 3-reviewer rule, Cohen's kappa 0.939–0.983
Appendix I/Table 19: CUA-AutoDebug detects 11 input failures; corrected runtime passes all 470 tests
Appendix L/Fig. 18: automated selection search drives validation error to 0.01 but held-out error stays 3.90→4.00, an honest negative result
Appendix A: limitations note API conditions at evaluation time and that subsets may require revalidation as agent capabilities change
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant to Agents & Tool Use and LLM evaluation preferences: a standardized platform benchmarking speed/cost/performance of LLM-driven computer-use agents, with direct analysis of reasoning-effort settings (more reasoning can reduce task time; Fig. 3) and LLM serving latency. Novelty is moderate: benchmark subsetting builds on tinyBenchmarks/IRT work and speed measurement follows OSWorld-Human, though the energy-distance selection, common agent interface, and the counterintuitive FastCUA finding (faster I/O raising task time from 89.5s to 99.0s, Fig. 5) are useful contributions. Rigor is high: leave-one-agent-out validation with Spearman >=0.95 (Table 14), five-seed repeatability (90.82±1.79%, Table 11), baseline comparisons of selection methods (Table 15), reviewer agreement stats (Table 18), and an honest negative result on automated selection search (Appendix L). Evidence is dense, quantitative, and internally consistent across 56 configurations, though Pareto findings are tied to the evaluated (as-yet-unverifiable) model set, limiting generalizability slightly. Excellent reproducibility: public code/infrastructure, listed task IDs, fixed seeds, and detailed appendices.

primary_link.title: cua-speedrun: Standardized Benchmarking of the Speed of Computer-Use Agents

papers.summary: Computer use agents (CUAs), which use graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete tasks on a computer, have recently surpassed human performance on many standard benchmarks, including difficult long-horizon tasks. Their capabilities are undoubtedly impressive, however, a key barrier to the widespread adoption and deployment of CUAs remains their speed and cost. Progress towards faster yet capable CUAs requires reliable evaluation of their speed, but many CUA benchmarks currently face a reproduc
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出，電腦操作智慧體（computer-use agents, CUA）雖已在 OSWorld 等基準上超越人類表現，但部署時真正的瓶頸是速度與成本，而現有 CUA 基準因基礎設施、容器組態與 API 介面各異，難以公平比較執行速度，形成可重現性危機。作者提出 cua-speedrun，將所有評估統一跑在 Modal 沙箱的同一個虛擬機與執行流程上，並設計共用 agent 介面，讓單一 agent 實作可跨不同基準運作；同時以能量距離最小化挑選具代表性的任務子集，在維持模型排序的前提下大幅縮短評估時間，例如 OSWorld 的評估時間減少 84.9%。他們在 OSWorld、OSWorld 2.0、CUA-World 與 MyPCBench 上評估數十種模型、harness 與推理強度設定的組合，繪製效能—時間與效能—成本的前沿。主要發現包括：沒有任何單一模型家族同時在三項指標領先，開源權重模型皆未進入前沿；提高推理強度有時反而降低完成時間，因為可避免反覆失敗的操作；而加速環境 I/O（FastCUA，延遲降至毫秒級）竟使總任務時間變長，因模型尚未學會配合更快的桌面更新節奏。限制在於時間與成本反映評估當時的 API 條件，子集需隨模型能力變化重新驗證，且未窮盡所有組態組合。此工作把評估焦點從單純成功率轉向速度與成本效率，對 CUA 的實務部署具重要意義。
