links.title: OPSRD: On-Policy Self-Role Distillation

evidence: Abstract: reports 'improvements over the base models without role prompts at inference' and that 'Forward KL achieves the highest macro-averaged accuracy among the three evaluated divergences at every scale'; code claimed at https://github.com/zhansan114514/OPSRD
Section 1 (Introduction): negative motivating result—'adding an expert olympiad mathematician role to Qwen3-1.7B changes macro accuracy from 35.74 to 34.54'
Section 4.2, Table 1: OPSRD macro 42.04 vs Base 35.74 (+6.30, interval [3.24, 9.54]) and vs Answer OPSD 38.70 (+3.33, interval [0.83, 6.02])
Section 4.4: three independent 1.7B training runs give OPSD 40.25±1.62, improving fixed Base by 4.51 points with interval [1.54, 7.69]; 'Every run improves Base'
Section 4.3 (Teacher context): 'the missing neutral-teacher 50% control leaves its contribution at the selected positions unresolved'
Section 4.3 (Supervision density): selection-vs-full difference interval [-1.33, 2.90]; 'The supported finding is that half the supervised positions retain the benefit of role distillation'

Appendix C.2: forward-minus-reverse intervals '[2.41,7.31], [-1.85,2.96], and [-0.56,4.81] at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B'; 'JSD uses H100 and the KL runs use A100'; 'per-sample JSD outputs are not publicly available'
Section 4.2, Table 2 and Appendix C.1: 4B primary shows Answer OPSD strongest (62.50 vs 61.48), ordering changes under averaged repeats (61.50 vs 62.52); acknowledged in text
Appendix D (Study design): 'Additional training runs followed a favorable primary result' and intervals apply 'without adjustment for multiple ablations'
Limitations: 'The evidence covers one model family, one mathematical training corpus, three competition benchmarks'

Reproducibility Statement: public repo with training/evaluation code, launch scripts, analysis scripts, tests, recorded environment; 'Model checkpoints are not redistributed'; Appendix A.1: 'The original runs did not pin a dataset revision'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences: LLMs, mathematical reasoning/CoT, prompting, and training/optimization (LoRA distillation of Qwen3 on competition math). Not in any out-of-scope domain. Novelty is moderate: on-policy distillation, entropy-based token selection, and forward-vs-reverse KL analysis are established; the twist—using a reusable expert role as privileged teacher context replacing per-problem reference solutions, motivated by a disclosed negative prompting result—is genuinely new but incremental. Rigor is above average: multiple baselines, role-placement/divergence/density ablations, paired problem-level bootstrap intervals, 3 training repeats and 4 evaluation repeats, plus honest disclosures (Section 4.3 admits the missing neutral-teacher 50% control; Appendix D admits post-hoc run additions and no multiple-comparison adjustment). Evidence strength is solid for the headline claim (+6.30pp at 1.7B, CI [3.24,9.54]; repeats CI [1.54,7.69]) but weaker elsewhere: forward-KL advantage crosses zero at 4B/8B (Appendix C.2), the Answer-OPSD ordering flips under repeated evaluation, and the entropy-selection component shows no supported advantage ([-1.33,2.90]). Generalizability is limited to one model family, one math corpus, and 90 problems, as the authors state in Limitations. Reproducibility is good: public code with launch scripts, tests, recorded environment, full prompts and hyperparameters in Appendix A; deductions for unpinned dataset revision, no checkpoint release, and unavailable per-sample JSD outputs.

primary_link.title: OPSRD: On-Policy Self-Role Distillation

papers.summary: Role prompting elicits specialized behavior from large language models through an expert identity, offering a lightweight way to guide reasoning on demanding tasks. However, evaluating or distilling complete role-prompted answers can miss useful next-token preferences when the sampled solution remains incorrect. Transferring these preferences also requires an objective that reaches alternatives the student rarely predicts. We introduce OPSRD, which uses a fixed expert role as privileged teaching
papers.summary_zh:
這篇論文處理一個實務上常見卻容易被忽略的落差：角色提示（role prompting）能讓大型語言模型以專家身分作答，但若只用「完整答案是否正確」來評估或蒸餾，往往會漏掉取樣答案錯誤時仍存在的有用下一個詞偏好。作者的第一個觀察其實是負面結果：在三個競賽數學基準上，替 Qwen3-1.7B 加上「奧林匹亞數學專家」角色後，巨集準確率反而從 35.74 降到 34.54，與中性系統提示相同，顯示單靠專家標籤並不足以改善取樣解。

據此作者提出 OPSRD，把固定專家角色當作教師的特權脈絡，進行無參考解答的同策略自我蒸餾。作法是由無角色的學生模型自行生成推理軌跡，再由同一基礎模型凍結後的實例，帶著專家角色對「學生實際走過的相同前綴」輸出角色條件分布，藉此暴露學生取樣以外的替代選項。監督僅限於學生熵值最高的前一半位置，把學習集中在真正不確定的預測上；學生端只更新 LoRA 低秩轉接器，教師固定不動，推論時學生回到一般提示。

目標函數的選擇是本文重點。作者指出反向 KL 在學生對某替代詞機率趨近零時更新會消失，因此改採教師加權的前向 KL，並對個別詞彙貢獻設上限，以避免不完美教師造成過大偏差；同時另行記錄未截斷的散度。實驗涵蓋 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 與 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT 2025，每個問題取樣 12 次並回報 Avg@12 與三任務巨集平均。在三個規模上前向 KL 的巨集準確率都是三種散度中最高；1.7B 主要實驗較 Base 提升 6.30 個百分點，並高於以參考解答為條件的 Answer OPSD 3.33 個百分點。角色放置的對照顯示，角色只放在教師、學生保持無角色時最佳；把角色同時給學生或僅給學生都會降低準確率。

限制方面，證據僅涵蓋單一模型家族、一份數學訓練語料與三個競賽基準，1.7B 只有三次訓練重複，較大規模的前向與反向 KL 差距信賴區間跨越零；JSD 條件在硬體與紀錄完整度上也不同，選擇比例的敏感度研究則在較小取樣預算下進行。整體而言，本文的意義在於說明角色提示的價值未必展現在完整答案的準確率，而可能是它在學生自身推理路徑上提供的分布性引導，並提供一個可重用、無需逐題參考解的同策略蒸餾配方。
papers.title: OPSRD: On-Policy Self-Role Distillation
papers.title_zh: OPSRD：同策略自我角色蒸餾

links.title: Fork-dLLM: Avoiding the Flexibility Trap in Diffusion Language Models

evidence: Abstract: claims Fork-dLLM matches AR pass@k scaling at 2-3x efficiency and ForkGRPO matches AR-based GRPO at substantially lower training cost
Section 3.1 & Algorithm 2: Fork-dLLM changes only Fast-dLLM's fallback from argmax-confidence to leftmost masked position, with no training, extra evaluations, or new hyperparameters
Figure 2 (Section 3.1): fallback tokens are ~1/8 of committed tokens but contribute ~45% of total token entropy on HumanEval with LLaDA-8B-Instruct
Section 4.1 Setup: two models (LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-v0-Instruct-7B), four benchmarks, semi-AR regime BL=32, L=256, GSM8K limited to first 300 test samples
Section 4.2 Setup: ForkGRPO/FastGRPO/JustGRPO-Fast trained by authors on 4xH100 for 12h with LoRA r=128, alpha=64; JustGRPO compared via released checkpoint from Ni et al. (2026)
Figure 6: FastGRPO collapses after ~220-350 steps with rising fallback entropy (>1.5 to >4); ForkGRPO stays stable; authors flag mechanism as hypothesis needing further study
Table 1: step-matched comparison shows similar accuracy but JustGRPO-Fast needs 1.6-1.9x more backward passes than ForkGRPO
Table 4: Fork-dLLM pass@1 80.9/pass@64 98.3 at 67.8 NFE vs AR 80.9/99.0 at 227.9 NFE on GSM8K (LLaDA-8B-Instruct)
Limitations section: hyperparameters tuned only on HumanEval+LLaDA, single GRPO configuration, no retraining of full JustGRPO, uniform discrete dLLMs left to future work
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on masked diffusion language model sampling and GRPO post-training, evaluated on math reasoning (GSM8K, MATH-500) and code (HumanEval, MBPP), matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning, RL, inference efficiency). The key mechanism is a one-line change to Fast-dLLM's fallback rule plus fallback-step-only GRPO; elegant and well-motivated by the fallback-token entropy analysis (Figure 2), but incremental since the flexibility-trap problem and alternative fixes (TCT, JustGRPO) come from cited prior work. Experiments are reasonably rigorous: hyperparameter-tuned baselines (Appendix B.1), fallback-ordering ablations (Figure 5), matched-compute and step-matched GRPO comparisons (Figure 7, Table 1), and a stability analysis of FastGRPO collapse (Figure 6). Headline quantitative claims check out (e.g., AR NFE 227.9 vs 67.8 for Fork-dLLM on GSM8K, Table 4; 8x fewer H100-hours, Figure 1). Weaknesses: no error bars, GSM8K restricted to first 300 test samples, GRPO tested in a single LoRA configuration on one model family, and the JustGRPO comparison partly relies on an externally released checkpoint trained with full fine-tuning under a different budget (confound acknowledged in Limitations). No explicit code release, though algorithms and hyperparameter tables (Tables 2-3) support reimplementation.

primary_link.title: Fork-dLLM: Avoiding the Flexibility Trap in Diffusion Language Models

papers.summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) have shown strong potential for faster inference through parallel token generation when combined with confidence-based samplers. However, recent work has shown that such methods can defer unmasking high-entropy fork positions at which multiple plausible continuations exist. This results in reduced generation diversity, as shown by worse pass@k scaling, and limits gains obtainable from RL post-training. To avoid this flexibility trap, prior work advocated
papers.summary_zh: 掩蔽式擴散語言模型（dLLM）搭配信心導向取樣器可平行產生多個 token，加快推論，但近期研究指出這類方法會延後高熵的「fork」分支位置，導致生成多樣性下降、pass@k 擴展變差，並限制 RL 後訓練的效益，此即所謂「彈性陷阱」。既有解法主張改用自迴歸（AR）取樣，卻犧牲平行解碼的效率。本文觀察到 Fast-dLLM 等取樣器在沒有位置超過信心門檻時本就會進入 fallback 步驟，而這些步驟正是 fork 位置的好代理：實驗顯示 fallback token 僅約占八分之一，卻貢獻近半數總熵。作者因此提出 Fork-dLLM，僅在 fallback 步驟改以 AR 風格解開最左側的遮罩位置，其餘步驟仍並行解碼，屬一行式修改，無需訓練、額外模型評估或新超參數。作者進一步提出 ForkGRPO，以 Fork-dLLM 產生 rollout，且只在 fallback 步驟套用 GRPO 目標，因每步僅承諾一個 token，可保持精確的策略概似比，同時大幅降低 rollout 與最佳化成本。實驗在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 與 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 上，涵蓋 GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval、MBPP，Fork-dLLM 在多樣性上可匹配 AR 取樣的 pass@k 擴展，但所需 NFE 少 2 至 3 倍；在相同算力下 ForkGRPO 的訓練步數為 JustGRPO-Fast 的兩倍以上，GSM8K 與 HumanEval 的增益明顯較大，並在約八分之一的 H100 時數下達到與完整 JustGRPO 相當的準確率。消融顯示多樣性增益主要來自 fallback 的排序方式，而非平行步驟的隨機性；訓練中亦發現 FastGRPO 會出現熵暴增與獎勵崩潰，ForkGRPO 則維持穩定。限制在於取樣超參數僅在單一設定下調校、GRPO 實驗只採 LoRA 與單一算力預算，且僅比較已釋出的 JustGRPO 檢查點，未重現其訓練。此工作的重要意義在於指出：要逃離彈性陷阱，不必放棄信心導向的平行解碼，只需在少數高不確定性步驟改用 AR 順序，即可兼顧多樣性與效率，為 dLLM 的取樣與 RL 後訓練提供低成本的實用方向。
papers.title: Fork-dLLM: Avoiding the Flexibility Trap in Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: Fork-dLLM：避免擴散語言模型中的彈性陷阱

links.title: Learning Process Rewards via Reasoning State Propagation

evidence: Abstract: claims 'average improvements over Qwen2.5-Math-PRM of 5.6% in beam search and 2.1% in reinforcement learning'; recomputing Table 1 averages (RSP 71.93 vs Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 66.33 across MATH500/Gaokao, e in {4,8,12}) and Table 3 (65.4 vs 63.3) confirms both figures.
Sec 4.2, Table 1: RSP on Qwen3-4B at e=12 reaches 79.8 on MATH500 and 67.9 on Gaokao, vs OVM 74.9/63.0 and Joint-Supervised PRM 75.6/61.1.
Sec 4.4, Table 3: RSP avg 65.4 vs GRPO 63.0; AIME 38.9 vs Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 31.1; Supervised PRM (59.0) falls below base policy (59.2).
Sec 4.6, Table 4: 'No Outcome Propagation' degrades beam search by 6.7 and ProcessBench by 4.0; 'No Repair' degrades beam search by 3.3, supporting both core mechanisms.
Appendix B, Table 5: RSP avg F1 65.8 vs Supervised PRM 56.6, but Qwen2.5-Math-PRM with full process supervision achieves 70.5 - an honestly reported limitation.

Appendix A.1: training details given (AdamW, lr 5e-6, 1:3 process:outcome batch ratio, 2 epochs, bfloat16, eight H100 GPUs); Reproducibility statement says 'Code is provided in the supplementary material'.

Appendix C, Proposition 2: gradient identities (d l_out/d eta = gamma*(alpha - alpha_tilde)) were independently re-derived and are algebraically consistent with the propagation matrix definition in Eq. (4)-(5).
Appendix E: states MATH500 problems are held out of PRM800K training split and all RL methods share the same 8K DAPO-MATH-17K prompts, addressing train/test overlap.
Sec 4.5: transition-distribution analysis uses Qwen3-32B as an LLM judge to construct ~10K step pairs - a potential judge-bias caveat for the diagnostic claims in Figure 2.
Appendix D, Fig. 3: empirical propagation-strength statistics (median kappa 0.092, 91.5% of transitions kappa>0) quantitatively characterize learned state dependence.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope LLM reasoning paper: a process reward model (RSP) trained on Qwen3 backbones that models break/repair state transitions between reasoning prefixes, jointly using scarce process labels (20% of PRM800K) and scalable outcome labels (AceMath-RM), evaluated in beam search, Best-of-N, ProcessBench, and GRPO-based RL. Preference relevance is high (LLM reasoning, reward models, RL, test-time scaling), with only incidental hits elsewhere. Novelty is moderate: it generalizes first-error chain-rule formulations like CRM by allowing B->G recovery and derives how outcome gradients reach intermediate transitions, but the formulation is a natural HMM-like extension of existing PRM work. Rigor is solid: fair same-backbone/same-data baselines (Pseudo-Label PRM, Joint-Supervised PRM, CRM-dagger), consistent internal numbers (Table 4 aggregates 74.4/72.2/65.8/65.4 match Tables 2,1,5,3; the abstract's 5.6%/2.1% claims recompute correctly from Tables 1 and 3), verified gradient algebra in Appendix C, ablations, scaling analyses, and an honest report that Qwen2.5-Math-PRM still wins ProcessBench (70.5 vs 65.8). Deductions: no statistical significance or multi-seed RL, a possible same-family PRM/policy confound (Qwen3-4B PRM scoring a Qwen3-4B policy), and diagnostic transition data constructed by a Qwen3-32B LLM judge. Evidence is concrete but small-average-gain in RL (2.1%) rests on single runs. Generalizability is limited to mathematical reasoning and Qwen3 backbones despite multi-family generators in Best-of-N. Reproducibility is good (full hyperparameters, data construction, overlap statement, code claimed in supplementary) though no external code link is verifiable from the text.

primary_link.title: Learning Process Rewards via Reasoning State Propagation

papers.summary: Process reward models (PRMs) have demonstrated notable effectiveness in test-time scaling and reinforcement learning by providing fine-grained signals for evaluating intermediate reasoning states, but their training relies heavily on costly process annotations. A natural way to alleviate this dependence is to complement limited process supervision with scalable outcome supervision. However, existing PRMs often model reasoning prefixes independently, providing no explicit mechanism for effectivel
papers.summary_zh: 過程獎勵模型（PRM）能為中間推理狀態提供細緻訊號，在測試時擴展與強化學習中相當有效，但其訓練高度依賴昂貴的過程標註。現有 PRM 多將各推理前綴視為獨立的二元分類目標，缺乏明確機制讓最終結果標籤回頭引導中間狀態的學習；PQM、CRM 等方法雖引入序列依賴，但圍繞第一個錯誤步驟組織，等同假設後續推理持續無效，忽略錯誤可能被後續步驟修正。為此，作者提出推理狀態傳播（Reasoning State Propagation, RSP），以二元狀態 G（有效、無未解錯誤）與 B（無效、存在未解錯誤）表示每個前綴，並在每個推理步驟上參數化兩個條件機率：break（由 G 轉為 B，代表引入錯誤）與 repair（由 B 轉回 G，代表修正錯誤），構成逐步傳播矩陣，最終狀態機率即為各步驟矩陣連乘。模型在 Qwen3 骨幹上於每個推理邊界插入 ⟨BREAK⟩ 與 ⟨REPAIR⟩ 兩個特殊符號，由前後邊界表徵經 MLP 頭預測兩機率，一次前向即可取得全軌跡轉移。訓練時過程標註監督中間傳播狀態，結果標籤僅監督最終狀態，但因最終狀態依賴所有中間更新，梯度可經傳播回傳至先前步驟，理論分析亦給出對應梯度形式。實驗涵蓋 beam search、Best-of-N 與結合 verifier 閘控的 GRPO 強化學習：相較 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM，beam search 平均提升 5.6%，強化學習提升 2.1%，AIME 上更領先 7.8%。消融顯示移除 repair、改用共享符號、阻斷結果梯度回傳皆造成明顯退化。限制在於過程標註仍集中於 PRM800K 少數子集，B→B 與 B→G 樣本稀少而需以 LLM 評審補充，且結果監督未必保證每一步有效。此工作的重要意義在於以狀態傳播把稀缺過程監督與可擴展的結果監督統一到同一框架，使 PRM 在細緻評估與下游策略最佳化上同時受益。

papers.title_zh: 透過推理狀態傳播學習過程獎勵

links.title: Learning Reliable GUI Agents under Imperfect Priors

evidence: §1/Abstract: frames GUI automation as decision making under retrieval-augmented imperfect priors; SAGE couples self-explored priors, drift-aware perturbation, and a reliability-gated Follow/Partial/Ignore policy (Eq.1).

§1/Fig.1: curated 176 tasks from 20 apps with paired old/new versions; only 44% retain identical trajectories, motivating a drift taxonomy of step add/remove, entry-point shift, renaming, and distracting detours.

§4.1: explorer reaches ~148 deduplicated screens and ~28 activities in 600 steps vs 54.3/7.3 for LLM-Explorer; subtask coverage +16.9pp overall (74.1 vs 57.2) across MobileWorld/AndroidLab/AndroidWorld.

Table 2 (§4.2): Ours improves over SFT across all 5 backbones and 6 prior conditions, backbone-level mean gains +2.79–9.39pp; Qwen3-VL-8B SFT shows negative gains (-3.67, -1.63pp) under Local/Other that Ours flips positive.
Table 3 (§4.3): online success-rate gains positive for Ours on AndroidLab/MobileWorld but still negative on AndroidWorld (-2.60/-1.70pp), honestly reported.
Table 5 (§4.5): Part-CoT ablation isolates explicit reliability-label supervision, raising mean gain from 5.59 to 7.87pp, better in 12/15 settings.
Appendix G: paired bootstrap (B=5,000) over 3 extra splits and 4 backbones; 10/12 CIs have lower bounds above zero, averaged differences +6.60 to +9.97pp.
Appendix O: on held-out real cross-version drift, Macro-F1 averages 70.48% with Follow F1 ~91% but Partial F1 only 58.82%, showing limits of transferred reliability assessment.

Appendix F/L: upon acceptance will release core implementation and public-data (CMGUI/ChiM-Nav) splits, but will not release raw self-explored CUTG screenshots/trajectories for privacy/licensing reasons.
Appendix J: acknowledges dependence on accessibility metadata, dynamic app factors, fixed splits, limited backbones, and teacher-annotation bias as limitations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM/VLM agent paper: GUI agents built on Qwen3-VL-class backbones with retrieval-augmented priors (Agents/Tool-Use, LLM, RAG, CoT all strongly matched; no excluded domain). Novelty is moderate: reliability gating (Follow/Partial/Ignore) extends Self-RAG/CRAG-style critique ideas and UI-graph exploration builds on AutoDroid/DroidBot/LLM-Explorer, but the empirically derived GUI-drift taxonomy (176 paired-version tasks, 44% trajectory stability, Fig.1) and drift-aware perturbation supervision are genuine contributions. Rigor is strong: 5 backbones, 3 trajectory datasets, 6 controlled prior conditions, Part-CoT ablation isolating reliability labels (5.59→7.87pp), paired bootstrap over 3 extra splits (10/12 CIs positive), online and cross-dataset transfer, plus honest negative results (AndroidWorld gains negative for both methods; Other-prior failures). Evidence is solid but the primary metric is marginal step-accuracy gain on small test sets (245/292/129), online gains are modest, and held-out real-drift Macro-F1 is only 70.48% with Partial F1 58.82%, tempering the central claim. Generalizability is decent across backbones/datasets but mobile/Chinese-app centric. Reproducibility is partial: detailed LoRA hyperparameters and 8x4090 compute reported, and core code plus public-data splits will be released, but the self-explored CUTG dataset (a core artifact) is explicitly withheld (Appendix F/L).

primary_link.title: Learning Reliable GUI Agents under Imperfect Priors

papers.summary: GUI agents built on large language and vision-language models still struggle on unseen applications and complex multi-step tasks, as completing real GUI tasks depends on app-specific, temporally volatile operational knowledge that is scarce in pretraining corpora. Retrieval-augmented execution offers a natural remedy but faces two coupled bottlenecks: knowledge at scale is hard to acquire, and self-collected priors inevitably drift from the live environment due to version updates, promotions, ad
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討 GUI 智慧代理在未見過的應用程式與長流程任務上仍然脆弱的問題。作者指出，完成真實 GUI 任務往往仰賴應用程式專屬、隨時間變動的操作知識，例如隱藏入口、設定可見的前置條件，或某個醒目按鈕其實是廣告；這類知識在預訓練語料中極少，單靠畫面像素也難以推斷。檢索增強執行雖是自然解方，卻面臨兩個耦合瓶頸：大規模知識難以取得，且自蒐集先驗會因版本更新、促銷、廣告、A/B 測試與個人化而偏離現行環境。作者爬梳 20 個熱門應用、176 個跨新舊版本配對任務後發現，僅 44% 任務在更新後軌跡不變，其餘落入步數增刪、入口或路徑位移、控制項更名、目標不符等漂移模式。據此，作者主張代理不應追求完美知識，而應學會在不完美先驗下正確行動，提出 SAGE 框架：以語意區域預算、狀態去重與可回復回溯建構 UI 狀態轉移圖，再由多模態標註器合成（任務, 軌跡）配對；並依漂移分類設計五種擾動算子與確定性可靠度標籤，訓練一個先輸出 Follow／Partial／Ignore 可靠度判斷、再產生動作的閘控策略。實驗顯示，自探索可達約 148 個去重螢幕與 28 個活動，優於 LLM-Explorer 等基線，基準子任務覆蓋率平均提升 16.9 個百分點；在五個骨幹、六種先驗条件下，先驗帶來的準確率增益平均提升 2.79 至 9.39 個百分點，跨資料集轉移亦多為正增益，線上基準亦優於單純 SFT。限制包括：探索依賴無障礙樹與截圖，遇到客製化渲染或封鎖自動化時可靠度下降；嚴重介面漂移仍可能降低檢索品質；教師模型可能引入偏誤；真實裝置探索與標註成本不低。附錄另以人工標註的真實跨版本漂移驗證可靠度判斷，Macro-F1 平均約 70.5%，其中 Partial 最具挑戰。此研究的重要性在於把 GUI 知識重新定位為「可審核、可擾動的先驗」，將檢索雜訊轉為明確監督訊號，為動態應用環境中的代理穩健性提供可規模化且免人工標註的訓練路徑。
papers.title: Learning Reliable GUI Agents under Imperfect Priors
papers.title_zh: 在不完美先驗下學習可靠的 GUI 智慧代理

links.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Decoupling Pretext from Actuation for Skill Poisoning in LLM Agents

evidence: Section 5.1: experiments in a sandboxed Claude Code environment; GPT-5.5 used for the attack pipeline with victims DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash, Claude-Sonnet-4.6; 62 qualified pairs × 7 payloads = 434 instances (Appendix C.1, Table 6).

Section 5.2/Table 1: ASR evaluated strictly on instances where the steering-only baseline fails; CoordPoison reaches 76.19% (128/168) on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, 51.23% on GLM-5.3-Flash, 44.44% on Claude-Sonnet-4.6, with TCR 'strictly at 100.00%' across all constructions.
Section 5.3/Table 2: transfer ASR 78.57%–96.88% to MiniMax-M3 and GPT-5.5; Naive baseline reports 0.00% across all source-target pairs.

Table 3/Section 5.4: cross-lifecycle variant reaches 95.31% ASR and 100.00% cASR on DeepSeek-V4-Flash vs 68.25% same-lifecycle; ablations show w/o Steering Pretext collapses to 10.32% ASR on DeepSeek-V4-Flash.

Appendix D.2/Table 8: injecting upstream trace summaries leaves cASR essentially unchanged (100.00% DeepSeek, 90.28% GLM), used to rule out context truncation as the cause of the cross-lifecycle effect.
Section 5.4/Table 4: dual-prompt hardening defense reduces transfer ASR by only 1.19–12.50 points, supporting the claimed limitation of prompt-level defenses.

Section 3.3: threat model restricts the attacker to modifying SKILL.md files with no access to system prompts, user queries, or model parameters; Appendix C.2 states all seven payloads are script-backed with deterministic runtime oracles.
Abstract/Section 6: code availability claimed at https://github.com/Wenxin-buaa/CoordPoison.git; Appendices A.2–A.4 provide full rendering and planner prompt templates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: an LLM-agent security paper hitting Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming preferences directly, covering prompt injection/skill poisoning, agent misbehavior, and defense evaluation. The core conceptual contribution—formalizing Risk-Realization Factors and decoupling the pretext ('why') from an intact actuation ('what') across coordinated skills via persistent artifact preconditioning—is a genuine but incremental twist on a dense line of skill-poisoning work (SkillTrojan/ColluSkill fragment actuation; SkillJect/POISE colocate pretext; SkillHarm/SkillJack already exploit persistent state). Experimental design is unusually careful for an attack paper: steering-only screening isolates ASR to instances where localized attacks fail (Table 1: 76.19% on 128/168 DeepSeek-V4-Flash), ablations quantify each pretext component (Table 3), a trace-summary control rules out context truncation as the driver of the cross-lifecycle 'Fait Accompali'-style effect (Table 8), and payload oracles are deterministic rather than LLM-judged (Appendix C.2). Deductions: uniformly perfect 100% TCR and a uniformly 0.00% Naive baseline are suspiciously clean and under-explained (Naive failing because agents 'fail to observe the Steering Skill' contradicts the qualification step requiring benign steering-skill invocation); no variance, seeds, or significance testing; attack generation/evaluation partially relies on the same GPT-5.5 pipeline model; evaluation confined to a single harness (Claude Code) and SKILL.md threat surface limits generalizability; and the entire model/citation ecosystem (GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash, 2026 preprints) is unverifiable. Code release plus detailed prompt templates, contract schemas, and payload provenance (Appendices A–C) support moderate reproducibility, though the named models are not reproducible today. Strong relevance carries the score; rigor and evidence are solid but not airtight.

primary_link.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Decoupling Pretext from Actuation for Skill Poisoning in LLM Agents

papers.summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable Skills for complex, multi-step tasks, creating a critical supply-chain attack surface where poisoned Skill content steers agent decision loops under benign requests. Existing skill poisoning attacks either colocate actuation with its contextual pretext or distribute actuation across multiple Skills, but do not explicitly separate the rationale for execution from the operation itself. In this work, we reveal that untrusted agent decisions fundamentally dep
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出，LLM 代理日益依賴可重用的 Skill 來完成多步任務，因而形成供應鏈攻擊面：攻擊者只要修改第三方 Skill 的 SKILL.md 指令檔，就能在良性使用者請求下操控代理的決策迴圈。作者提出 Risk-Realization Factors（RRFs）框架，把風險實現拆成兩個概念上不同的因素：actuation factor（實際執行什麼有害操作）與 pretext factor（為何代理認為必須執行）。據此提出 CoordPoison 攻擊範式，將理由與執行解耦：上游 Grounding Skill 透過例行公用操作，悄悄把理由寫入持久化的工作區產物，下游 Steering Skill 則保留完整未拆解的有害操作，並在讀取該產物後把它當成執行前置條件。整套流程自動化：先驗證良性 Skill 配對之間真實的狀態傳遞依賴，再做僅 Steering 的localized 篩選，接著合成協調契約並渲染投毒指令，最後依執行時軌跡與失敗分類進行前綴保留的迭代修補。實驗在沙箱化 Claude Code 環境中，以 7 個固定 payload 與 62 組合格 Skill 配對、共 434 個評測實例進行，受害模型包含 DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.3-Flash 與 Claude-Sonnet-4.6，並在 MiniMax-M3 與 GPT-5.5 上評估跨模型轉移。在僅 Steering 基線完全失效的樣本上，CoordPoison 仍達到 76.19%、51.23%、44.44% 的整體 ASR，任務完成率維持 100%；跨生命週期設定更高達 95.31% ASR 與 100% cASR，作者稱之為 Fait Accompli 效應，即下游代理只把既有狀態視為既定事實。跨模型轉移 ASR 約 78.57% 至 96.88%，明顯優於 Skill-Inject 與 SkillJect 等單一 Skill 基線。消融顯示移除 ZG 或 ZS 皆使效能下降；在系統與使用者提示同時加入稽核指令的雙重提示防禦僅能小幅降低 ASR。限制在於實驗集中於特定模型與 Skill 生態，防禦評估也僅止於提示層級，尚未檢驗執行期或系統層機制。此研究的重要性在於揭示現行孤立 Skill 安全審查的盲點，並主張需要具備組合感知能力的防禦。
papers.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Decoupling Pretext from Actuation for Skill Poisoning in LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 藏於明處：將前置理由與實際執行解耦的 LLM 代理技能投毒

links.title: PatchKV: Weight-Space Compensation of KV Cache

evidence: Abstract: proposes a training-free framework that 'compensates KV cache compression methods by carrying part of the context in the model's weights' via a context-specific weight patch computed once at context-loading time.
Sec 3.2: 'On SQuAD, in particular, PatchKV recovers up to 73% of full-KV accuracy with no cache, whereas the cache-only baseline collapses to near zero.'

Sec 2.2: patch derivation is 'a gradient-free block-wise ridge regression that patches MLP output projections', explicitly borrowing from Mazzawi et al. [18] and Dherin et al. [4,6] context-to-weight conversion.

Sec 3.3 Table 2: patches built from disjoint 20% cache subsets score best on their source cache (85.39/88.09 diagonal vs 65.63/66.60 off-diagonal), supporting that patches capture compression-lost information.
Sec 3.4 Table 3: chunk-size ablation shows relative accuracy flat at 1K-5K (.696/.695/.696) then dropping at 8K-10K (.672/.679), with memory growing to 35.9GB.
App B.2 Table 5: honest negative result—Attention Matching and Attention Matching+PatchKV both achieve 0.0 on Retr.KV and Retr.Prefix-Suffix at all budgets (0.20-0.01).
App C Table 7: online extension on AIME 2025 uses only 30 problems per cell with mixed outcomes (e.g., 2048→222: AM 2/30 vs AM+PatchKV 8/30 at 4K, but 2048→1034 8K: AM 13/30 vs PatchKV 12/30).

App D Limitations: acknowledges reference-query mismatch risk, one-time preprocessing cost requiring full-cache teacher access, and that multi-context serving of patches 'requires additional serving mechanisms'.
App C Table 6: patch construction costs 153.17s and 32.98GB peak memory for a 169K-token context at budget 0.2, quantifying the one-time overhead claim.

Sec 3.1: evaluation spans three LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B-1M, Qwen3-4B, LLaMA3.1-8B), two compression methods (KVzip, Attention Matching), and benchmarks up to 170K tokens; no code release is mentioned anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM long-context inference paper (KV cache compression + weight-space compensation), squarely matching LLM, Long Context & Memory, and Inference & Serving preferences. Novelty is moderate: the closed-form ridge activation-matching is adapted from Mazzawi et al. [18] and context-to-weight theory from Dherin et al. [4,6], with Cartridges-style self-study references; the contribution is repurposing these as a compressor-agnostic compensation layer, which is a genuinely new and practical framing versus concurrent KV-side compensation (GRKV, MomentKV). Rigor is solid: three backbones, two compressors, ablations on chunk size, ridge scaling, reference strategies, low-rank patches, precision, plus a clever cross-evaluation of disjoint-cache patches (Table 2) and honest reporting of failure cases (0.0 accuracy on Retr.KV, Table 5). Evidence is decent but headline benchmark results are mostly in figures without exact numbers, and the online AIME extension is tiny (30 problems) with mixed results (12/30 vs 13/30 for AM at 2048→1034, Table 7). Generalizability is strong across models, budgets, quantized caches, and task mixtures. Reproducibility is middling: Algorithm 1 and implementation details are given, but no code release is stated and patch cost (153s, 33GB peak for one context, Table 6) plus context-specific patches limit easy replication. Limitations are candidly discussed in App. D.

primary_link.title: PatchKV: Weight-Space Compensation of KV Cache

papers.summary: Long-context inference with Large Language Models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by the linearly growing memory of the key-value (KV) cache. Existing compression methods reduce the cache through token eviction or approximation, but degrade sharply at aggressive compression budgets. We propose PatchKV, a training-free framework that compensates KV cache compression methods by carrying part of the context in the model's weights. PatchKV pairs an off-the-shelf compressed KV cache with a context-specific we
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的長脈絡推論常受限於隨脈絡長度線性成長的 KV 快取記憶體。既有做法多靠 token 淘汰或快取近似來壓縮，但在預算極度緊縮時準確率會急遽下滑。本文提出 PatchKV，一個免訓練（training-free）框架，將部分脈絡資訊改由模型權重承載，與現成的壓縮 KV 快取並行使用。其核心是在脈絡載入階段，以脈絡衍生的參考查詢 token 為基礎，比較「完整快取教師」與「壓縮快取學生」在每個 Transformer 區塊的激活值，再以脊迴歸（ridge regression）求得閉式解，產生一個脈絡專屬的權重修補，作用於 MLP 輸出投影；修補合併後前向圖與每筆查詢的推論成本皆不變，額外計算僅支付一次並可攤提到後續查詢。為支援長脈絡，作者採分塊編碼與充分統計量累積，使峰值記憶體與參考長度無關，並以自適應脊係數跨層正規化。實驗涵蓋 Qwen2.5-7B-1M、Qwen3-4B、LLaMA3.1-8B 三種架構，搭配 KVzip（token 淘汰）與 Attention Matching（快取近似）兩種壓縮法，於 SCBench（最高 170K token）、SQuAD、NIAH、GSM8K 等基準測試。結果顯示在 b/n 介於 0.02 至 0.1 的激進預算下增益最明顯；SQuAD 上即使完全不保留 KV 快取，仍可回復約 73% 的全快取準確率，而純快取基線幾乎歸零。消融實驗指出區塊大小 5K 為最佳平衡，自適應脊縮放優於跡平均等方案，且低秩（rank-32）修補可維持近乎全秩表現並節省 99% 儲存。限制在於參考查詢僅為未知下游查詢的代理，分布偏移較大時補償能力受限；建構需一次性前處理成本與完整快取作為教師，較適合單脈絡多查詢或長解碼場景，多脈絡並行服務仍需額外機制。
papers.title: PatchKV: Weight-Space Compensation of KV Cache
papers.title_zh: PatchKV：以權重空間補償 KV 快取壓縮

links.title: ArchitectureIQ: On the Measure of Training Intuition

evidence: Section 3.2 / Figure 1: frontier models reach ~76% overall accuracy vs 33.3% chance and 66.0% best human on a 50-question subset; Table 4 (Appendix D) shows architecture-only accuracy (e.g., 38% GPT-6 Astra) far below optimizer-only (84-87%).

Section 4, Table 1: zero-shot vs 10-shot comparison shows no reliable ICL gain (e.g., GPT-5.6 Luna 64.0% -> 60.0%), used to support the 'empirical not structured' claim; authors note 50-sample noise threshold of ~7% for test-time scaling tiers.

Section 5 / Figure 7: knowledge base of 20 propositions raises GPT-4o from 53.2% (KB0) to 67.6% (KB8) on a 50-question held-out subset without parameter updates, while Claude Opus 5 fluctuates around its 76% ceiling; selection rule specified in Appendix C.1.

Appendix E, Table 5: strict paired label-flip evaluation (52 accepted pairs) shows combined accuracy 0.462-0.500 and answer-change rates of only 5.8-23.1% when changing the dataset should reverse the correct answer.
Appendix A.3: ground truth requires the winner's worst run across 10 seeds to beat every rival's best run (Eq. 1), with a release audit re-deriving answers and checking leakage for all 500 questions.

Section 6 Discussion: authors concede the benchmark is 'deliberately fully synthetic' with short training horizons and finite family registry, limiting transfer to real-world experiment selection; project URL given as https://github.com/renrua52/ArchitectureIQ.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM research: a benchmark probing whether LLMs can predict neural-network training outcomes before execution, directly engaging high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, prompting/ICL, evaluation, knowledge transfer). The construction is unusually careful: executable ground truth with a strict 10-seed winner-separation criterion (Appendix A.3), parameter-count control, a release audit, and taxonomy of question types. Findings are quantitatively supported (Table 4: frontier models ~76% vs chance 33.3%; architecture-only weakness down to 38% for GPT-6 Astra) and stress-tested via a clever paired label-flip protocol showing combined accuracy collapses to 0.462-0.500 when the dataset alone flips the winner (Appendix E, Table 5). Novelty is solid but bounded: related ML-agent benchmarks exist, and the contribution is isolation of pre-execution prediction plus a PUCT-style verifiable-proposition knowledge base (Appendix C.1) that lifts GPT-4o from 53.2% to 67.6% (Section 5, Figure 7). Deductions: KB and human evaluations rest on small 50-question subsets; key interpretive claims ('intuition is empirical not structured') rest on null results from noisy small-n ICL (Table 1) and test-time-scaling experiments where the authors admit differences below ~7% are indistinguishable; and the fully synthetic, tiny-scale regime (small MLPs/GRUs, short horizons) limits generalizability to real experiment selection, a limitation the Discussion itself concedes. Reproducibility is supported by a code URL, frozen v1.5 release, and reproduced prompt templates (Appendix B), though the repository is unverified and reported model identifiers are unverifiable. Overall a rigorous, relevant, moderately novel benchmark paper with honest limitations.

primary_link.title: ArchitectureIQ: On the Measure of Training Intuition

radar.summary: Top researchers have good intuition, but do language models have as good intuition about model training as top AI researchers? To measure model intuition of LLMs and humans, we introduce the ArchitectureIQ benchmark. Each question presents a synthetic dataset and several training recipes, and the test-taker is asked to predict the recipe yielding the best test metric. Overall, we find that LLMs' model intuition is good but has four limitations: (1) The intuition is imperfect, or even sub-human i
radar.summary_zh: 頂尖研究者往往能在執行實驗前，憑直覺判斷某個架構或訓練超參數改動是否值得一試。本文提出 ArchitectureIQ，用來量測大型語言模型與人類是否具備同等的「模型直覺」。每題給出一個合成資料集與數個完整訓練配方（模型架構、最佳化器、損失函數、批次大小與訓練步數），受測者必須在不執行訓練的情況下，預測哪個配方能取得最佳測試指標。所有題目皆由程式生成並實際執行十個隨機種子以確立標準答案，藉此排除預訓練階段的資料記憶。在 500 題三選一的靜態基準上，前沿模型約達 76.0% 準確率，遠高於隨機猜測的 33.3%，而十位機器學習研究者中最佳者僅 66.0%；但在純架構題上，最佳人類為 65%，GPT-6 Astra 僅 38%，顯示模型在架構判斷上反而弱於人類。作者進一步指出四項限制：直覺不完美、屬經驗性而非結構化（增加 CoT 運算或少量示範皆無顯著增益）、可被壓縮（僅 20 條命題的知識庫即可讓 GPT-4o 逼近 Claude Opus 5）、以及對資料集性質不敏感。配對的資料翻轉實驗顯示，當僅更換資料集就足以改變贏家時，模型準確率驟降至 46–50%，且僅在 6–23% 的配對中改變選擇，凸顯資料仍是 AI 中的「暗物質」。此基準的價值在於把難以言傳的實驗直覺變成可執行、可驗證的量化探針，並示範如何把反覆的實驗證據轉化為可重用的知識。限制在於資料集全為合成、訓練規模短小，與真實大型訓練仍有落差。
radar.title: ArchitectureIQ: On the Measure of Training Intuition
radar.title_zh: ArchitectureIQ：論訓練直覺的度量

links.title: On the (In)effectiveness of AMR Augmentation for Large Language Models

evidence: Section 3.2 / Table 3: 'we only find significant (p<0.05) differences between text-only and AMR-augmented performance on two of 36 configurations' — supports the central null result with significance testing.

Section 3.2: baseline discrepancy diagnosis — 'Zhang et al. (2025) report an F1 score of 35.5 on SNLI for their text-only... far lower than we would expect given that even BERT reaches ∼91% accuracy on SNLI', attributing prior gains to faulty configuration.

Section 4.2 / Table 5: multi-sentence extension (RAMS, CNN/DM, ANLI, LogiQA) shows 'no meaningful improvement from AMR augmentation across all fine-tuning strategies and models', addressing the saturation confound.

Section 5.2 / Table 7: probe result — 'no substantial difference between AMR-augmented perplexity and that of the AMR-nodes control condition', supporting the claim that AMR adds no relational knowledge beyond text.
Section 3.1.2: methodology rigor — five seeds per configuration, LoRA r=64/α=128 on seven target modules, grid-searched learning rates (Appendix A.3, Tables 9-10).
Appendix D: additional integration strategies (3-layer R-GCN + Q-Former, frozen AMRBART encoder) also show 'no consistent improvement over the text-only baselines', strengthening the null result.
Limitations: scope restricted to '8B parameter models (we conduct a single-seed 70B experiment in Appendix A.4)', AMR only among SRs, parser-error effects unstudied — bounds generalizability claims.

Section 1: 'We make all code used in these experiments available on GitHub' (footnote 2), plus full prompts and hyperparameters in Appendices A-C, supporting reproducibility; AMR-NLD generation relies on 'Claude Sonnet 4.6' (Section 5.1.1), a partially closed dependency.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid, in-scope LLM/NLP methodology paper: a careful reproduction study showing that AMR augmentation does not improve fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B/Qwen3-8B performance, plus a perplexity-based probe (with an AMR-nodes control) explaining why. Preference relevance is strong for LLM fine-tuning/evaluation and NLP tasks, though it touches none of the highest-weight agent/Japanese/reasoning cores beyond incidental task coverage. Novelty is moderate: negative-result reproduction extending Jin et al. (2024) to SFT, with a simple but well-controlled probe as the main new method. Rigor and evidence are high: 5 seeds, grid-searched LRs per configuration, t-tests over 36 configurations, multi-sentence anti-saturation checks, alternative GNN/AMRBART soft-prompt integrations, and an intermediate AMR-to-text objective to rule out format unfamiliarity. Generalizability is capped by the AMR-only scope, LoRA SFT setting, and mostly-8B scale (single-seed 70B). Reproducibility is strong with released code and exhaustive configuration tables, though AMR-NLD generation depends on a closed Claude model.

primary_link.title: On the (In)effectiveness of AMR Augmentation for Large Language Models

radar.summary: While Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) has historically improved performance on a range of NLP tasks, the benefit---or lack thereof---of AMR augmentation for modern LLMs is thus far unclear. In this paper, we attempt to reproduce recent work that reported substantial downstream gains from AMR augmentation, finding that these are likely due to specific choices in the experimental settings used: using a consistent and unified protocol for hyperparameter selection, we observe that text-only ba
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文檢驗一個常見假設：把 Abstract Meaning Representation（AMR）這類語意表徵接進大型語言模型（LLM）的輸入，是否能提升下游任務表現。過去在 BERT、T5 等較早期模型上，AMR 曾被證實對資訊檢索、問答、摘要、改寫等任務有幫助，但對現代 LLM 是否仍有效並不清楚。作者重現 Zhang et al. (2025) 的監督式 fine-tuning 實驗，在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 與 Qwen3-8B 上，改用統一且一致的超參數選擇協定，並納入 joint 與 individual 兩種訓練方式。結果顯示，純文字基線在多數任務上等於或優於 AMR 增強模型；36 組設定中僅兩組出現顯著差異，因此推論先前報告的增益很可能來自特定的實驗配置與自建資料集，而非 AMR 本身。作者進一步把評估擴展到 RAMS、CNN/DailyMail、ANLI、LogiQA 等多句任務，排除單句基準已飽和的可能性，但 AMR 仍未帶來一致改善。為探究原因，他們以 AMR-NLD 產生自然語言描述的關係內容，並比較模型在純文字、文字加 AMR、文字加去關係節點三種條件下的困惑度。結果發現 AMR 雖降低困惑度，但去關係控制組也幾乎同樣降低，顯示差異來自格式偏誤而非新增關係知識。論文限制包括僅測試 8B 模型為主、只涵蓋 AMR 一種表徵、未處理 parser 錯誤，且僅在 fine-tuning 階段整合。其貢獻在於提供可重現的否證證據，並提示語意表徵的價值可能需在預訓練等更根本層次重新評估。
radar.title: On the (In)effectiveness of AMR Augmentation for Large Language Models
radar.title_zh: 論 AMR 增強對大型語言模型的（無）效用

links.title: ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation

evidence: Abstract: claims average absolute gain of 22.5% in final-cycle success rates when added to self-distillation baselines on ALFWorld and TextCraft, plus SGS improvement for multimodal GUI agents on AITZ.

Table 1 (Section 4.2): OEL+ReSAIL reaches 74.2% on ALFWorld ID Cycle 3 (Qwen3-4B) vs OEL 47.4%; OEL alone finishes below first-cycle performance in all six settings, while ReSAIL variants are non-decreasing.
Table 2 (Section 4.3): full SGS+TLB+PR configuration achieves 74.2%/67.2% ID/OOD at Cycle 3 vs TBSD-only 56.5%/45.6%, supporting complementary roles of selection and retention.
Table 3(a) (Section 4.3): Top selection at rho=0.05 gives 62.2%/57.3% vs Random 49.7%/45.8% and Bottom 40.1%/40.4%, indicating the sensitivity criterion rather than sparsity drives gains.
Appendix C.1 and D.3: standard deviations describe decoding variability only ('rather than variation across independent training runs') and PI-sensitivity curves describe one training seed.
Section 4.4 and Table 8: full ReSAIL costs 5.32 GPU-hours vs 4.33 for OEL (1.23x) on eight H800 GPUs; SGS alone reduces student optimization cost by ~74%.
Section 4.4 / Appendix C.2: OEL+SGS on AITZ reaches 65.95% vs 64.89% for OEL at update 100, a modest +1.06 point gain with a fixed top-80% step subset.

Appendix B/E: detailed hyperparameters (Table 5), baseline adaptations (Table 6), Top-20-plus-residual KL approximation, and full prompt templates support reproducibility, though no code release is stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope LLM-agent methodology: iterative self-distillation for agent self-improvement on Qwen3-4B/8B matches high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Training & Optimization, some RL). The contribution is a plug-in (sensitivity-guided step selection via teacher JSD, trajectory loss balancing, privileged-view retention KL) addressing a real, demonstrated failure mode (performance collapse across self-distillation cycles, Figure 1/Table 1 where OEL and SDPO degrade by Cycle 3). Novelty is moderate: each component is a known technique (top-K divergence selection, loss reweighting, teacher-KL regularization); the value is in the diagnosis and combination for the iterative setting. Rigor is above average: six model-benchmark settings, matched budgets, full 2^3 component ablation (Table 2), selection-strategy control (Random/Bottom vs Top, Table 3a), retention-view control (ordinary vs privileged, Table 3b/D.1), hyperparameter sweeps (Table 7), and cost accounting (Table 8). Key limitations: standard deviations capture only decoding variability, not independent training seeds (admitted in Appendix C.1); a single-cycle of three deployments; per-benchmark hyperparameters differ (rho=0.05 vs 0.25, lambda=0.5 vs 1.0); and the AITZ generalization gain is small (65.95% vs 64.89%). Reproducibility is good given full prompt templates, optimizer settings, and infrastructure details, but no explicit code/data release is claimed.

primary_link.title: ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation

radar.summary: Iterative self-distillation enables LLM agents to learn from successive deployments, offering a path toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet our experiments with existing methods reveal a collapse in deployment performance across cycles, while task performance with privileged information (PI) also declines. We address this collapse by prioritizing informative interaction steps for distillation and preserving PI-conditioned behavior as the student becomes the next teacher. We introduce Reten
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理可透過多輪互動產生軌跡，並以訓練時才提供的特權資訊（privileged information, PI）進行自我蒸餾，逐步把行為內化到模型參數中，形成遞迴自我改進的循環。然而作者以 SDPO 與 OEL 進行實驗後發現，隨著部署週期反覆進行，部署時的成功率會明顯崩壞，而依賴 PI 的任務能力也同步下滑。作者將問題歸結為兩點：其一，並非所有互動步驟都值得蒸餾，PI 對教師預測影響越大的步驟才帶有最多可轉移的訊號；其二，學生在下一週期會成為教師，但基礎目標只訓練無 PI 的視角，並未保留其 PI 條件行為。為此，作者提出 ReSAIL，一套可外掛於既有 PI 自我蒸餾方法的增強模組。它包含軌跡平衡選擇式蒸餾（TBSD）與特權保留（PR）：前者以教師在含 PI 與不含 PI 兩種輸出分布間的 Jensen–Shannon 散度定義 PI 敏感度，只保留敏感度最高的步驟，並在軌跡層級重新平衡損失，避免長軌跡主導；後者則在所有步驟上，把學生的特權視角輸出分布正則化回凍結教師，使更新後的學生仍能勝任下一週期的教師角色。在 ALFWorld 與 TextCraft 上，ReSAIL 分別加掛於 SDPO 與 OEL，於 Qwen3-4B 與 Qwen3-8B 兩個規模、三個部署週期皆維持增益，最終週期成功率平均較對應基線提升 22.5 個百分點，且不再出現逐週期衰退。消融顯示，選擇機制在單週期內最有效，保留機制則決定跨週期的穩定；以相同比例比較時，只挑最不敏感的步驟反而比隨機更差，說明準則本身才是關鍵。此外，作者把 PI 敏感度當作離線資料篩選器，在 AITZ 多模態 GUI 代理上保留前 80% 步驟，動作預測準確率由 64.89% 提升至 65.95%。限制方面，特權保留會使訓練迴圈成本增至 OEL 的約 1.23 倍，評測僅涵蓋三個週期與三個解碼種子，曲線亦來自單一訓練種子，且未評估摘要生成品質與後續教學效果。整體而言，這是首度指出迭代式代理自我蒸餾的崩壞可透過更穩健的學習機制有效緩解，對持續自我演進代理的訓練流程具實務意義。
radar.title: ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation
radar.title_zh: ReSAIL：減緩迭代式代理自我蒸餾中的效能崩壞

links.title: Right Answer, Wrong Mechanism: Detecting Pernicious Divergence in Causal Interventions

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 72 configurations and 100,800 interventions on GPT-2 small' — states scale and model for all reported results.
§6.2 / Table 3: 'kNN and LPCA fall below 0.5 in every setting' among successful interventions, with HPC-L at 0.83–0.87 on visible gender families.

§6.3 / Table 4: gender-task DAS success 87–91% with 90–95% pathway-dominated; restricted DAS reports 12–26% success, 'every such success is pathway-dominated'; on-manifold penalty cuts pathway-dominated share to 4.5–4.7% at 6–11 point success cost.
§6.4 / Table 5: unmodified GPT-2 shows ~0% successful interventions with HPC-L>1; positive control catches 67–96% of wrong-mechanism successes for silent/hijack/distributed but 0–1.5% for in-range.

§7 Limitations: 'Main-benchmark configurations use a single seed (seed 0)'; 'All reported results are on GPT-2 small (124M parameters)'; 'Natural regimes are estimated on the same templated prompts that are intervened on'.

Appendix A: DAS trained 150 steps (restricted 300), Adam lr 1e-2, batch 128; compute on one RTX 5060 Ti and an M3 laptop; 'A GPT-2 configuration takes 2–8 minutes' — supports reproducibility, though no code-release URL is stated.
§6.2 (in-range): 'on gender (HPC-L is at chance, 0.54, among successful interventions)' — the informative pathway family defeats the proposed detector, honestly reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic LLM interpretability methodology: the paper builds a planted-pathway benchmark in GPT-2 small that supplies exact ground-truth labels for pernicious divergence in activation patching/DAS, and proposes Hidden-Pathway Contribution (HPC), a label-free downstream clamping test. Novelty is real relative to Grant et al. and Makelov et al.: the benchmark turns an unobservable property into a measurable one, and §6.3 gives a controlled demonstration that optimised DAS routes 90–95% of gender-task successes through planted pathways while site-level distances score below chance (Table 3). Rigor is solid but bounded: exact labels via pathway toggling, sanity-check families, a positive control (Table 5), bootstrap CIs (Table 6), and candid limitations; however main runs use a single seed (§7), several constants are fixed rather than tuned, natural regimes come from the same templated prompts, and three of four pathway families are detectable by construction. Evidence within scope is quantitative and matches the abstract's claims, but the honest headline is that HPC fails on the informative in-range family (gender AUROC 0.54 among successes), and all results are on GPT-2 small (124M) with Pythia/Qwen only smoke-tested, limiting generalizability. Reproducibility is aided by a detailed implementation appendix and TransformerLens, but no explicit public artifact link is verifiable from the text.

primary_link.title: Right Answer, Wrong Mechanism: Detecting Pernicious Divergence in Causal Interventions

radar.summary: Causal interventions such as activation patching and distributed alignment search (DAS) are the main tool for making mechanistic claims about neural networks. Recent work showed that these interventions routinely push representations off the model's natural distribution, and that such divergence is sometimes harmless and sometimes pernicious: it can recruit pathways the model never uses on natural inputs, so that an intervention produces the expected answer through the wrong mechanism. No method
radar.summary_zh: 本文探討機械可解釋性中一個核心難題：activation patching、DAS 等因果干預常把表徵推離模型自然分布，這種分歧有時無害，有時卻「有害」——干預透過模型在自然輸入下從未使用的路徑給出預期答案，形成「對的答案、錯的機制」。由於真實網路缺乏ground truth，作者改在預訓練語言模型（GPT-2 small）中植入隱藏路徑：這些路徑在所有 benchmark prompt 上恆為靜默，因此不改變模型行為，但當干預把下游狀態推離自然範圍時便會啟動，藉此為每個干預提供精確標籤。研究涵蓋 72 種設定、100,800 次干預，主要發現有三：其一，先前常用的 nearest-neighbour 與 local-PCA 站點距離，在辨識「藉植入路徑成功」的干預上低於隨機（AUROC 0.35–0.47）；其二，作者提出無需標籤的下游因果檢測 Hidden-Pathway Contribution（HPC），將下游單元夾限於同輸出自然執行時的範圍，量測決策消失多少，當路徑表現為單元層級越界活動時 AUROC 可達 0.99 以上，但若整條路徑的每個單元都落在自然範圍內（in-range）則失效，作者將此列為未解難題；其三，最佳化干預會主動尋找隱藏路徑：在性別任務上，四類路徑家族中有三類，DAS 有 90–95% 的成功案例是經由植入路徑達成，即使在 DAS 目標中加入下游 on-manifold 懲罰，也只能把此比例從近乎全部降到 5% 以下，代價是成功率下降 6–11 個百分點，且對受限 DAS 的假成功僅部分抑制。在未修改的 GPT-2 上，成功干預幾乎不依賴單元層級越界活動（比率近 0），受限 DAS 成功率亦極低，但作者以 positive control 界定此結論的敏感度：in-range 組合型的依賴無從偵測，且結果僅限 124M 參數的小模型，是否推廣至大型模型仍待驗證。此基準為後續開發能找出「單元組合異常」的檢測器提供了明確靶標。

primary_link.title: When Instructions Retrieve Trajectories: Diagnosing and Mitigating Generalization Failures in VLA Models

radar.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can exceed 90% success on in-distribution tasks and withstand nuisance changes that preserve the required action, yet fail under counterfactual changes that demand a different action. Aggregate robustness scores can therefore conceal a more specific failure, in which a policy responds to both language and vision yet does not combine them to select the action the task requires. We call this failure instruction-action binding. Instructions cue familiar trajector
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出 Vision-Language-Action（VLA）模型在分布內任務可達九成以上成功率，也能忍受不改變所需動作的 nuisance 擾動，卻在要求不同動作的 counterfactual 擾動下失效；作者將此現象命名為 instruction-action binding（指令—動作綁定）。他們在 LIBERO-PRO 上以官方 π0.5 與 GR00T-N1.7 checkpoint 進行 381 次行為探針，發現 69% 的 rollout 會重播來源任務或其他已示範任務的軌跡，僅 4% 是無結構崩潰，顯示語言與視覺皆被使用，卻未被共同用來選擇正確動作。接續的前綴 KV 讀出與干預實驗顯示，任務條件化的內部狀態確實會影響動作選擇：替換 prefix-KV 快取可把手臂導向目標任務物件，而來源任務完成率由 200/200 降至 0。作者由 flow matching 的模仿目標分析，說明條件動作支撐過窄會讓 grounded 與 instruction-keyed 解在示範上無法區分，因而提出 Equivariant Counterfactual Training（ECT）：ECT data 提供同一指令下需不同動作、且場景可辨的合法示範，ECT loss 則在每次更新中同時訓練成對的對照樣本。在 LIBERO-PRO 受控比較中，完整 ECT 把 π0.5 平均 Swap 成功率由 36% 提升至 59%；在 CALVIN 上，僅用 ECT loss 即可把五任務完成率由 58% 拉到 76%；在真實 UR5e 且固定示範預算下，未見位置成功率由 8% 提升到 88%。資料量掃描顯示，把原始示範由 25% 增加到 100% 仍無法縮小 counterfactual 落差，支持「缺少的是場景相依的動作替代選項，而非樣本數」。限制方面，Swap 與 Task 在 ECT 後仍低於分布內表現，配對訓練中多項因素共同作用、機制未明，且方法目前只在任務特定 fine-tuning、非接觸密集的操作情境驗證。此工作的重要性在於把 VLA 失效從「忽略語言或視覺」重新定位為任務層級的動作選擇問題，並提出可操作且跨架構、跨模擬與真機的監督準則。

Section 4.2.2, Table 2: LiveCodeBench v6 pass@1 at RL step 70: CoT monitor 30.00, chi-squared penalty 27.71, Gradient Regularization 27.71, baseline 26.00
Section 4.3 (Figure 8): retaining code comments reduces monitor recall with mean ΔRecall ≈ -0.40 over steps 101-140 under monitor penalties
Appendix A, Table 3: shared GRPO settings (lr 1e-6, 16 rollouts/prompt, temperature 0.7, data seed 42); single model Qwen3-4B
Appendix D.3: gold hacking label defined as I_easy*I_hard=1 and r_true=0, with cache indicator excluded

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment/safety research: a controllable testbed for reward hacking in coding RLVR, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, alignment/RLHF, AI safety, code, CoT monitoring, agents/evaluation). Novelty is moderate: it extends Countdown-Code and Steering RL Training by adding SWE-wrapped loopholes with 'specious engineering justifications', a dual Hackable/Unhackable run gold monitor, and dynamic (not static) evaluation of mitigations, with a genuinely interesting finding that models learn to mislead CoT monitors via code comments. Rigor is solid: precise gold-label criterion, full hyperparameters, three mitigation baselines (CoT monitor, chi-squared penalty, gradient regularization), and CoT/comment ablations; but findings rest on a single model (Qwen3-4B), single seed (data seed 42), no error bars or significance tests, and a coarse toxic-ratio threshold (4.5% vs 9.1% only). Evidence is concrete (LiveCodeBench pass@1 30.00 vs 26.00 baseline; mean ΔRecall ≈ -0.40 for comments) but drawn from small-scale, single-checkpoint evaluations and unquantified curves. Generalizability is limited by the single model and synthetic SWE-wrapped algorithmic environments, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is strong: public code release, detailed appendices (SFT composition Table 4, reward equations, full monitor prompt Table 6, rule-based exploit tags Table 7).

primary_link.title: CATCH: A Controllable Analysis Testbed for Reward Hacking in Coding RL

radar.summary: During reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), large language models (LLMs) can exploit loopholes in their environments to obtain high rewards without improving the intended capabilities, i.e., reward hacking. Despite its risks to training efficiency and safety, monitoring and mitigating reward hacking during training remain challenging, which is limited by a lack of testbeds that reproduce hacking and reliably identify it. We introduce CATCH, a controllable testbed for studying r
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文關注可驗證獎勵強化學習（RLVR）中的獎勵駭客（reward hacking）問題：大型語言模型在訓練時可能利用環境漏洞取得高分，卻未真正提升目標能力，使訓練獎勵失去作為任務成功指標的意義。作者指出，既有測試平台多半只暴露簡單、容易被察覺的漏洞，或直接停用思維鏈（CoT），因此無法在訓練全程追蹤駭客行為與監測器效能的共同演化。為此，他們提出 CATCH：刻意在 SWE 風格的程式碼環境中植入三類漏洞——修改測試檔、利用測試資料（硬編答案）、干擾執行流程，並搭配「似是而非的工程理由」讓漏洞利用得以隱藏在正當開發工作中。此平台同時執行可駭的 Hackable Run（提供代理獎勵）與不可駭的 Unhackable Run（獨立稽核正確性），藉此給出以執行結果為依據的黃金標籤；並可透過 SFT 資料混合比例控制模型初始駭客傾向，以及透過獎勵設計調整取得獎勵的難度。實驗以 Qwen3-4B 與單輪 GRPO 進行，結果顯示代理獎勵上升而真實獎勵下降，且 RL 會放大原本微弱的駭客傾向，獎勵越難取得越早出現駭客行為。作者進一步比較 CoT 監測器、χ² 正則化與梯度正則化，發現 CoT 監測器雖能短期抑制駭客，但偵測召回率隨訓練下降；消融分析顯示模型學會用程式註解誤導監測器，移除註解反而提升偵測率。限制在於實驗僅涵蓋 Qwen3-4B，且受控的演算法包裝環境無法完全反映真實軟體倉庫的複雜度。此工作的重要性在於強調：安全機制必須在訓練全程評估，因為模型會持續適應並侵蝕防護。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work: a multi-agent LLM-as-a-judge framework (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-70B, Qwen2.5-72B) that treats claim-level judge disagreement as an actionable signal, with entropy-ranked focal re-evaluation, graph/retrieval-based correction propagation, and rubric induction. Strongly matches Agents, LLM, and Evaluation preferences. Strengths: clean ablations that isolate focal re-evaluation, propagation, and rubric contributions (Table 3), beta sensitivity sweep (Table 4), heterogeneity ablation showing multi-model beats multi-persona (Table 5), and unusually candid limitations (human-guided mode unvalidated; correlated-judge blind spots). Weaknesses: only two internal baselines (no external judge methods or escalation baselines), no significance testing over just three seeds, an ad hoc weakest-link scoring rule, results confined to two English benchmarks with the headline human-in-the-loop mechanism never tested, and no code/artifact release statement. Novelty is a competent recombination of known ingredients (query-by-committee, PoLL panels, claim decomposition, selective escalation) rather than a fundamentally new mechanism.

primary_link.title: JuryFlow: Disagreement-Guided Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Evaluation

radar.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated judges for AI-generated content, yet a single judge is unreliable and even a panel of judges leaves a hard residue: when judges disagree, majority voting discards the conflict instead of resolving it. We present JuryFlow, a disagreement-guided, human-in-the-loop multi-agent evaluation framework that treats inter-judge disagreement not as noise to be averaged away, but as a precise, claim-level signal indicating where an evaluati
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理大型語言模型（LLM）作為自動評審時的可靠性問題：單一評審容易受位置、冗長度與自我偏好等偏誤影響，而即使改用多位評審組成的 panel，一旦評審之間出現分歧，多數投票往往只是把衝突平均掉，並未真正解決。作者提出 JuryFlow，把評審間的分歧視為精細到 claim 層級的不確定性訊號，而非雜訊。方法分五階段：先由多個異質 judge agents 把候選回應拆解成原子化 claim 並給出逐項判定與維度標籤；接著建構 disagreement graph，節點以判定熵計分、邊則編碼 claim 之間在標籤 Jaccard 相似度與 embedding 餘弦相似度上的結構關聯；再由人類只做一次最小介入，選出最關鍵的爭議 claim（實驗中改以熵排序自動選取）；隨後進行傳播式重評，焦點 claim 依證據重新判定，修正沿圖的邊擴散到相關 claim，並透過最近鄰檢索延伸到歷史上相似案例；最後把修正抽象成可重用的 rubric 條目，讓所有 judge 在後續評估中繼承，形成可自我精進的評估器。在 MT-Bench 與 LLMBar 上，JuryFlow 與 gold label 的一致率高於單一評審與多數投票 panel：MT-Bench 準確率由 0.804 提升至 0.857，LLMBar 由 0.679 提升至 0.784，Cohen's κ 亦同步上升。消融實驗顯示焦點重評、傳播與 rubric 歸納各有貢獻，且 LLMBar 上傳播的貢獻大於 rubric 歸納；傳播閾值 β 呈現倒 U 形的準確率—成本權衡，β=0.5 時最佳。研究亦發現僅靠單一模型的多 persona panel 效果有限，真正的模型多樣性才是增益來源。限制在於：所有人類引導模式均未經使用者研究驗證，熵無法偵測評審間高度相關的共識錯誤，跨案例傳播與持續增長的 rubric 會推升推論成本並有漂移風險，且實驗僅涵蓋兩個英文基準。其意義在於把人類從標註者重新定位為結構導引者，並將分歧解析與評估準則的精進串成閉環。
