primary_link.title: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs

radar.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly moving toward lower precision to realize the throughput of hardware accelerators, but aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ) can degrade model quality. We present QATFactory, an open-source framework for deployment-aligned quantization-aware distillation (QAD) and reinforcement learning (QARL). QATFactory simulates deployment-time quantization while performing matrix multiplications in BF16, allowing models to adapt to quantization noise
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型推論正朝向低精度發展，但激進的訓練後量化（PTQ）常導致模型品質下降。本論文提出 QATFactory，一套開源的部署對齊量化感知蒸餾（QAD）與量化感知強化學習（QARL）框架。其核心設計原則是「把推論引擎視為數值規格」：針對 NVFP4、MXFP4 與 llama.cpp 的 Q4_K 等格式，以對齊引擎的假量化器重現其可表示值集合、區塊結構、捨入行為與階層式縮放規則，同時所有矩陣乘法仍以 BF16 執行，因此無需原生支援目標格式的硬體，例如可在缺乏 FP4 Tensor Core 的 H100 上進行 NVFP4 訓練。框架涵蓋稠密與 MoE 模型、全參數與 LoRA 訓練，並可將檢查點直接匯出至 vLLM、SGLang 與 llama.cpp，免除額外的有損轉換或推論負擔。作者在 8B 至 230B 參數模型上進行實驗，於生產推論引擎中評估。結果顯示 QAD 在多數格式與模型上穩定優於 RTN 與 GPTQ 等強基準：Qwen3.5-9B 在 NVFP4 下平均準確率達 68.9%，MXFP4 下達 66.0%，分別高於最佳 PTQ 的 65.4% 與 56.4%。研究亦發現最佳訓練策略與格式相關：NVFP4 僅量化權重較佳，MXFP4 則需同時量化權重與激活；rank-16 LoRA 可降低約 2.9 倍 GPU 記憶體，但提高 rank 無法彌補與全參數 QAD 的差距；固定 token 預算下，以較少 32K 序列訓練優於較多 4K 序列，平均提升 1.9 個百分點。NVFP4 QARL 相較 BF16 RL 後接 PTQ，端到端吞吐提升 1.23 倍，五項數學基準平均準確率提升 2.7 個百分點。主要限制在於部分格式與訓練精度的取捨仍屬經驗性解釋，且未涵蓋新興的查表式格式。
radar.title: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
radar.title_zh: QATFactory：對齊部署情境的 LLM 量化感知訓練與蒸餾框架

links.title: No Task Vector Is an Island: A Comprehensive Study on the Composability of Task Vectors from On-Policy Distillation

evidence: Section 3.2, Table 1: within-task TIES merge on Qwen3-4B Code reaches 41.24% vs RL teacher 37.51% (+3.73 pp), with OPD student weaker (37.18%)
Section 3.3, Table 2: OPD compositions beat RL compositions in seven of eight backbone-merging-rule comparisons and show smaller specialist loss in all eight
Section 4.2, Table 5: norm-matched controls on SmolLM3 Code show Raw Sum exceeds rescaled RL/OPD by 1.77/2.07 pp; residual removal costs 2.88 pp but is not norm-matched
Appendix B.4: 'the reported configuration is selected as the best-performing one among the evaluated candidates'—merging configs tuned on the same evaluation results
Appendix B.2: scores are means over three repetitions; the paper states positive mean differences 'do not, by themselves, establish statistical significance'
Section 3.4, Table 4: joint composition avg 33.28% on SmolLM3, but comparison with Open-MOPD baselines uses their avg@64 Math protocol vs this study's avg@8, acknowledged as limiting conclusions
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology paper (task-vector merging of on-policy distillation vs RLVR updates) with strong alignment to LLM, reasoning, code, and agent preferences. Empirically solid: two backbones, five domains, three merging rules, three repetitions, and a norm-matched control supporting directional complementarity. Novelty is moderate—the setting (OPD task vectors) is new but methods are standard (TA/TIES/TSV-M plus geometry diagnostics). Key weaknesses: merging hyperparameters selected on the test evaluation (Appendix B.4), no significance testing (explicitly disclaimed), only one configuration gets the norm-matched control (SmolLM3 Code), and the external Open-MOPD baseline comparison mixes avg@64 with avg@8 protocols (Table 4), limiting cross-study claims.

primary_link.title: No Task Vector Is an Island: A Comprehensive Study on the Composability of Task Vectors from On-Policy Distillation

radar.summary: Task vectors provide a simple mechanism for composing learned capabilities through model merging. However, the composability of task vectors produced by on-policy distillation (OPD) remains largely unexplored. OPD trains a student using teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories, yielding parameter updates that differ from those produced by the teacher model, usually by reinforcement learning (RL). We therefore ask whether OPD task vectors can complement their RL teacher updates and comp
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個過去少有研究的問題：由同策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation, OPD）所產生的任務向量（task vector），是否具備良好的可組合性。OPD 讓學生模型在自身生成的軌跡上接受教師的詞元層級回饋，因此其參數更新結構與教師以強化學習（RL）訓練出的更新並不相同。作者想確認兩件事：在單一任務內，把較弱的 OPD 學生任務向量與其 RL 教師任務向量合併，能否勝過兩者；以及跨任務時，OPD 任務向量是否比對應的 RL 任務向量更容易合併、保留專家能力。實驗涵蓋五個領域（數學、程式、指令遵循、科學、Agent 工具使用）與兩種模型架構（SmolLM3-3B、Qwen3-4B），並比較 Task Arithmetic、TIES-Merging、TSV-M 與 Raw Sum 等合併規則。結果顯示，單一任務內有 12 組任務－合併設定中的 7 組在點估計上同時超越兩個端點，例如 Qwen3-4B 在 Code 上 TIES 合併比 RL 教師高 3.73 個百分點；跨任務方面，OPD 組合在 8 組主幹－合併規則比較中有 7 組平均分數高於 RL 組合，且相對於各自專家平均的落差皆較小。參數空間分析指出 OPD 與 RL 更新之間有大量非共線成分，SmolLM3 在 Code 的範數匹配對照支持方向互補性，OPD 更新在前 10% 高能量前饋通道的重疊度也較低，平均 Jaccard 相似度由 0.154 降至 0.111。限制在於作者明言多數比較僅為三次重複的平均點估計，未建立統計顯著性；方向保留的改善僅見於 Code、Science 與 Agent，Math 與 IF 反而下降，且部分基線協定（如 avg@64）不一致，故不能過度推論方法優劣。此研究的意義在於指出「可組合性」是評估後訓練更新的一項獨立性質：單獨表現較弱並不代表合併價值較低，這對多專家整合與模型合併的實務具有啟發。
radar.title: No Task Vector Is an Island: A Comprehensive Study on the Composability of Task Vectors from On-Policy Distillation
radar.title_zh: 沒有任務向量是一座孤島：同策略蒸餾任務向量可組合性的綜合研究

links.title: Self-Repulsive Sampling for Diffusion Language Models

evidence: Abstract: deterministic SR reaches 80.38% plurality on GSM8K vs 70.17% greedy (10 paths, 128 steps); +2.06 points over self-consistency in blocks of 32 at matched budgets
Section 3.3/Table 2: SR count trails self-consistency on MATH in blocks by 0.10; strongest GSM8K baseline is ODD (α=256) at 78.00 vs SR count τ=0 at 80.38
Appendix C.1/Table 4: paired SR-minus-SC differences of 3.51, 1.68, 1.74, 1.68, 1.69 points across five seeds, all positive; SR seed SD 1.08 at 1280 NFEs
Section 3 Setup: penalty strength selected on 200 problems with one seed; scope ρ=0.75 fixed beforehand; baselines are authors' reproductions
Table 3: own-distribution control gains only +0.20/+1.26 per-sample at matched disagreement vs +7.35/+12.71 for the peer statistic
Appendix D.9/Table 18: end-of-sequence correction moves count margin from 15.91 to 14.50; with EOS excluded from the count the margin is still +13.42
Section 5 Limitations: evidence limited to the LLaDA family; LLaDA-1.5 covers GSM8K only; allocation result is local under shared logits; plurality flat beyond K=10
Appendix B.4: ODD and TAPS run from authors' released code at pinned GitHub commits; no commitment to releasing the SR implementation is stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: An inference-time sampling method for masked diffusion LLMs (LLaDA-8B-Instruct) that improves self-consistency voting on reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH), squarely matching the high-weight LLM and reasoning/CoT preferences; not a domain application or out-of-scope area. Novelty is moderate: logit-level diversity penalties date to Diverse Beam Search and ODD exists for diffusion LMs, but the within-step 'cascade' peer-commitment coupling with information-order asymmetry, the sparsemax allocation result, and the coupling-ceiling bound are genuinely new twists. Rigor is strong: matched-NFE comparisons, 2-5 seeds with paired differences (Table 4), an own-distribution control (Table 3), a peer-blind water-filling control (Appendix D.3), a triangular-filtration ablation (Table 14), and an end-of-sequence correction audit (Table 18) that honestly trims the headline margin from 15.91 to 14.50 points. Evidence is broad within its scope but confined to one model family, with LLaDA-1.5 on GSM8K only; MATH count-variant trails self-consistency by 0.10 and TruthfulQA is a stated negative case. Generalizability is limited: authors note masked diffusion's defer/repair property is load-bearing and the exact allocation guarantee is local; vote saturates beyond K=10. Reproducibility is good on protocol detail (Algorithm 1, frozen problem indices with SHA-256 tags, pinned baseline commits, recommended settings in Table 10) but no code-release statement for the method itself. Calibrated score 0.74 reflects a solid, well-controlled LLM decoding paper with real but incremental contribution.

primary_link.title: Self-Repulsive Sampling for Diffusion Language Models

radar.summary: Sampling several responses and voting over their answers can improve a language model's accuracy, but repeated answers limit the benefit of additional samples. Raising temperature increases diversity at a potential cost to per-sample accuracy. We introduce Self-Repulsion (SR), a sampler for masked diffusion language models that uses peer commitments to diversify the pool. At each penalized denoising step, each path lowers a token's logit according to how many peers have committed that token at t
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對擴散語言模型的多路徑取樣問題：雖然多取幾個答案再投票可提升準確率，但答案重複會讓額外樣本失去效益，而提高溫度雖增加多樣性，卻往往犧牲單題準確率。作者提出 Self-Repulsion（SR），一種可直接套用的取樣器：在遮罩式擴散語言模型的每個去噪步驟中，每條路徑依「同伴已在同一位置選定的 token 數量」調降該 token 的 logit。K 條路徑共用一次批次前向傳播，之後依序提交（稱為 cascade），因此後面的路徑能看到同一階段中較早路徑的選擇。此機制不需訓練、不需額外前向或反向傳播，且在溫度為零時仍能產生不同路徑；當所有路徑同時提交同一位置時，更新等同於最大化總 logit 減去凸的重复成本。實驗以 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 在 GSM8K、MATH 與 TruthfulQA 上評估：在 10 條路徑、128 步去噪下，確定性 SR 在 GSM8K 達到 80.38% 多數投票準確率，優於未加懲罰貪婪解碼的 70.17%；在溫度 0.6 且計算預算相同時，相較 self-consistency 在 32 塊半自回歸設定提升 2.06 個百分點、純擴散設定提升 14.50 個百分點。分析顯示投票增益主要來自正確答案覆蓋率提升，而非投票器選擇力變好。限制在於證據僅涵蓋 LLaDA 系列模型，精確配置結果只在共享 logit 的局部條件下成立，且池子變大後如何選出正解仍是未解問題。
radar.title: Self-Repulsive Sampling for Diffusion Language Models
radar.title_zh: 擴散語言模型的自排斥取樣

links.title: RATIO: Reasoning Analysis and Token-level Inference Optimization for Quantized Reasoning Models

evidence: Abstract: claims 'up to 9.8 points accuracy improvement and reduces chain-of-thought (CoT) length by up to 51.3%' — matches Table 1 Qwen-1.5B AWQ-W3 row (avg 30.88→40.66, ΔAcc +9.78, ΔLen −51.34%).
Sec. 4.1: evaluation uses T=0.6, top-p=0.95, max 65,536 tokens on RTX A6000; no multiple seeds, sampling repetitions, or variance estimates reported anywhere.
Table 1: honest mixed outcomes — Llama-8B AWQ +RATIO ΔAcc +0.06 (negligible) and Qwen-14B AWQ ΔAcc −0.07, so accuracy gains are not uniform across models.

Sec. 4.3 / Table 2: ablations isolate components; TSPD with manual markers is 3.27 points below RATIO accuracy and 49.27% longer CoT under AWQ-W3, but QRBA(λ=1.0) under GPTQ-W3 achieves higher accuracy (38.68 vs 37.40) and shorter CoT (21.91 vs 22.05) than full RATIO, which the authors acknowledge.
Appendix A.1 / Table 3: generalization check on FlatQuant W4A4KV4 (Qwen-1.5B) gives +3.21 avg accuracy and −12.90% CoT, extending beyond weight-only W3.

Appendix B.1–C.3: token sets and normalized penalties (Tables 4–5), QSTI support/stability thresholds (Eqs. 17–28), staged RTV gates (Eqs. 55–61), and logit-correction derivation (Eq. 62–67) are provided; code 'will be available' at github.com/steven-bao1/RATIO (not yet verifiable).
Sec. 5: acknowledged limitation that penalties are static during inference and may mis-calibrate tokens whose role varies by reasoning state (e.g., useful self-correction vs repetitive loops).

Sec. 4.1: RTV calibration uses only 50 randomly sampled questions per benchmark per quantized model, so token selection statistics rest on a modest sample; contextual review involves qualitative lexical inspection, reducing exact reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methods work squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: LLMs (DeepSeek-R1-Distill, Qwen3, Llama), reasoning/CoT efficiency (overthinking suppression), and inference/quantization efficiency. Novelty is moderate-incremental: it upgrades a known fixed-penalty decoding idea (Lotfi et al.) into model-specific token discovery (QRBA) plus full-precision-guided token-specific penalties (TSPD), training-free. Rigor is decent: 5 models, 3 families, 2 W3 quantizers plus FlatQuant W4A4KV4, 5 benchmarks, and both component ablations (Table 2); however all results appear single-run at T=0.6 with no seeds, error bars, or significance tests, and small sets like AIME (30 problems) make few-point deltas noisy. Evidence is internally consistent (Table 1 averages recompute correctly) and honestly reports weak/negative cases (Llama-8B AWQ +0.06; Qwen-14B AWQ -0.07; Table 2 shows QRBA λ=1.0 under GPTQ beats full RATIO on both metrics, acknowledged in Sec. 4.3). Generalizability is bounded: all test models are reasoning-tuned, W3-focused where overthinking is severe, and calibration requires full-precision model access plus reference trajectories. Reproducibility is supported by detailed appendices (thresholds, token lists, penalties, calibration data, decoding params) and a promised code release, but parts of QRBA (contextual/lexical review) are heuristic and not fully specified; code not yet available at review time.

primary_link.title: RATIO: Reasoning Analysis and Token-level Inference Optimization for Quantized Reasoning Models

radar.summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has become a widely adopted technique for reducing the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs). However, recent studies reveal that when applied to reasoning models, PTQ not only degrades reasoning performance but also exacerbates overthinking, leading to longer reasoning trajectories. These issues may offset the efficiency gains expected from lower-precision inference. Existing approaches mainly rely on complex optimization procedures
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理的是後訓練量化（PTQ）用在大型推理模型上的副作用。過去的觀察指出，低位元量化不僅會拉低推理準確率，還會加重「過度思考」，讓模型產生猶豫、反覆驗證等冗長片段，鏈式思考長度變長，反而侵蝕了量化原本要帶來的效率紅利。既有做法多倚賴複雜的最佳化流程，或是由人工預先指定過度思考標記、再套用統一懲罰，難以適應不同模型在量化後各自偏移的 token 分布。作者提出的 RATIO 是一套免訓練的框架：先以「量化感知推理行為分析（QRBA）」找出模型專屬的過度思考 token，作法是在相同推理脈絡下比較全精度與量化模型的下一個 token 機率偏移，並用真實量化軌跡做行為與軌跡層級驗證，篩選出與錯誤或重複推理相關者；再用「token 專屬懲罰判定（TSPD）」，以全精度模型為參照，在 logit 空間計算各 token 需要的修正量，取中位數並於 AWQ、GPTQ 間保守取小，最後於推論時扣減對應 logit。實驗涵蓋 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 的 1.5B、7B、14B、Llama-8B 與 Qwen3-4B，在 AWQ 與 GPTQ 的 W3 設定下，相較未校準的量化基準最高提升 9.8 個百分點準確率，並最多縮短 51.3% 的 CoT 長度。消融顯示 QRBA 與 TSPD 互補；FlatQuant W4A4KV4 上也見效果。限制在於懲罰於推論期間固定不變，且 token 篩選需事先蒐集量化軌跡與量化模型變體，作者因此建議未來發展依推理狀態動態調整的校準策略。
radar.title: RATIO: Reasoning Analysis and Token-level Inference Optimization for Quantized Reasoning Models
radar.title_zh: RATIO：針對量化推理模型的推理解析與 token 層級推論最佳化

links.title: A helps B while B hurts A: directed transfer in instruction-tuning mixture

evidence: Abstract: 'We fit the map in hundreds of fine-tuning runs on Qwen3 and Mistral models from 0.6B to 32B parameters... its predictions have less than half the error of a mixture-agnostic baseline.'
Section 5 / Table 2: recorded predictions have MAE 2.31 pp (r=0.865, slope 1.054) vs mixture-agnostic baseline MAE 6.20 pp and count baselines 9.31/9.20 pp across n=8 cells.

Section 7: 'the Qwen3-32B and Mistral-24B maps agree at r=0.880, while the PubMed map agrees with them at only r=0.279 to 0.545', and a 32B-selected mixture wins 11 of 12 size-target cells by mean +4.44 pp.

Section 8 (Limitations): 'No human judges answer quality... The gold answers are themselves generated by GPT-5-mini'; 'Each test, of eight and of twelve cells, reuses targets and conditions across its cells, so its intervals are descriptive.'
Section 6 / Table 1: 'Each comparison uses one run per mixture, so the TaskShop margins and Skill-It's edges are not resolved'; similarity selector loses 3.11-9.68 pp on mhop/err cells.

Reproducibility Statement and Appendix F: repository github.com/Vahidrostami/directed-transfer with frozen evidence bundle; 'make analysis and make figures recompute every table and figure'; 751 runs, ~540 GPU-hours accounting, full rsLoRA/optimizer/decoding configuration given.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A squarely in-scope LLM methodology paper: instruction-tuning data mixture selection for Qwen3/Mistral models, measuring signed, directed transfer between synthetic task types via a linear datamodel ('transfer map') fit from hundreds of fine-tuning runs. Novelty is moderate: the estimator is an acknowledged datamodel over task types, with Skill-It, TaskWeb and LESS as close prior work; the contributions are the controlled fixed-budget withheld-target setting, the size-alias identification lemma (Lemma 1), and cross-family/scale transfer of selections. Rigor is unusually high: 751 runs, bootstrap intervals, seed replicates, degeneration checks, scoring-rule audits (Appendix G), an order experiment with honestly reported placebo failures, and recorded pre-run predictions beating the mixture-agnostic baseline (MAE 2.31 vs 6.20 pp, Section 5). Evidence strength is capped by the paper's own admissions: all scores come from an automated embedding rule against GPT-5-mini-generated gold answers with no human evaluation, only 8 and 12 prediction cells, dose/passage confounds, and two cells whose effects reverse under scoring variants (Section 8, Appendix G). Generalizability is mixed: the map transfers across five model sizes and two families (r=0.76-0.92) but is corpus-specific and fails to carry to the second corpus (r<0.55, Section 7). Reproducibility is strong: public repository with frozen evidence bundle, make targets that recompute and verify every table/figure, and full training/decoding/scoring specifications (Reproducibility Statement, Appendix F).

primary_link.title: A helps B while B hurts A: directed transfer in instruction-tuning mixture

radar.summary: Adapting a language model to a specialized corpus means choosing which instruction-tuning tasks to train on under a fixed budget, and testing one choice costs a fine-tuning run. Common heuristics add more source tasks or pick sources similar to the target. The first assumes transfer is never negative; the second, that it is symmetric. We show that both assumptions fail: task $A$ can help task $B$ while $B$ hurts $A$, so helpfulness is a signed property of ordered source--target pairs. We introdu
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文挑戰指令微調資料混合的兩項常見假設：遷移不會為負，以及遷移是對稱的。作者固定語料、預算與任務來源，證明任務 A 可以幫助任務 B，而 B 卻傷害 A，因此「助益」是帶正負號、且有方向性的配對性質。他們提出轉移圖（transfer map）：以線性資料模型對每個「來源—目標」配對給出正負估計，並在 Qwen3（0.6B 至 32B）與 Mistral-24B 上執行數百次微調，目標任務完全不給訓練樣本。主要證據顯示，轉移圖能在訓練前預測未見混合的準確率，誤差不到混合無關基線的一半；在推理型目標（因果解釋、多跳問答、方法學批判）上，準確率最多提升 14 個百分點。值得注意的是，單一干擾型任務可抵銷其餘任務的效益，而相似度選擇器因不帶正負號，無法區分有助與有害的來源。轉移圖在模型家族與規模間大致一致，換語料則需重新探測。限制在於評分全靠自動規則、段落與來源劑量未能完全控制、預測測試單元數偏少，且混合被當成集合，忽略訓練順序的影響。
radar.title: A helps B while B hurts A: directed transfer in instruction-tuning mixture
radar.title_zh: A 助 B 而 B 傷 A：指令微調混合中的有向遷移

links.title: GrammarRL: Effective Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1: GrammarRL improves constrained greedy baseline on all 9 task/model settings (e.g., Gloss 1B 0.342→0.570 BLEU, 8B 0.611→0.754), while single-reward variants can underperform the baseline (reverse-only CoNLL 8B 0.597 vs 0.752), supporting the claimed reward complementarity.

Section 4.3, Table 2: at 1× greedy cost GrammarRL (best λ) reaches 0.559 Gloss / 0.621 CoNLL, beating 10× sampling methods (Full IS, Full SMC), but WoS is an exception where Full IS (0.442) outperforms GrammarRL (0.415); the best-λ row is admitted to be 'slightly optimistic' due to test-set selection.

Section 4.4, Table 3: reward-mixing ablation shows an intermediate λ beats both single-direction objectives on every task (WoS 0.288/0.309 → 0.407 at λ=0.25); Appendix E Table 8 shows B=10 training beam regresses Gloss to 0.470.

Appendix F: mechanism-level analysis — direct-only training leaves 23.71% of gold CoNLL fields empty vs 2.12% under reverse-only, while reverse-only raises Gloss THERE-DESC trap tokens from 33 to 140; Figure 4 shows the combined reward tracks BLEU ordering where the direct reward alone cannot.
Section 5 Limitations: per-grammar retraining required, RL phase cost, and on CoNLL beam search on the frozen model remains slightly stronger than GrammarRL greedy.

Reproducibility statement + Appendices A/B/C (Tables 4, 5, 7): reward scaling constants, full LoRA/hyperparameter config (r=64, 1000 steps, H100 5–18h), and exact prompts are documented and datasets/checkpoints are public, but no code or artifact release is claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: label-free RLOO fine-tuning (LoRA on Llama 1B/3B/8B) that amortizes grammar-constrained decoding preferences into model weights using a bidirectional noisy-channel reward from a frozen reference model. Strong preference fit to LLMs, RL, training/optimization, inference cost, and structured-output NLP tasks; no Japanese, agentic, or reasoning content. Novelty is a competent combination of known pieces (RLOO, noisy-channel reranking, posterior-approximation literature) with a new amortization framing rather than a fundamentally new technique. Rigor and evidence are solid: three tasks, three model sizes, 10 sampled test sets with std, reward-mix and rollout-composition ablations, and honest negative results (reverse-only CoNLL 8B drops to 0.597 vs 0.752 baseline; WoS where Full IS beats GrammarRL). Limitations: single model family, per-grammar retraining, retrieved prompt 'hints' from training vocabulary complicate interpretation, Table 2 uses only 2 test sets, and best-λ is selected on test seeds (acknowledged as optimistic). No code release is stated despite detailed hyperparameter/prompt appendices.

primary_link.title: GrammarRL: Effective Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Reinforcement Learning

radar.summary: Grammar-constrained generation guarantees syntactic validity, but can substantially degrade semantic quality when the model's preferred outputs are poorly aligned with the imposed grammar. This trade-off is particularly severe when the prompt is underspecified or the model has limited instruction-following ability. Beam search can partially mitigate these failures by exploring multiple valid sequences, but its computational cost grows with beam width, while sequence-level probability is only an
radar.summary_zh: 本文針對文法約束解碼（grammar-constrained decoding）的核心痛點：遮罩無效詞元雖能保證語法正確，卻可能在模型偏好與文法不符時嚴重損害語意品質，且在標註資料稀缺、指令遵循能力有限的情境下更為明顯。既有補救方式如 beam search 與事後機率近似（importance sampling、SMC）都在推論時付出額外算力，且序列層機率並非語意品質的良好代理。作者提出 GrammarRL，一種無需標註資料的標籤免費（label-free）強化學習方法：以凍結的預訓練模型提供兩個互補的自我監督獎勵，一是直接獎勵（給定輸入下輸出之對數概似），二是反向獎勵（由生成輸出重建輸入之對數概似），再以 RLOO 目標在一組文法約束的 rollout 上最佳化，並加入 beam search top-1 候選、以 KL 正則化約束於凍結基礎模型。實驗涵蓋手語 Gloss 翻譯、WoS 階層分類與 CoNLL 命名實體辨識，使用 1B 至 8B 的 Llama 模型。結果顯示相較貪婪解碼平均提升 9.8 分、最高增益 22.8 BLEU，在三項任務中的兩項達到或超越 beam search，且維持貪婪解碼的推論成本，亦勝過生成量多十倍的取樣式事後近似方法。消融實驗指出兩個獎勵具互補性：單一獎勵可能低於未訓練基準，混合後則在所有設定皆優於基準。限制包括需額外進行一次無標註強化學習訓練、更換文法須重訓，以及在 CoNLL 上冷凍模型的 beam search 仍略優於貪婪解碼的 GrammarRL。此工作的重要性在於把推論時的序列層修正攤銷進模型參數，為結構化生成提供低成本且無需標註的調適途徑。
radar.title: GrammarRL: Effective Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
radar.title_zh: GrammarRL：透過強化學習達成有效的文法約束解碼

links.title: ActionGuard: Tool Call Authorization under Poisoned Skills

evidence: Abstract + §6.1: abstract claims ASR reduced 'by 70.44% relative to No Safeguard', while §6.1 reports '20.40 percentage points (70.2% relative reduction)' from 29.05% to 8.65% — a minor internal numerical inconsistency.

§5.1 & Table 2: 319 SKILL-INJECT injection–task pairs (139 contextual, 180 obvious) and five reviewer models (Gemma 4, Qwen 3.5, Ministral 3, GPT-5.4 mini, Claude Haiku), each condition repeated three times (§5.2).
§5.3: TSR evaluated on subsets (100/139 contextual, 155/180 obvious) because some attacks destroy artifacts needed for adjudication; technical failures excluded from both ASR and TSR.

Table 3 & Table 4: per-model and overall results support headline claims — ActionGuard overall ASR 8.65%/TSR 90.38% vs Dynamic Guardian 16.05%/92.08% and SkillGuard 13.42%/88.55%, consistent with the stated 46.1% and 35.5% relative ASR reductions.

§7.2 & §8: case study INST-10_git_task1 documents a utility failure from blocking a compound tool call; §8 concedes evaluation is limited to one agent framework, one target agent model, and one benchmark; no adaptive-attack (attacker-aware) evaluation appears in §5–§6 despite citing Zhan et al. 2025 on adaptive attacks.

Appendix A, Table 5, Table 6: anonymized artifact (anonymous.4open.science/r/ActionGuard-D85C) with implementation, prompts, profile DB, dataset snapshot, and logs; full sandbox/host and parameter detail reported, but only three-run means are given with no dispersion, and outcome adjudication uses a single LLM Judge model without human validation (acknowledged as future work in §8).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an LLM-agent safeguard that authorizes tool calls at execution time against poisoned-skill (indirect prompt injection) attacks, aligning with high-weight preferences on Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation. Evaluation is comparatively careful: 319 SKILL-INJECT pairs, three baselines (No Safeguard, Dynamic Guardian, SkillGuard), five reviewer models across open-source and commercial tiers, three repetitions, paired ASR/TSR metrics, detailed environment and implementation tables, and an honest utility-failure case study. However, the contribution is an incremental combination of known ideas (runtime LLM guardrail, LLM-as-judge, skill profiling) in a crowded area; robustness is tested only over reviewer models, not target agents, frameworks, or adaptive attackers; outcome adjudication relies on a single LLM judge with no human-agreement validation; only mean results of three runs are reported with no variance or significance testing; and the abstract (70.44%) slightly mismatches the computed relative reduction (70.2%) in §6.1. Generalizability is explicitly limited to one framework (OpenClaw), one target model, and one benchmark. An anonymized artifact with code, prompts, dataset snapshot, and logs supports reproducibility, though availability is review-scoped.

primary_link.title: ActionGuard: Tool Call Authorization under Poisoned Skills

radar.summary: LLM-based agents extend their capabilities through third-party skills that provide task-specific instructions, scripts, and tool-use procedures. However, malicious instructions inserted into an otherwise benign skill can cause a benign user request to trigger dangerous Tool Calls, including data exfiltration, file deletion, or unauthorized code execution. This paper presents ActionGuard, which inspects skill-influenced Tool Calls immediately before execution. ActionGuard separates the target age
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理常藉由第三方技能（skill）取得任務指示與工具使用流程，但攻擊者可在原本良性的技能中夾帶惡意指令，使代理在正常使用者請求下產生資料外洩、檔案刪除或未授權程式執行等危險的 Tool Call。本文提出 ActionGuard，於工具實際執行前攔截技能所影響的 Tool Call。其核心設計在於把目標代理的動作生成脈絡與防護機制的授權脈絡分離：目標代理仍可讀取原始技能來規劃任務，但 ActionGuard 不會把可能被投毒的原始技能文字直接交給 Reviewer 模型，而是以工作階段開始時擷取的可信使用者請求、由防護端獨立維護的平衡技能側寫（含一般工作流程與可疑訊號）、當前與近期 Tool Call，以及待執行本機指令碼中擷取的證據，來判斷動作是否獲得授權。系統於 OpenClaw 的 before_tool_call 階段攔截，並以 fail-closed 政策強制執行隔離語意 Reviewer 的 ALLOW 或 DENY 判定。實驗在 SKILL-INJECT 設定下評估 139 個情境式注入與 180 個明顯注入，並與 Dynamic Guardian 及 SkillGuard 比較，使用三個開源模型與兩個商用模型作為決策元件，每個條件獨立重複三次，以攻擊成功率（ASR）與任務成功率（TSR）衡量。結果顯示 ActionGuard 對兩類注入皆維持低 ASR 與高 TSR；整體評估中，相較既有防護機制降低 ASR 達 35.54–46.11%，相較無防護則降低 70.44%，且未明顯損害良性任務表現。限制在於僅於單一代理框架、單一目標模型與單一基準上驗證，且當良性與未授權動作被合併於同一 Tool Call 時會整筆封鎖，後續成敗取決於代理能否重新規劃；此工作凸顯以執行邊界授權與執行期行為證據防禦技能注入的價值。
radar.title: ActionGuard: Tool Call Authorization under Poisoned Skills
radar.title_zh: ActionGuard：遭受投毒技能下的工具呼叫授權機制

links.title: Speculative Safety Honeypot: Toward Proactive Defense Against Multi-turn Agent Attacks

evidence: Abstract: claims SSH-enhanced systems achieve 'a 0% ASR against both jailbreak and indirect injection' while mitigating utility degradation
Section 4.1: target agent is Qwen3-235B; the three SSH simulators are fine-tuned Dolphin3-3B models deployed via Multi-LoRA
Table 1 (Section 4.2.1): standalone PromptGuard averages 12.25% ASR / 36.02 UA vs 0.00% ASR / 44.14 UA with SSH; Judger 10.48% ASR / 44.75 UA vs 0.00% / 58.43 UA with SSH
Section 4.2.2 (Table 2): risk exposure 84.5% at M=1 rising to 99.5% (HarmBench) with ASR 0.0% at M=5 on ActorAttack
Section 4.2.5 ablation: Beam Search beats Top-P; hit rate 47.2% at M=4 on AgentDojo vs 8% on text-based ActorAttack
Section 3.3: dual thresholds tau1 < tau2 for matched/mismatched speculation are defined but their numeric values are never specified
Limitations: ~1.3% parameter overhead, ~0.2% system FPR on AgentDojo, 3-7s latency penalty per false positive, compute cost of M=5 branches acknowledged
Appendix D.1 (Table 5): generalization to GPT-4o-mini (0.0 avg ASR with SSH+judger) and GPT-OSS-120B (0.7 avg ASR), using 3,000 newly distilled simulator samples
Appendix D.2 'Hyperparameter Analysis' section header present but contains no content
Section 3.4 / Appendix B: simulator training uses 11,000 distilled Qwen3-235B samples plus 4,700 synthetic IPI samples from 30 templates (Table 4), indicating per-target tuning is required
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic paper: LLM agent safety against multi-turn jailbreaks and indirect prompt injection, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, LLMs, and Red Teaming/Evaluation preferences. The speculative-simulation framing (forecasting agent trajectories via a vulnerable multi-agent honeypot, then pruning against real actions) is a genuinely new angle relative to retrospective detectors, building plausibly on prior speculative-decoding/agent-planning work it cites. Rigor is solid but uneven: four benchmarks, six-plus baselines, beam-search-vs-top-p ablation, budget/depth scaling, and three target models, yet no seeds/significance, unspecified alert thresholds (tau1/tau2 values never given), and a uniformly perfect 0% ASR across all Table 1 cells invites skepticism. Evidence is detailed but partly locked in unquantified figures and rests on a small Qwen3-0.6B judger; Appendix D.2 (Hyperparameter Analysis) is an empty stub. Generalizability is partially demonstrated (GPT-4o-mini, GPT-OSS-120B in Appendix D.1) but requires per-target distillation fine-tuning (11,000 / 3,000 samples), weakening the plug-and-play claim. Reproducibility is middling: thorough training pipeline and Algorithm 1, but no code/data release and missing threshold values.

primary_link.title: Speculative Safety Honeypot: Toward Proactive Defense Against Multi-turn Agent Attacks

radar.summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in complex environments, multi-turn interaction attacks have become a significant security challenge. Existing detection methods typically rely on historical context. However, this retrospective logic struggles to identify deep malicious intents that are split across turns to hide future risks. Inspired by speculative decoding, we propose the Speculative Safety Honeypot (SSH) framework. SSH uses a multi-agent simulation system compos
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理在多輪互動中面臨越獄與間接提示注入（IPI）攻擊，惡意意圖常被拆分到多個回合以規避偵測。現有防禦多依賴歷史脈絡進行回溯式判斷，難以在風險真正發生前察覺被隱藏的深層惡意意圖。本文借鏡推測式解碼（speculative decoding）的概念，提出推測式安全蜜罐（SSH）框架。SSH 以一組小型語言模型構成多代理模擬系統，建立動作層級的「先推測、後驗證」流程：在推測階段，由助理、使用者與環境三個模擬器（皆以未經安全對齊的模型搭配 Multi-LoRA 部署）非同步展開軌跡樹，並採用多樣性導向的 Beam Search，透過行為分群、雙層洗牌與輪詢選取，在有限算力下優先探索罕見且偏門的風險路徑；在驗證階段，以目標代理的真實動作為依據修剪軌跡樹，再交由既有偵測器對葉節點進行二元風險判定，並以風險葉節點比例作為風險分數，搭配命中與未命中兩種門檻觸發警示。實驗以 Qwen3-235B 等模型為目標代理，在 AgentDojo、ActorAttack、XSTest 與 BFCL-v3 上評估。結果顯示，結合 SSH 後 PromptGuard 與 Judger 的平均攻擊成功率皆降至 0%，同時受攻擊下的任務效用平均提升約 8 個百分點；在 ActorAttack 上，即使僅取樣一次（M=1），風險曝露率即達 84.5%，M=5 時攻擊被完全阻擋。效用方面，BFCL-v3 與 XSTest 的表現與部署前幾乎一致，平均風險分數接近零，誤報率約 0.2%。作者指出限制包括：平行推測帶來額外 GPU 記憶體與能耗成本，雖僅增加約 1.3% 參數量仍不可忽略；誤報雖低，仍會造成約 3 至 7 秒延遲與較保守的回覆。此工作的重要性在於把代理防禦由被動回溯轉為主動預測，降低對單一偵測器精度的依賴，為多輪時序攻擊提供具預警前置時間的防禦韌性。
radar.title: Speculative Safety Honeypot: Toward Proactive Defense Against Multi-turn Agent Attacks
radar.title_zh: 推測式安全蜜罐：邁向對多輪代理攻擊的主動防禦

links.title: SEPAL: Separated Expert Pairs with Answer-Level Fusion for Reliable LLM Collaboration

evidence: Abstract: 'Across five open-weight backbones and five question-answering benchmarks, SEPAL improves mean accuracy by 1.81 percentage points over a matched single Actor-Critic pair, with improvements across all five backbones.'

Section 3.4: 'It follows the ACC-Collab training order... We train each role on its own trajectories using ACC-Collab's preference rule.' (Sec 1 also states retention of ACC-Collab's continuation-valued training rule)
Section 4.1 (Baselines and metric): 'All comparisons are descriptive, using one fixed realization per model-method-dataset cell under the recorded protocol.'

Section 4.4 (Table 3): 'The same trained Actors gain +3.72 macro points from Full-R0 to Full-R4, with improvements in 23 of 25 cells'; No-SFT leads Full-R4 on Llama (77.79 vs 76.90), showing backbone-dependent best configuration.
Section 4.3: 'Oracle-any-role accuracy reaches 86.12%, exposing a 9.81-point selection gap.'

Limitations: 'SEPAL uses three pair trajectories and reports one fixed run per cell on five 2B-8B backbones and short-answer QA tasks. Repeated training seeds, comparisons at equal compute, and a direct communication-boundary ablation would clarify robustness.'

Reproducibility statement: 'Code, configurations, and result records are publicly available... Two scripts recompute the reported numbers from these records without model inference.' Appendix A gives checkpoints, splits, hyperparameters, seeds; Appendix B gives prompts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on multi-agent collaboration for QA with reasoning, CoT-style deliberation, and DPO-based preference training, matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, reasoning). The contribution is a competent but incremental combination of existing pieces: ACC-Collab's continuation-valued preference rule is reused verbatim per role (Sec 3.4), role diversity is prompt-based, and late majority voting is standard; the genuinely new element is isolating feedback paths so errors do not synchronize candidates before the vote. Rigor is solid in design (matched ACC baseline, six-variant ablations, decision diagnostics, revision-round analysis) but explicitly weakened by 'one fixed realization per model-method-dataset cell' with no seeds, no significance tests, and no equal-compute comparison (Sec 4.1, Limitations), and trained-system vs untrained-baseline comparisons confound training data with protocol. Evidence is consistent (24/25 cells positive, +1.81 macro mean) but modest in magnitude and single-run. Generalizability is limited to short-answer QA on 2B-8B models. Reproducibility is a strength: full configs, prompts, seeds, parser versioning, CSVs, and scripts recomputing all reported numbers without inference.

primary_link.title: SEPAL: Separated Expert Pairs with Answer-Level Fusion for Reliable LLM Collaboration

radar.summary: Multi-agent collaboration lets large language models (LLMs) improve question answering through deliberation and feedback. Yet shared discussion couples correction with exposure to the same mistakes, which can erode the diversity needed for voting. Self-consistency offers sampling diversity without feedback, while single-pair Actor-Critic collaboration refines only one candidate. We introduce SEPAL, which assigns three private Actor-Critic teams to direct reasoning, evidence grounding, and verifi
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理多代理 LLM 協作中「修正」與「多樣性」互相衝突的問題。共享討論史雖能讓代理彼此糾錯，卻也讓同一個早期錯誤擴散到多個候選答案，削弱投票所需的多樣性；而 self-consistency 雖保留獨立取樣，卻缺乏回饋修正機制。作者提出 SEPAL，將三個私有 Actor–Critic 團隊分別指派給直接推論、證據支撐與驗證三種角色，以角色導向的訓練賦予各隊不同的推論目標，並限制 Critic 的回饋只在隊內流動，最後僅以各隊的最終答案進行多數投票，Direct 作為平手的固定備援。訓練沿用 ACC-Collab 的續寫正確率偏好規則，並以 DPO 訓練各角色。實驗涵蓋五個 2B 至 8B 的開源骨幹與五項問答基準，SEPAL 在 25 個模型–資料集組合中勝過匹配的單一 Actor–Critic 配對達 24 個，巨觀準確率平均提升 1.81 個百分點。分析顯示 Critic 引導的修正貢獻最大，且投票在 21 個設定中優於最強單一角色。限制在於僅回報單次固定執行、未做等算力比較與種子重複，且仍存在 9.81 分的 oracle 選擇落差。
radar.title: SEPAL: Separated Expert Pairs with Answer-Level Fusion for Reliable LLM Collaboration
radar.title_zh: SEPAL：分離式專家配對與答案層級融合，實現可靠的大型語言模型協作

links.title: Effective Does Not Mean Useful: Conditional Functional Substitutability for Redundancy and Scaling in Transformers

evidence: Section 4.1, Table 1(b): conventional proxies correlate weakly with CFS (Taylor importance Spearman 0.2386; parameter cosine -0.0050; attention-map similarity 0.0175 over 861 ranking units)

Section 4.2 and Appendix D: exhaustive joint-subset oracle on final 12-head layer of ViT-B/16 (220/924/220 subsets, 448 images, 611,072 interventions) reduces KL 61.6-81.3% vs Taylor, with all paired bootstrap CIs below zero (Eqs. 25-26)

Section 6.2, Table 7 and Appendix F.2: CFS-guided routing reduces KL vs Taylor by 43.5-49.2% at K=3/6/9 with paired 95% CIs excluding zero; accuracy 'not statistically resolved' so fidelity is primary evidence

Section 5.2 and Appendix E.2: from shared W768/D12 baseline, width scaling raises Raw Oracle by 0.0397 vs 0.0029 for depth while D18 yields larger loss reduction per added parameter; authors frame this as limited, not 'depth preferable to width'

Section 5.3 and Appendix E.3: fixed-capacity head-decomposition result (loss 3.5707/3.5752/3.5780 vs Raw Oracle 0.2012/0.2125/0.2583) is explicitly 'associative rather than causal' because head granularity changes inductive bias
Appendix B, Table 8: CFS evaluated on only 32 contexts for BERT (MNLI) and Qwen2.5 (FineWeb-Edu) versus 512 images for ViT natural-family experiments
Section 7 and Appendix F.4: acknowledged limits - logical not wall-clock budgets (dense fused QKV kernels), single-layer head granularity, higher-order interactions beyond pairwise CFS
Reproducibility statement: protocols, seeds (e.g., 17/23/41), validity threshold 1e-5, and alpha grids specified across Appendices A-F, but code 'will be released upon acceptance'
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope core-ML work on transformer redundancy, interpretability, and scaling, with meaningful LLM components (Qwen2.5 1.5B-14B analysis, GPT-2-style controlled training) though roughly half the experiments are ViT-based, limiting LLM-preference alignment. CFS (input-conditioned, directional head substitutability via gated interventions and rescaling) is a genuinely new lens distinct from importance/similarity proxies, though conceptually adjacent to activation patching and self-repair work. Rigor is strong: Matched-2 candidate-count control, exhaustive joint-subset oracle (611,072 interventions), paired bootstrap CIs, R1/R2 ablations, shared-calibration and oracle-alpha controls, and explicit associativity/wall-clock caveats. Evidence is solid but some key evaluations use small probe sets (32 texts for BERT/Qwen CFS, 448 routing test images) and the fixed-capacity performance claim rests on small loss differences (3.5707 vs 3.5780) the authors themselves call associative. Generalizability is bounded by single-layer (final-block) analysis and untested extension to MLPs/tokens/experts; no wall-clock speedup is demonstrated. Protocols, seeds, thresholds, and grids are well documented, but code is only promised upon acceptance.

primary_link.title: Effective Does Not Mean Useful: Conditional Functional Substitutability for Redundancy and Scaling in Transformers

radar.summary: Modern neural networks scale predictably, yet the mechanisms behind these regularities remain unclear. Neural redundancy is typically characterized by component importance or representational similarity, both indirect proxies. We view redundancy as an input-conditioned, dynamic relation: intermediate computational states are functionally redundant when they induce similar downstream responses. We introduce Conditional Functional Substitutability (CFS) to directly characterize such functional sub
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出，過去用來描述神經網路冗餘的「重要性」與「相似度」指標都只是間接代理，無法說明某個計算單元是否真的不可替代。作者提出「條件式功能可替換性」（CFS）：在給定輸入下，把來源頭關閉、調整候選頭的補償係數，測量下游輸出損傷能被回復的比例。CFS 具備輸入條件性與方向性，因此能刻畫一個動態關係，而非靜態分數。實驗涵蓋 ViT、BERT 與 Qwen2.5 等 Transformer 家族，並以自訓 GPT-2 進行寬度、深度與固定參數下的頭分解控制實驗。結果顯示，尺度化會系統性重整功能結構：Raw Oracle 上升、覆蓋率與有效功能秩下降，代表新增容量同時帶來多樣性與重複利用，為報酬遞減提供微觀層次的解釋；在固定容量下，可替換性較低、獨立結構較多者表現較好。此外，CFS 可由前向狀態預測並用於動態元件選擇，在相同邏輯預算下比 Taylor 重要性路由更能保留稠密模型行為。限制在於：固定容量實驗屬關聯性而非因果、成對 CFS 無法完全預測聯合干預的高階交互作用，且目前後端仍執行稠密核心，尚未轉化為實際時鐘加速。
radar.title: Effective Does Not Mean Useful: Conditional Functional Substitutability for Redundancy and Scaling in Transformers
radar.title_zh: 有效不等於有用：Transformer 中冗餘與尺度化的條件式功能可替換性

links.title: ComputerSD: Online Self-Distillation from Real-Time Feedback for Computer-Use Agents

evidence: Abstract & Section 4.2: ComputerSD beats outcome-only GRPO by 1.9 (Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking) and 4.1 (EvoCUA-8B) points on OSWorld-Verified.
Table 1: 33.8->37.9 (GRPO)->39.8 (ComputerSD) for Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and 41.3->43.8->47.9 for EvoCUA-8B; results averaged over three evaluation runs.
Table 2: GRPO degrades OOD performance (21.6, -1.4; 30.2, -1.4) while ComputerSD improves it (27.5, +4.5; 35.4, +3.8); note GRPO in-domain 48.2 exceeds ComputerSD 47.5 on the Qwen backbone.
Table 3 (Ablations): w/o Real-Time Feedback 35.0, w/o Value Gate 36.6, w/o GUI Analyzer SFT 38.0 vs full 39.8.
Table 4: gate variants SDAR 38.1, hard 35.2, reverse 36.0 vs value gate 39.8; Table 5: lambda_OPSD {0.1: 35.6, 0.01: 39.8, 0.001: 37.1}.
Appendix C.3 Table 9: analyzer SFT raises expert agreement 29.9%->85.3% and valid output 41.6%->99.7% on a 341-sample holdout, scored against the expert model's own annotations.
Appendix A (Limitations): value gate cannot resolve jointly unreliable guidance/value outputs; systematic analyzer errors may bias policy updates.

Appendix B Tables 6-7 and Reproducibility Statement: LoRA (rank 32), AdamW lr 1e-6, GRPO clip 0.2, KL 0.01; appendices document annotation prompt (Fig. 9), system prompt (Fig. 10), data stats (Table 8), splits (App. D); code link in header.
Section 4.3/Figure 5: asynchronous framework gives 5x synchronous throughput; ComputerSD retains ~57% of GRPO's trajectory throughput.
Appendix E Table 10: prompt-only 34.6 and GRPO with PRM 37.4 vs ComputerSD 39.8 on Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope agentic LLM training paper: online RL + on-policy self-distillation for computer-use agents, hitting Agents & Tool Use, RL, and Training preferences. Method (value-gated token-level OPSD from a fine-tuned GUI analyzer, joint with GRPO, asynchronous pipeline) is an incremental but genuine advance over SDAR/HERO-style prior work. Evaluation is comparatively thorough: two 8B backbones, component ablations, gate-design comparisons, coefficient sensitivity, OOD splits, cross-platform WAA, and extra baselines (prompt-only 34.6, GRPO+PRM 37.4 vs 39.8). Caveats: gains are modest (1.9 pts on Qwen backbone), training appears single-run without seeds or significance tests, analyzer quality is validated on only 341 samples against the expert model's own labels (circularity acknowledged in Appendix A), Table 2 shows GRPO actually beats ComputerSD in-domain on the Qwen backbone (48.2 vs 47.5), and the abstract reports an EvoCUA OOD figure (34.9) inconsistent with Table 2 (35.4). Reproducibility is good: code link, full hyperparameters, annotation and system prompts, data statistics, and benchmark splits.

primary_link.title: ComputerSD: Online Self-Distillation from Real-Time Feedback for Computer-Use Agents

radar.summary: Online training enables computer-use agents (CUAs) to improve through interaction with executable environments. However, existing methods primarily rely on sparse outcome rewards, which provide no supervision for intermediate actions. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers token-level learning signals through privileged rescoring, but directly applying it to CUA online training presents two challenges: fixed guidance may become misaligned with the student's current state, and guidance-induced
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對電腦操作代理（computer-use agents, CUAs）的線上訓練問題。現有方法主要依賴環境驗證器給出的稀疏結果獎勵，只能判斷任務是否完成，無法指出一連串動作中哪些是有效、冗餘或錯誤的，因此信用分配始終是難題。既有的同策略自我蒸餾（OPSD）雖能在 token 層級提供學習訊號，卻面臨兩項挑戰：事先固定的特權指引可能與學生當前狀態錯位；而指引造成的機率位移也未必與步驟層級的正確性一致。作者提出 ComputerSD，把每個動作執行後 GUI 畫面轉換所產生的即時回饋轉為學習指引。經微調的 GUI 分析器在每個動作後輸出指引與步驟層級的價值分數：指引作為特權上下文供重新評分，價值分數則透過 sigmoid 閘門調節每個 token 的 OPSD 訊號強度。此 token 層級目標與軌跡層級的 GRPO 聯合最佳化，並以全非同步管線重疊環境互動、GUI 分析、特權重評與策略更新。在 OSWorld-Verified 上，ComputerSD 於通用型 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 與專門化 EvoCUA-8B 兩個 8B 骨幹上，分別比純結果 GRPO 高出 1.9 與 4.1 個百分點；在訓練時保留的應用類別上增益更大（+5.9 與 +5.2），WindowsAgentArena 跨平台評測亦有一致提升。消融實驗顯示，改用固定指引或移除價值閘門都會使表現低於 GRPO。非同步管線的吞吐量約為同步版本的五倍。限制在於方法高度依賴 GUI 分析器的可靠性，若指引與價值判斷同時出錯，閘門無法完全補救；且作者僅在受控基準環境中評估，真實部署的安全性未涵蓋。其意義在於證明持續互動所產生的即時回饋，可提供超越稀疏任務結果的細粒度監督，為 CUA 的線上自我蒸餾提供實用途徑。
radar.title: ComputerSD: Online Self-Distillation from Real-Time Feedback for Computer-Use Agents
radar.title_zh: ComputerSD：以即時回饋進行線上自我蒸餾的電腦操作代理

links.title: Taming Speculative Search for Test-Time Scaling in LLM Serving

evidence: Section 1 (Introduction): claims 'SpecScale achieves 2.18x and 1.87x higher throughput than the naive speculation and FastTTS' on MATH with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; these figures are not restated numerically in Section 5, which reports 1.51x/1.43x vs. non-spec baseline (Section 5.2).

Section 3.2.1/3.2.2 (Figs. 4-6): motivating characterization showing speculative execution roughly doubles concurrent candidates (~3 to ~6 per request) and accumulates 2-3x more verification calls than the non-speculative baseline.

Section 5.1 (Experimental Setup): four generator-verifier pairs from Qwen2.5/Llama3 families, single NVIDIA A100 80GB, PyTorch v2.9, CUDA 12.8; FastTTS reimplemented 'because the publicly released code supports only a batch size of one', with validation summarized but 'detailed results are omitted due to space constraints'.

Table 2 (Section 5.5): answer accuracy deltas for SpecScale vs. non-spec range from -1.01 to +2.97 percentage points across beam sizes 4 and 8, indicating approximate but not strict accuracy preservation.

Section 5.6/5.7: sensitivity study finds 2,048-token verification threshold optimal (1.09x/1.14x over EP+CD), and at beam size 32 SpecScale maintains ~195ms latency vs. ~330ms for non-spec with ~22% KV memory reduction.

Section 6 (Related Work): positions early pruning against FastTTS's Speculative Candidate Selection and concurrent SPEX's confidence-margin termination, and lazy verification against FastTTS's Lookahead Verification, indicating incremental rather than wholly novel contributions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed LLM-serving systems paper (SpecScale) targeting speculative execution for test-time scaling of reasoning, squarely on-topic for LLM, reasoning/CoT, and inference/serving preferences. Strengths: clear problem characterization (waiting time 20-55% of runtime, Section 2.3/Fig.2; 2-3x more verification calls under speculation, Section 3.2.2/Fig.6), three complementary techniques with incremental ablations (EP, EP+CD, EP+CD+LV, Section 5.2), accuracy-preservation analysis (Table 2), threshold sensitivity study (Section 5.6), and scalability analysis (Section 5.7). Weaknesses: novelty is incremental relative to FastTTS (Lookahead Verification, Speculative Candidate Selection) and concurrent SPEX, with the paper's own related-work section (Section 6) drawing the distinctions; headline claims of 2.18x/1.87x vs. naive-spec/FastTTS appear only in the Introduction and are not restated as numbers in the evaluation text (only 1.51x/1.43x vs. non-spec baseline in Section 5.2); evaluation limited to math benchmarks (GSM8K/MATH-500/OlympiadBench) on a single A100; FastTTS is a reimplementation whose validation is asserted but 'detailed results are omitted' (Section 5.1); no code/artifact release is mentioned; some accuracy regressions exist (e.g., -1.01 pp OlympiadBench at 8 beams, Table 2b).

primary_link.title: Taming Speculative Search for Test-Time Scaling in LLM Serving

radar.summary: Test-time scaling has recently emerged as a powerful approach for improving LLM reasoning by allocating additional computation during inference, substantially enhancing accuracy on challenging tasks such as mathematics and coding. To accelerate the exploration of reasoning paths, recent studies proposed speculative execution. However, we show that supporting speculative execution poses two unique challenges for LLM serving systems: (1) an explosion in the search space of candidate paths and (2)
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型在測試時擴展（test-time scaling）下的服務效率問題。此類方法以 beam search 搭配過程獎勵模型（PRM），反覆進行「擴展—驗證—選擇」以提升數學與程式推理準確率，但每步都需等待所有候選路徑完成驗證，導致 20–55% 的執行時間耗費在閒置等待。近期研究提出推測式執行（speculative execution），讓先完成的路徑提前擴展，卻帶來兩項新挑戰：候選路徑空間爆炸，以及頻繁且細碎的驗證工作，使 GPU 使用率低落並反覆打斷解碼。作者提出服務系統 SpecScale，以三項技術因應：一是早期剪枝（early pruning），當已驗證候選數超過 k 或累積 k 個滿分候選時，立即終止不可能進入最終 top-k 的分支；二是計算去重（computation deduplication），將共享相同前綴的候選合併為單次前向傳播，僅在取樣結果分歧時才分支；三是延遲驗證（lazy verification），將驗證請求排入佇列，依累積 token 量、同源群組完成與每樣本延遲次數上限三項策略批次送出。實驗以 Qwen2.5 與 Llama3 系列的生成器—驗證器配對，於 GSM8K、MATH-500、OlympiadBench 上、單張 A100 80GB 執行。結果顯示 SpecScale 在吞吐量與端到端延遲上皆優於非推測式與 FastTTS；MATH 上 8 beams 時吞吐量分別高出 1.51× 與 1.43×，答案準確率大致持平。限制在於延遲驗證的門檻需離線量測，且部分效益取決於模型產生滿分的頻率，Llama 系列受益較小。
radar.title: Taming Speculative Search for Test-Time Scaling in LLM Serving
radar.title_zh: 馴服推測式搜尋：LLM 服務中測試時擴展的效率最佳化

links.title: Backward-State Policy Is Part of the Learning Algorithm

evidence: Sec 2.1/Fig 1: three forked 390M pairs from a step-999 checkpoint differ only in what the attention correction term D reads; reuse of the forward's rounding fails (final loss 7.314) while a new rounding from the same distribution trains (3.256), with rules fixed before launch (Appx D.2).

Sec 2.2/Fig 2 and Table 8: shipped TE FP8 attention fails on all 3 seeds (validation gaps 5.097-5.225 nats above BF16); replacing only the backward with BF16 while keeping the FP8 forward ends 0.0029-0.0059 nats above BF16, replicated at 1.5B and on newer PyTorch/TE builds.

Appx B.2 Theorem: proof that no shared substitute Z satisfies E[Z|F,r]=p_q and E[J(Z)|F,r]=J(p) simultaneously, since Cov(Z|F) >= Sigma_r contradicts E[J(Z)|F]=J(p)-Cov(Z|F); confirmed by exact enumeration in two finite cells (Appx B.3, eleven preregistered statements).

Sec 3.3/Figs 4-5: 8000-step 6-bit store runs show U/U vs U/R final-loss 95% interval inside the pre-fixed +/-0.010-nat margin while root-mean-square gains differ in every layer on both seeds, demonstrating final loss cannot detect departure from the reference.

Appx C.3-C.6 Tables 2-4: predictions about reuse were registered before testing on PyTorch checkpointing, log-softmax backward, and TE's FP8 attention backward; all main predictions held exactly (e.g., eight of eight FP8 cells within a^2/10 tolerance), with three sub-statements (S6, LS4, LS5b) reported as missed.

Appx D.5: compute accounting of 112 training runs (5856 GPU-hours) with full recipes (FineWeb-Edu 10B sample, Mistral-NeMo tokenizer, AdamW settings, TE delayed-scaling FP8 recipe, build strings in Table 6); no public code release is mentioned.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM training-methodology paper: argues that which value the backward pass reads (forward's rounding, original, or fresh stochastic rounding) is part of the learning algorithm, with a per-use reference-gradient framework applied to FP8 attention and normalization stores. Relevance is moderate: strong match to training/optimization, transformer-attention, and scaling/efficiency preferences, and it trains Llama-3-style LMs, but it touches none of the highest-weight capability topics (reasoning, agents, Japanese NLP, alignment). Novelty is high: the per-use reference definition, the impossibility theorem for shared substitutes of rounded attention probabilities (Appx B.2), and the no-training checker go beyond prior failure reports (FOG, Qiu & Yao, Attn-QAT). Rigor is exceptional: preregistered predictions and evaluation rules fixed before runs, exact rational-arithmetic enumerations, and honest reporting of misses (S6, LS4, LS5b in Tables 2-3). Evidence is strong and replicated across seeds, software builds, and a 1.5B check, though mostly at 390M on one GPU type with an emulated backward (validated to 2.4-7.6% gradient distance, Appx D.2). Generalizability is decent conceptually (checkpointing, activation compression) but empirics are confined to one decoder-LM family and FineWeb-Edu. Reproducibility is aided by exhaustive recipes and compute accounting (5856 GPU-hours, Appx D.5) but no code/artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Backward-State Policy Is Part of the Learning Algorithm

radar.summary: Low-precision training rounds tensors that the backward pass reads again, often for several gradients; each use can read the forward's rounded value, the original, or a new random rounding. This backward-state policy looks like a memory and precision detail, settled by copy accuracy and final loss. We argue that it is part of the learning algorithm, and that neither check shows whether it is right. Copy accuracy does not decide the outcome: in three pairs of 390M runs with an emulated FP8 backwa
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文主張：低精度訓練中「反向傳播該讀哪一份已捨入張量」的選擇，並非記憶體與精度細節，而是學習演算法的一部分。作者定義「使用（use）」為每次讀取已捨入張量的梯度計算，並將每個使用所讀的值（前向用過的捨入值 R、原始值 U、或同分布的新捨入 N）稱為反向傳播狀態策略。他們宣告一個參考標準：前向實際執行時的梯度，梯度依 straight-through 慣例穿過捨入不變。在此標準下，即使最精確的原始值也可能在某個使用上出錯，因為同一張量可能餵給需要不同值的多個梯度（例如正規化輸出：gain 的梯度需要原始值，下一層權重梯度需要捨入值）。實驗上，在 390M、模擬 FP8 反向傳播的三組配對中，重用前向捨入會使訓練失敗，而讀取同分布的新捨入則成功；僅更換反向傳播（保留 FP8 前向、改用 BF16 反向）即可消除 NVIDIA Transformer Engine FP8 attention 在三個種子上的失敗。最終損失則無法辨別策略是否遵循參考：多種策略的最終損失落在事先固定的 0.010 nats 邊界內，但訓練出的權重不同（gain 統計量分歧）。作者因此改為逐一使用檢查，從參考推導出每個使用可讀的值或其替代，並在 PyTorch 與 Transformer Engine 的三個運算子上預先登錄預測：checkpoint 重算、log-softmax 反向、TE FP8 attention 反向，全部預測皆成立。限制在於理論假設（如隨機捨入的獨立性、二次損失）與單運算子的量測範圍。
radar.title: Backward-State Policy Is Part of the Learning Algorithm

links.title: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does

evidence: Section 4.1: 'Without steering, one-hop accuracy is 48.2%, but with J_one it rises to 99.6%. Two-hop accuracy reaches 98.2% with J_two' on held-out graphs with a frozen backbone.

Section 5.2: 'In D8L6, patching steered patterns into the unsteered run raises one-hop accuracy from 39.2% to 61.6%. The reverse patch reduces accuracy from 99.7% to 68.1%'; Ouro: 'steered patterns produce 248/256 correct answers, close to 251/256 under full steering'.
Section 6 and Table 13 (Appendix E.3): five matched backbone pairs; one-hop accuracy 100% (stepwise) vs 66.5±10.0% (final-only); two-hop 13.2±6.8% vs 50.5±15.2%, with final-only higher in every pair.

Section 4.2 and Table 7 (Appendix C.4.4): controller reuse degrades — eighth-call exact match 9.7/10.6/10.1% for repeated-one/two/mixed; Conclusion admits 'controllers that work over one or two loops degrade under longer composition'.

Appendix C.4.5: 'The mean across these backbones describes the selected cases, not a random sample of seeds'; Appendix D.3/D.4 note a single Ouro checkpoint and 'cannot establish that these graph identities were absent from backbone training'.

Appendix H Tables 16-17: J+F reaches 89.69% on Qwen3-8B long requests (k=5-8) vs 28.59% F-only, and raises KG relation-composition accuracy from 2.53% to 99.92% over lengths 4-16, declining beyond the map-training range.

Reproducibility Statement: 'Reproduction materials are available in the repository linked below the abstract' (github.com/wjjpku/howloop); Appendix G tabulates training budgets and intervention sites.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic interpretability study of looped (weight-tied) transformers showing that the entering hidden state causally selects what a frozen loop computes, with attention routing identified as the pathway via pattern patching. Matches the preference profile well on interpretability, transformer architecture, and latent multi-step reasoning, with partial LLM coverage (Ouro-2.6B in Section 5, Qwen3-8B in Appendix H), but no Japanese NLP, agents, RAG, or code content, and core results live on small synthetic models. Novelty is solid: it extends prior loop-trajectory work (Zhang et al., Blayney et al. cited in Sections 1-2) with causal steering and patching rather than observation alone. Rigor is exceptionally high: matched supervision pairs across five seeds (Section 6, Table 13), two map fits per target, dedicated evaluation cohorts per experiment (Table 3), bootstrap CIs, and extensive controls (values-only, unrelated-graph, wrong-loop, comparison-head interventions, Appendix D.4 Table 12). Evidence strength is strong but bounded by selected backbones ('the selected cases, not a random sample of seeds', Appendix C.4.5), a single Ouro checkpoint with no cross-backbone replication (Appendix D.4), and unverifiable graph-exclusion for Ouro. Generalizability is moderate: confirmed on graph walks, parity, letter-walk, and Qwen/KG tasks, but the paper itself shows finite operating regimes (~10% exact match at the eighth controller call, Table 7) and steering depends on backbone supervision. Reproducibility is high: public repository, per-experiment hyperparameters, seeds, budgets, and hash verification (Reproducibility Statement, Appendix G).

primary_link.title: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does

top5.summary: Looped Transformers repeatedly apply the same set of Transformer layers, giving them a recurrent architecture for latent computation. Their strong performance on iterative reasoning and length-generalization tasks suggests an appealing explanation: recurrence may provide an inductive bias that lets the model reuse a learned algorithm across loops. However, weight sharing alone does not imply that every loop performs the same operation. This raises a basic question: is each loop actually repeatin
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討迴圈式 Transformer（Looped Transformer）的核心疑問：權重共享是否代表每個迴圈都執行相同運算？作者指出，由於進入共享層的隱藏狀態會隨計算推進而改變，相同的參數實際上可被導向不同的操作。研究以圖漫步（graph walk）任務為測試案例，先在原生軌跡中觀察到解碼預測可能每圈前進不同數量的圖步，或停留在已抵達的目標，顯示遞迴進展不必遵循「一圈一步」的固定規則。接著作者凍結共享 Transformer 層，僅在迴圈邊界訓練一個線性層 J，結果顯示只改變進入狀態即可讓同一組凍結權重分別選取一跳或兩跳目標，未引導時一跳準確率為 48.2%，加入 J 後可達 99.6%，兩跳則達 98.2%。機制分析上，作者以激活修補（activation patching）證明注意力模式可承接引導效果，甚至直接切換所選轉移，在 D8L6 與 Ouro-2.6B 多跳語言任務上皆成立；配對監督實驗則顯示，主幹訓練是否加入中間監督，會改變 J 能誘發哪些轉移，支持 J 是「選取」主幹已學得的運算而非創造新演算法。限制方面，控制器雖可連續套用兩個迴圈，但準確率隨組合長度增加而下降，且深度外推能力有限。此研究釐清遞迴深度的歸納偏誤，並指出長程遞迴推理的關鍵在於狀態能否持續與共享運算相容。
top5.title: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does
top5.title_zh: 共享權重、選擇性計算：迴圈式 Transformer 如何決定每個迴圈做什麼

links.title: Better Supervision Is Nearby: Neighborhood On-Policy Self-Distillation

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): 'Across three independent runs per method, NEIGHBORHOOD OPSD improves the three-benchmark Average@12 over OPSD by 2.75, 1.67, and 1.94 points on Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, respectively.'
Section 3.2 / Table 1 (Page 6): N-OPSD Avg. 66.57±0.46 vs OPSD 64.63±0.16, EOPD 64.63±0.09, PW-OPSD 65.12±0.33 on Qwen3-8B; text states it 'ranks first across all nine model-benchmark settings.'

Section 3.3 / Table 2 (Page 6): matched ablations—Random Top-K 64.29, w/o selection clip 64.26, w/o SCGate 65.28, OPSD+SCGate 64.91 vs full method 66.57—supporting complementary selection and filtering.
Section 3.4 / Table 3 (Page 7): downstream Avg. peaks at sigma=.002 (66.57) while SF coverage and anchor accuracy continue rising to sigma=.006, supporting radius calibration on student prefixes.
Table 5 (Page 15): routing ablation at sigma=.002, K=25—MaxPeak-anchored q=.75 reaches 66.57 vs Uniform averaging 64.63, Random 64.91, Token consensus 65.00; q=1 drops to 65.28.

Appendix B.4/B.6 (Pages 13-14): complete training/eval configs (lr 1e-6, batch 64, 100 steps, tau=.99, kappa=.06, val.n=12, 8 GPUs for 8B) though no code availability claim appears anywhere in the document.
Appendix F (Page 20): limitations state experiments 'cover mathematical reasoning tasks and the Qwen3 model family' and that the expert pool 'remains fixed throughout training.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-methodology paper on improving on-policy self-distillation for mathematical reasoning: a strong match to the reasoning (2.5), LLM (2.5), and training/distillation preferences. The method is a well-motivated but incremental extension that combines existing ingredients—Gaussian perturbation experts (Neural Thickets/RandOpt) with privileged on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)—adding greedy complementary expert selection by filtered reference-token PTA and MaxPeak-anchored quantile routing. Rigor and evidence are strong: three independent runs with std devs for main methods at three model scales, N-OPSD first in all nine model-benchmark settings, and matched ablations isolating selection, filtering, routing, radius, pool size, divergence, and target-distribution choices, with a clear radius-calibration story (downstream peaks at sigma=.002 even though reference-side coverage keeps rising). Weakened generalizability: only math benchmarks and the Qwen3 family, requires privileged reference solutions, and the expert pool is frozen during training; authors acknowledge this in Appendix F. Reproducibility is aided by very detailed hyperparameters, data identifiers, thresholds, and timing breakdowns, but no code release is stated. Main baseline numbers for Base/SFT/GRPO are inherited from a cited prior work rather than rerun (disclosed), and many ablations are single-run point estimates, slightly tempering evidence strength.

primary_link.title: Better Supervision Is Nearby: Neighborhood On-Policy Self-Distillation

top5.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains mathematical reasoning models using a privileged teacher that sees a reference solution and supervises student-sampled prefixes. Standard OPSD uses one fixed parameter setting at every state, but nearby settings may offer additional supervision. We find that local parameter perturbations reveal complementary reference-aligned corrections under the same reference context. Different experts supply these corrections at different reference positions. Their p
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文關注同策略自蒸餾（OPSD）在數學推理訓練上的一個限制：特權教師雖然能看見參考解答，但在每一個學生造訪的狀態都使用同一組固定參數，因此可能沒有把同一個基礎模型所能提供的監督用盡。作者觀察到，對教師參數做微小的區域擾動後，不同擾動專家會在相同參考脈絡下產生互補的修正，且這些修正落在不同的參考位置上；把這些專家集合起來，能涵蓋比未擾動教師更多的參考位置。據此他們提出 NEIGHBORHOOD OPSD（N-OPSD）：離線階段以「過濾後的參考詞元機率提升」作為評分，利用貪婪邊際增益挑出精簡且互補的專家池；線上階段則把「錨定方向」與「支持程度」分開處理，先以 MaxPeak 選出錨定詞元，再用分位數選擇挑出與錨定一致的專家，由該專家提供完整的下一詞元分布，並沿用 OPSD 的截斷前向 KL 目標。實驗在 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 上訓練，於 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 與 HMMT 2025 評估 Average@12。三次獨立訓練的結果顯示，相較於 OPSD，N-OPSD 在三項基準平均上分別提升 2.75、1.67 與 1.94 分，且在各模型尺度與基準上皆排名第一。消融實驗指出，過濾後的參考詞元增益是有效的選擇準則，考慮專家池內部重疊與依狀態路由都能進一步提升準確率；最高峰的專家未必提供最佳訓練目標。限制在於實驗僅涵蓋數學推理與 Qwen3 系列，專家池在訓練期間固定，未必能跟上學生變化，且推論時僅使用蒸餾後的學生模型。
top5.title: Better Supervision Is Nearby: Neighborhood On-Policy Self-Distillation
top5.title_zh: 更好的監督就在附近：鄰域同策略自蒸餾

links.title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text

evidence: Abstract: 'we pretrain 800 language models (19.9M to 973M parameters)... our scaling law predicts the effect of AI text on held-out human-text loss for models up to 3.6x larger with 41% lower error than the best existing law'
Section 2: 'AI-generated texts pass FineWeb's pipeline 2.3x (29.3% vs. 12.8%) and DCLM's full pipeline 9.8x (14.5% vs. 1.5%) as often as human-written documents' from a 10,000-document audit
Table 1: paired RMSE x10^3 on held-out sizes, ours 0.83 on C4 vs 1.41 for Shukor joint (best existing) and 4.32 for Chinchilla
Section E.1: bootstrap over 51 held-out AI runs by control group, law beats joint law in 99.99% of draws on C4 (gap 0.58x10^-3, 95% interval 0.32 to 0.84)
Table 8 (Appendix D): one-at-a-time ablation of benefit and harm functional forms, chosen form 0.83 vs no-harm 3.27 and no-credit 3.29 x10^-3 on held-out sizes

Limitations: 'We fit our law on models up to 268M parameters and test it up to 973M... We study only pretraining, on English web text labeled by Pangram'; CORE scores show AI text raises scores 'about as much as fresh human text' (Section G)
Reproducibility Statement: releases 'all 83B tokens of WildAI' with labels, 'every checkpoint together with its loss on the seven evaluation sets', and all fitting/comparator code
Section A: Pangram 3.3.2 labels 37 of 60,000 pre-2021 documents AI (0.062%), stated as an upper bound on web-text false-positive rate; detector is from the authors' institution Pangram Labs
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM pretraining methodology: 800 controlled pretraining runs (19.9M-973M params) yield a new scaling law for 'wild' AI-generated web text with separable benefit/harm terms that reduces to Chinchilla (§4.3), a genuinely new setting distinct from model-collapse and curated synthetic-data work (§3). Strong rigor: paired controls where each AI addition trains on exactly its control's human corpus (§B), fixed held-out sizes (477M/973M), unified benchmarking of 11 comparator laws with bootstrap significance (Table 1, §E.1), and form-by-form ablations (Table 8). Evidence is quantified across four human-text targets and mixed/AI targets, including honest negative results (law loses to Shukor joint on AI-text targets, Table 9; CORE scores show no harm, §G). Main weaknesses: AI labels come from the authors' own Pangram detector (conflict of interest, partially mitigated by pre-2022 false-positive bounds, §A), models are small so the 1.6x/3.0x compute forecasts and 8B projections are extrapolations, and scope is English-only next-token loss (Limitations). Exceptional reproducibility: 83B-token labeled corpus, all checkpoints and losses, fitting code and comparator implementations released (Reproducibility Statement).

primary_link.title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text

top5.summary: Web text makes up the majority of pretraining data and is increasingly AI-generated. After applying FineWeb quality filtering, we find that 27.5% of tokens from June 2026 web data are labeled as AI-generated by Pangram, rising to 31.1% by August. Unlike synthetic data or model-collapse setups, this *wild* AI text comes from many models, is written for human readers, and arrives unlabeled in pretraining corpora. How does AI text in the wild affect language model pretraining? To answer this questi
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理一個當前預訓練實務上的迫切問題：充斥網路的「野外」（wild）AI 生成文本，對語言模型預訓練究竟有何影響。作者先用 EditLens 與 Pangram 3.3.2 標註網頁資料，發現 2026 年 6 月通過 FineWeb 品質過濾的 token 中有 27.5% 為 AI 生成，8 月升至 31.1%，且 FineWeb 與 DCLM 的過濾流程反而偏好保留 AI 文件（分別為人類的 2.3 倍與 9.8 倍）。為了量化影響，他們預訓練 800 個模型（19.9M 至 973M 參數），改變 AI 與人類 token 比例，並在人類、混合與純 AI 文本上評估。核心發現是：AI 文本只對資料匱乏的模型有幫助，在 Chinchilla 最佳化的 20 tokens per parameter 之後，AI token 幾乎立刻提高人類文本的損失，而同樣數量的新的人類 token 仍能持續降低損失。既有縮放定律（如 Chinchilla、重複資料或混合資料定律）無法預測此現象。作者提出新定律，結合一項飽和的收益項與一項對數成長的傷害項，在沒有 AI 文本時退化回 Chinchilla，並將 AI token 的價值以人類 token 當量表示，允許其正負號改變。此法在保留的 477M 與 973M 模型上，預測誤差為 0.83×10⁻³，優於最佳既有定律的 1.41×10⁻³。推論指出，若不篩除 AI 文本，2026 年 8 月的 AI 佔比需多花 1.6 倍算力才能追平人類子集訓練，2028 年將達 3.0 倍。作者建議：以人類文本為目標時應過濾 AI 文本、優先重複人類文本再加 AI 文本，並分開報告人類與 AI 文本的驗證損失，因為在 22.3% AI 佔比的混合驗證集下，95.5% 的有害訓練會被掩蓋。限制在於最大只驗證到 973M 參數，且僅涵蓋英文網頁預訓練；更大模型的記憶與崩壞行為可能不同。作者釋出 WildAI 語料（83B token）、標籤、800 個模型與程式碼。
top5.title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text
top5.title_zh: 一個 AI token 值多少？網路野外 AI 生成文本的縮放定律

links.title: PhantomEnvironments: Training LLM Agents in Fictional Worlds

evidence: Section 4.1, Table 2: RL fine-tuning in PhantomEnvironments improves F1 across four LLMs on six benchmarks, e.g., Llama-3.2-3B from 3.8 to 27.0 on SynthWorlds-SM (7.1x), with mean +/- standard error over two training seeds.

Section 4.2, Figure 4: real NQ+HotpotQA training wins in-domain (56.7% vs 52.2% avg F1) while PhantomEnvs wins on newer out-of-domain benchmarks (32.1% vs 28.4%) and closes the SynthWorlds Knowledge Advantage gap to 0% for Qwen2.5-3B.

Section 5, Figures 5-6: ablation over environment complexity axes shows linear hops dominate transfer; Hops +Comparisons targets matching real-world comparison categories; Hops +Constraints actively hurts via verbatim-query shortcuts.
Appendix B.1: verbatim MuSiQue trajectory pair contrasting monolithic-query behavior of a Constraints-trained agent (wrong answer) versus decomposed search of a Hops-trained agent (correct answer).

Appendix A.2-A.3: full GRPO hyperparameters (lr 1e-6, 8 rollouts, fp32 FSDP2, vLLM rollouts, SkyRL commit 298bebc), retriever ablations in Tables 4-5 showing evaluation with a stronger Qwen3-Embedding-4B retriever than training; code released at github.com/kilian-group/phantom-envs.
Table 8: PopQA, MMLU, and Wiki-18 perplexity largely unchanged after fine-tuning, except Phi-4-mini + PhantomEnvs drops 2.1pp on PopQA and 7% relative perplexity increase, reported transparently.
Section 4.1, Figure 3: emergent 'search scaling'—Qwen models allocate search calls roughly linearly with question difficulty; Phi-4-mini shows no scaling, indicating model-dependence.
Limitations section: acknowledges compute limits to larger LLMs, no open-web benchmarks like BrowseComp-Plus, and that blending synthetic with real data is untested.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong fit to high-weight preferences: LLM agents trained with GRPO RL in rule-generated synthetic search environments (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning/CoT, RAG, RL). The core contribution—LLM-free, Prolog-verifiable environments with zero marginal cost that transfer to real-world multi-hop benchmarks—is a genuine advance over LLM-synthesized environments, though it builds directly on the authors' own PhantomWiki and pre-LLM procedural work (BabyAI, RandomWorld), tempering novelty. Rigor is solid: four model families, two seeds, matched 55K data budget against Search-R1-style real data, retriever ablations (Tables 4-5), pooled-corpus robustness (Table 3), and knowledge-retention checks (PopQA/MMLU/perplexity, Table 8). Evidence is extensive with standard errors, though the abstract's 'often outperforming real-world training data' holds fully only for Qwen models—Figures 9-10 disclose Llama/Phi gaps persist—and the authors report the best held-out checkpoint for unstable runs, a mild selection bias they disclose. Generalizability is bounded by 3B-7B models, dense-retrieval-only search, and no open-web evaluation (acknowledged in Limitations). Reproducibility is excellent: open code, hyperparameters, SkyRL commit, generator configurations. The complexity-axis ablation (hops vs comparisons vs constraints) with the shortcut analysis in Appendix B.1 is a particularly valuable, honest negative result.

primary_link.title: PhantomEnvironments: Training LLM Agents in Fictional Worlds

top5.summary: Training LLM agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is bottlenecked by environments, which must provide verifiable rewards, support long-horizon interaction, and scale cheaply. Existing approaches rely on costly human-curated data or on LLM-generated environments that risk hallucinations and benchmark contamination. We show that LLMs can instead be trained into capable search agents using synthetic environments generated entirely by rules, whose generation requires no LLM and has zero marginal
top5.summary_zh: 以強化學習訓練 LLM 搜尋代理時，瓶頸在於環境：必須提供可驗證獎勵、支援長程多輪互動，且能廉價擴充。現行做法依賴人工整理語料（如 NaturalQuestions、HotpotQA），或由 LLM 生成環境，但後者帶來幻覺獎勵、基準資料污染、API 成本與生成器能力上限。本文提出 PhantomEnvironments，把 PhantomWiki 的虛構世界與模板化多跳問題，轉成可互動的多輪 RL 環境；整個生成流程完全由規則驅動，沒有真人、也沒有 LLM 參與，因此邊際成本為零，且答案可由 Prolog 精確驗證。研究者以 GRPO 全量微調 Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 與 Phi-4-mini-instruct，並在六個真實多跳搜尋基準上評估。結果顯示，在 Wikipedia-2018 系列（HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue）平均提升約 1.7 倍，在較新且更難的 SynthWorlds-RM/SM 與 FRAMES 上約 2.2 倍，Llama 在 SynthWorlds-SM 上甚至提升 7.1 倍。此外，Qwen 模型學會依問題難度大致線性擴充搜尋次數，展現 emergent search scaling；且能泛化到未見過、甚至大 10 倍的虛構宇宙。與真實 NQ+HotpotQA 訓練相比，真實資料在同領域基準勝出，但在較新的跨領域基準上優勢收斂甚至消失；合成環境能把 SynthWorlds 的知識優勢落差降到 0%。複雜度消融顯示線性跳躍是遷移主軸，比較題能改善對應題型，而限制條件題反而因獎勵「逐字查詢」捷徑而傷害遷移。限制在於領域內知識記憶仍勝出，且環境設計須避免獎勵捷徑。此工作把規則生成環境定位為零邊際成本、可精確驗證、不會過時的新訓練資料來源。
top5.title: PhantomEnvironments: Training LLM Agents in Fictional Worlds
top5.title_zh: PhantomEnvironments：在虛構世界中訓練 LLM 代理

links.title: Cheap to Draw, Expensive to Trust: Certifying Test-Time Scaling Curves

evidence: Abstract: paired audit 'uses 0.74 times the answers of the cheapest competing certified audit at 64 budgets and 0.53 times at 1,024'; MMLU-Pro curve certified with 79,133 answers 'within 0.6% of what a cost law fitted beforehand predicted'.
Section 8.2, Table 2: median answer ratios 0.74/0.66/0.53 at K=64/256/1024, cheaper on 175/185 and 173/185 pools; Section 8.2 reports no misses across 3,255 stored-pool runs.
Section 6, Lemma 7: exact paired exponential inequality for two independent Bernoulli draws at the same question, enabling variance-adaptive simultaneous bands without a pilot.
Section 8.4: honest limitations — paired audit loses at coarse precision ε=1/16 (median ratio 1.40) due to the two-round start-up, and wins at ε=1/64 on 179/185 pools.
Section 8.5: cost law aKM+L(bK/ε+cΣw/ε²) fitted with R²=0.995 across 1,085 settings; coefficients fixed before the MMLU-Pro study, predicting 78,656 answers vs 79,133 used.
Section 7: extensions to pass@k, majority voting, question populations (Section 7.3), dependent trajectories (Proposition 12), and Theorem 13's 4/e asymptotic price of unknown score percentiles.
Section 9 Related work: fixed-list results of Sections 4–6 'have no counterpart' in Fitas (2026), the closest work auditing the same curve for question populations.
Appendix G: full protocol, data licenses (Weaver MIT, CodeContests CC BY 4.0, MMLU-Pro MIT), competitor designs, computation costs; no explicit code release is stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Statistical certification methodology for LLM test-time scaling curves (best-of-k, pass@k, majority voting), squarely within high-weight preferences (LLMs, test-time/evaluation, reasoning-style sampling, code pass@k); not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid: minimax characterization of the cost of certifying a whole scaling curve, a no-pilot paired audit built on a new exact exponential inequality for Bernoulli pairs (Lemma 7), a corrected exact-binomial final look (Lemma 8), and an exact 4/e price of unknown score percentiles (Theorem 13), with fixed-list results claimed absent from the closest prior work (Section 9, Fitas 2026). Rigor is high: complete proofs in Appendices A–F, matching lower and upper bounds, explicit assumptions and constants, coverage proofs. Evidence is strong: 185 held-out stored pools with exactly computable answer laws, zero misses in 3,255 runs, ablations isolating where savings come from, honest failure-mode analysis (loses at coarse precision), and a pre-registered newly generated MMLU-Pro study whose cost was predicted within 0.6% before generation (Section 8.5–8.6). Generalizability is good (populations, dependent trajectories, other curves) with clearly stated scope limits. Reproducibility is aided by public data sources, licenses, protocol, and computation details (Appendix G), but no explicit code release is stated.

top5.summary: Sampling several answers and keeping the one a verifier scores highest is one of the simplest ways to buy accuracy at test time. Its effect is reported as a scaling curve: accuracy against the number $k$ of sampled answers. The curve is cheap to draw and expensive to trust. top5.summary_zh: 本文研究語言模型測試時間擴展（test-time scaling）曲線的統計認證問題。作法上，作者先推導在固定題目清單上認證整條 best-of-k 曲線的 minimax 成本，指出成本由三部分組成：分數分布尾部的校準、題目之間的差異，以及沿曲線累加的題內雜訊；並證明在單一基準上，成本可收斂為某個「最佳答案分配下單一答案影響力的變異數」。據此提出「配對稽核」（paired audit）：每回合對每題各生成兩條路徑，利用成對 Bernoulli 抽樣的指數不等式，無需先導實驗即可隨時有效地給出同時涵蓋所有預算的信賴帶。在 185 組保留分數池上，配對稽核在 64、256、1024 個預算下分別只需最便宜競爭認證稽核 0.74、0.66、0.53 倍的生成答案數，且 3255 次執行全數涵蓋精確曲線；另在 MMLU-Pro 新生成研究中以 79133 個答案完成認證，與事前擬合的成本定律預測相差 0.6%。限制包括：配對稽核需付出兩個完整回合的啟動成本，因此在大基準、粗精度下反而較差；未知分數百分位數的價格僅對單題、均方誤差目標成立；相依軌跡僅涵蓋固定生成策略。此工作的重要性在於：實務上建議回報同時信賴帶而非單點曲線，並以 Proposition 1 據帶選擇預算，讓「花多少算力取樣才值得」這件事有可驗證的統計保證。
